AR KAI 2024..pdf Tema Theme 2024 Memperkuat Layanan dan Menjamin Keselamatan untuk Wujudkan Keberlanjutan Empowering Services and Ensuring Safety to Cultivate Sustainability PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) | Laporan Tahunan dan Keberlanjutan 2024 Penjelasan Tema Theme Explanation Sejalan dengan visi menjadi solusi ekosistem transportasi terbaik untuk Indonesia, PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) memperkuat layanan dengan meningkatkan sarana-prasarana untuk mendukung operasional yang lebih baik. Komitmen tersebut dilakukan sebagai langkah strategis KAI dalam mewujudkan masa depan yang berkelanjutan. Di tahun 2024, KAI melakukan transformasi dan inovasi digital untuk meningkatkan keandalan dan menjamin keselamatan bagi penumpang. KAI meluncurkan inovasi Track-Mod dan Smart Rail untuk meningkatkan keselamatan dan keamanan kereta. Inovasi ini dirancang untuk meningkatkan efisiensi operasional, penghematan biaya, dan juga jaminan keselamatan perjalanan kereta api. KAI juga meluncurkan Carbon Footprint yang dapat diakses melalui aplikasi Access by KAI sebagai solusi transportasi yang inovatif dan ramah lingkungan. Lebih lanjut, KAI menerbitkan Obligasi melalui mekanisme Penawaran Umum Berkelanjutan (PUB) Obligasi dan Sukuk Ijarah Berkelanjutan I Kereta Api Indonesia Tahap II Tahun 2024.
In line with its vision of becoming Indonesia's best transportation ecosystem solution, PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) strengthens its services by improving infrastructure to aid better operations. Such commitment is carried out as KAI’s strategic step in realizing a sustainable future.
In 2024, KAI conducted digital transformation and innovation to improve reliability and ensure safety for passengers. KAI launched the Track-Mod and Smart Rail innovation to increase train safety and security, designed to improve operational efficiency, cost savings, as well as ensure train travel safety. KAI also launched Carbon Footprint which could be accessed through the Access by KAI application as an innovative and environmentally friendly transportation solution. Moreover, KAI issued bonds through the Continuous Public Offering (PUB) mechanism for Continuous Bonds and Sukuk Ijarah I Kereta Api Indonesia Phase II in 2024.
Memperkuat Layanan dan Menjamin Keselamatan untuk Wujudkan Keberlanjutan Empowering Services and Ensuring Safety to Cultivate Sustainability 1 Annual and Sustainability Report 2024 | PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) Kesinambungan Tema Theme Continuity PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) berkomitmen untuk menjadi katalisator utama dalam mendorong transformasi berkelanjutan bagi negeri melalui inisiatif yang terfokus pada peningkatan konektivitas. Sebagai pionir dalam sektor transportasi darat, perusahaan telah mengambil peran sentral dalam mempercepat pertumbuhan dan kemajuan ekonomi nasional. Dengan jaringan kereta api yang merentang dari ujung barat hingga timur, PT Kereta Api Indonesia telah menciptakan jalur komunikasi yang efisien, menghubungkan pusat-pusat ekonomi, industri, dan perdagangan di seluruh negeri. Keberadaan layanan kereta api yang andal tidak hanya memperpendek jarak antar-kota, tetapi juga memperluas aksesibilitas bagi masyarakat di daerah-daerah terpencil.
Melalui investasi strategis dalam pemeliharaan dan pengembangan infrastruktur, PT Kereta Api Indonesia memberikan kontribusi signifikan pada perubahan positif dalam sektor transportasi. Penambahan jalur kereta api, perluasan stasiun, dan peningkatan teknologi layanan merupakan upaya nyata dalam meningkatkan efisiensi dan kualitas perjalanan.
PT Kereta Api Indonesia juga mengambil peran sebagai katalisator sosial dan ekonomi, menciptakan peluang baru untuk pengembangan bisnis dan pertumbuhan ekonomi lokal. Dengan membangun kolaborasi erat dengan berbagai pemangku kepentingan, perusahaan ini mendorong transformasi berkelanjutan yang berdampak positif pada pengembangan masyarakat di sepanjang jalur kereta api.
Sebagai pilar penting dalam mobilitas dan konektivitas, PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) tidak hanya menjadi penggerak utama transformasi nasional tetapi juga pendorong perubahan menuju masa depan yang lebih berkelanjutan dan inklusif bagi negeri.
PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) is committed to being the primary catalyst in driving sustainable transformation for the nation through initiatives focused on enhancing connectivity. As a pioneer in the land transportation sector, the company has taken a central role in accelerating national economic growth and progress.With a railway network stretching from the western to the eastern ends of the country, PT Kereta Api Indonesia has created efficient communication routes, connecting economic, industrial, and trade centers across the nation. The existence of reliable rail services not only shortens the distance between cities but also expands accessibility for communities in remote areas.
Through strategic investments in the maintenance and development of infrastructure, PT Kereta Api Indonesia makes a significant contribution to positive changes in the transportation sector. The addition of railway lines, station expansions, and technological service improvements are tangible efforts to enhance travel efficiency and quality.
PT Kereta Api Indonesia also plays a role as a social and economic catalyst, creating new opportunities for business development and local economic growth. By building close collaborations with various stakeholders, the company promotes sustainable transformation that positively impacts community development along the railway lines.
As an essential pillar in mobility and connectivity, PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) is not only a primary driver of national transformation but also a promoter of change towards a more sustainable and inclusive future for the nation.
2023 Meningkatkan Konektivitas, Mengkatalisasi Transformasi Berkelanjutan bagi Negeri Enhanching Connectivity, Catalyzing Sustainable Transformation for the Nation 2 Memperkuat Layanan dan Menjamin Keselamatan untuk Wujudkan Keberlanjutan Empowering Services and Ensuring Safety to Cultivate Sustainability PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) | Laporan Tahunan dan Keberlanjutan 2024 Kesinambungan Tema Theme Continuity Seiring pemulihan situasi ekonomi dari dampak pandemi Covid-19, KAI terus memperkuat kontribusi pada sektor transportasi negeri. Hal tersebut terwujud melalui pengembangan usaha dan operasional selama 2022, yang secara mendasar mampu mendorong daya adaptasi KAI dalam menghadapi dinamika industri. Lebih dari itu, kontribusi KAI juga tercermin melalui peningkatan kinerja keberlanjutan yang terlaksana selama 2022, mencakup aspek ekonomi, sosial, dan lingkungan, sebagai upaya berkelanjutan dalam menghadirkan dukungan kuat bagi pencapaian tujuan-tujuan pembangunan berkelanjutan di Indonesia.
Sampai akhir 2022, KAI menerapkan sejumlah langkah strategis mencakup segmen angkutan penumpang dan barang. Pada angkutan penumpang, KAI menerapkan pencegahan penularan Covid-19 sesuai kebijakan Pemerintah, sebagai upaya menyeluruh dalam memberi rasa aman bagi seluruh pelanggan. KAI juga telah menerapkan sejumlah upaya pemasaran, baik secara online maupun offline, hingga melakukan reclass, rerouting, dan menghadirkan perjalanan KA tambahan. Kemudian, pada angkutan barang, KAI telah menerapkan sejumlah upaya yang diarahkan guna percepatan pembangunan infrastruktur pendukung, optimalisasi sarana dan kegiatan pemasaran, hingga menerapkan upaya efisiensi pola operasi untuk meningkatkan volume angkutan, baik pada wilayah Jawa maupun Sumatra.
Penguatan kontribusi KAI antara lain ditunjukkan melalui peningkatan kualitas operasional, baik pada aspek keselamatan, ketepatan waktu, kenyamanan, dan daya tarik perjalanan. Pada 2022, KAI berhasil meningkatkan keandalan melalui kinerja pelayanan dan keselamatan, dengan merealisasikan penurunan kecelakaan dan keterlambatan, baik pada KA penumpang maupun KA barang. Peningkatan kenyamanan dan daya tarik perjalanan KA juga tercermin melalui hadirnya KA Luxury dan KA Panoramic pada 2022.
Atas pencapaian yang diraih pada 2022, kami optimistis kontribusi KAI dapat dipertahankan dan terus ditingkatkan seiring kelanjutan laju pembangunan negeri. Kami optimistis, KAI akan tumbuh lebih kuat sebagai pengelola moda transportasi berkelas dunia, seiring pencapaian visi untuk hadir menjadi solusi ekosistem transportasi terbaik untuk Indonesia.
As the economic situation recovers from the impact of the Covid-19 pandemic, KAI continues to strengthen its contribution to the country’s transportation sector. This was realized through business and operational development throughout 2022, which is fundamentally able to encourage KAI’s adaptability in dealing with industrial dynamics. Moreover, KAI’s contribution is also reflected in the improvement in sustainability performance that was carried out in 2022, covering economic, social, and environmental aspects, as an ongoing effort to provide strong support for achieving sustainable development goals in Indonesia.
As of the end of 2022, KAI was implementing various strategic steps covering the passenger and freight transportation segments. In passenger transportation, KAI implemented prevention of Covid-19 transmission according to Government policy, as a comprehensive effort to provide a sense of security for all customers. KAI has also implemented a number of marketing efforts, both online and offline, to reclass, reroute, and present additional train trips. Then, in the transportation of freight, KAI implemented numerous efforts aimed at accelerating the development of supporting infrastructure, optimizing marketing Rolling Stock and activities, as well as implementing operational pattern efficiency efforts to increase transportation volume, both in Java and Sumatra.
Strengthening of KAI’s contribution, among others, is shown through operational quality improvement, both in the aspects of safety, punctuality, comfort, and travel attractiveness. In 2022, KAI succeeded in increasing reliability through service and safety performance, by realizing a reduction in accidents and delays, both on passenger and freight trains. The increased comfort and attractiveness of train travel are also reflected in the presence of the Luxury KA and the Panoramic KA in 2022.
For the performance achieved in 2022, we are optimistic that KAI’s contribution can be maintained and continuously improved in line with the country’s continued development. We are optimistic that KAI will grow stronger as a world-class mode of transportation operator, in line with achieving its vision to be present as the best transportation ecosystem solution for Indonesia.
2022 Berakselerasi Memperkuat Kontribusi bagi Negeri Accelerating to Strengthen Contribution for the Nation 3 Annual and Sustainability Report 2024 | PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) Kesinambungan Tema Theme Continuity Tahun 2021 menjadi tahun ditanamkan semangat pemulihan dari dampak pandemi COVID-19. Sinyal pemulihan ekonomi dapat terlihat dari Purchasing Managers Index (PMI) manufaktur global yang berada pada zona ekspansif. Dalam menyambut sinyal tersebut, PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) atau KAI membangun strategi-strategi khusus yang dilakukan dalam upaya untuk bangkit dan kembali normal di masa Pandemi COVID-19 dengan tetap mengutamakan visi, misi serta nilai-nilai KAI.
Perseroan melakukan berbagai inisiatif dan hal-hal baru seperti perbaikan layanan tempuh kereta api (KA Argo Bromo Anggrek (Gambir - Surabaya Pasar Turi PP), Argo Wilis (Bandung – Surabaya Gubeng PP), Argo Lawu (Gambir - Solo Balapan PP), Argo Dwipangga (Gambir - Solo Balapan PP), dan Taksaka (Gambir - Yogyakarta PP)), penambahan frekuensi perjalanan kereta api, penerapan dynamic pricing, penggunaan model skema tarif untuk angkutan sesuai dengan cluster kereta api unggulan, non-unggulan dan kereta api perintis. Untuk peningkatan pelayanan kepada penumpang kereta api juga dilakukan dengan menghadirkan wifi gratis dalam KA Argo Bromo Anggrek, Argo Lawu, Argo Dwipangga, Argo Wilis, Taksaka, dan Argo Parahyangan serta layanan Live Cooking di atas KA Argo Bromo Anggrek, KA Argo Lawu, Argo Dwipangga, Taksaka, dan Argo Wilis. KAI juga menghadirkan layanan first mile-last mile, layanan dompet digital KAI Pay, dan layanan top-up dan tagihan di Access by KAI.
Berbagai langkah terus diupayakan yang mengarah pada keselamatan, ketepatan waktu, pelayanan dan kenyamanan seperti menjaga keandalan sarana dan prasarana, peningkatan jaminan keselamatan, implementasi sistem manajemen berbasis pelanggan (customer driven) melanjutkan penataan SDM, intensifikasi pasar yang sudah ada, pengembangan sistem informasi yang terpadu, dan peningkatan peran bisnis non angkutan melalui penertiban aset serta pengelolaan aset secara optimal dan profesional.
Kontribusi Perseroan lainnya ditunjukkan dengan mengawal jalannya Proyek Strategis Nasional berbasis perkeretaapian yaitu LRT Jabodebek dan Kereta Cepat Jakarta-Bandung. Dengan dijadikannya KAI sebagai pimpinan konsorsium BUMN atas proyek Kereta Cepat Jakarta Bandung serta dikucurkannya dana PMN oleh Pemerintah kepada perseroan untuk pembiayaan kedua proyek tersebut, kita semakin optimis bahwa Indonesia akan segera memiliki moda transportasi tambahan untuk menunjang terciptanya ekosistem transportasi yang baik.
2021 was the year to instill the spirit of recovery from the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic. Signals of economic recovery could be seen from the global manufacturing Purchasing Managers’ Index (PMI), which was in the expansion zone. In welcoming this signal, PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) or KAI developed special strategies carried out in an effort to rise and return to normal during the COVID-19 pandemic while still prioritizing KAI’s vision, mission and values.
The Company carried out various initiatives and new things such as improving rail travel services (KA Argo Bromo Anggrek (Gambir - Surabaya Pasar Turi PP), Argo Wilis (Bandung - Surabaya Gubeng PP), Argo Lawu (Gambir - Solo Balapan PP), Argo Dwipangga (Gambir - Solo Balapan PP), and Taksaka (Gambir - Yogyakarta PP)), increasing the frequency of train trips, implementing dynamic pricing, using a tariff scheme model for transportation in accordance with the superior, nonseeded and pioneer train clusters. To enhance passenger service, free Wi-Fi has been provided on the Argo Bromo Anggrek, Argo Lawu, Argo Dwipangga, Argo Wilis, Taksaka, and Argo Parahyangan trains, as well as Live Cooking services on the Argo Bromo Anggrek, Argo Lawu, Argo Dwipangga, Taksaka, and Argo Wilis trains. KAI has also introduced first-mile-last-mile services, KAI Pay digital wallet services, and top-up and billing services at Access by KAI.
Various steps were continuously pursued that lead to safety, punctuality, service, and comfort such as maintaining the reliability of Rolling Stock and infrastructure, increasing safety assurance, implementing a customer-driven management system (customer-driven), continuing HR management, intensifying existing markets, developing an integrated information system and increasing the role of non-transportation businesses through asset control and optimal and professional asset management.
The Company’s other contribution could be shown by overseeing the implementation of the National Strategic Projects based on the railway, namely the Jabodebek LRT and the Jakarta-Bandung high-speed train. With the appointment of KAI as the head of the SOE consortium for the Jakarta Bandung High-Speed Rail project and the Government’s disbursement of PMN funds to the company to finance the two projects, we were increasingly optimistic that Indonesia could soon have additional modes of transportation to support the creation of a good transportation ecosystem.

6 Memperkuat Layanan dan Menjamin Keselamatan untuk Wujudkan Keberlanjutan Empowering Services and Ensuring Safety to Cultivate Sustainability PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) | Laporan Tahunan dan Keberlanjutan 2024 Kontribusi KAI Untuk Indonesia KAIs Contribution To Indonesia PENYELESAIAN PROYEK STRATEGIS NASIONAL PROYEK KCJB DAN PROYEK LRT JABODEBEK PROYEK KERETA CEPAT JAKARTA BANDUNG (KCJB) KCJB Whoosh yang diresmikan pada 2 Oktober 2023 memiliki kecepatan 350 km/jam dengan waktu tempuh dari Jakarta menuju Bandung kurang lebih sekitar 46 menit. Di tahun 2024, jumlah penumpang KCIC terus mengalami pertumbuhan rata-rata penumpang bulanan. Pada awal operasi, di Oktober 2023, rata-rata jumlah penumpang Whoosh berada di angka 13 ribu penumpang per hari. Pada Juni 2024 jumlahnya meningkat menjadi 17,8 ribu penumpang per hari dan melonjak menjadi 19,9 ribu penumpang per hari di masa libur sekolah pada Juli 2024. Puncaknya terjadi di Desember 2024, dimana Whoosh memiliki rata-rata penumpang per hari stabil di 20,2 ribu penumpang per hari.
LRT JABODEBEK LRT Jabodebek resmi beroperasi komersial penuh pada 28 Agustus 2023 dan diresmikan oleh Presiden Joko Widodo di Stasiun Cawang. LRT Jabodebek melayani dua line, yakni Dukuh Atas BNI - Jati Mulya dan Dukuh Atas BNI - Harjamukti dengan total sebanyak 18 stasiun dan panjang lintasan 44, 43 km. LRT Jabodebek memiliki 31 Trainset yang dibuat oleh PT INKA dengan jumlah perjalanan per hari 366 perjalanan saat weekday dan 270 perjalanan saat weekend. Pengguna LRT Jabodebek dapat melakukan pembayaran melalui Kartu Multi Trip KAI Commuter, Access by KAI, Link Saja dan Kartu Uang Elektronik.
COMPLETION OF NATIONAL STRATEGIC PROJECTS KCJB PROJECT AND JABODEBEK LRT PROJECT JAKARTA-BANDUNG HIGH-SPEED TRAIN (KCJB) PROJECT KCJB Whoosh, which was inaugurated on October 2, 2023, has a speed of 350 km/hour with a travel time from Jakarta to Bandung of approximately 46 minutes. In 2024, the average monthly number of KCIC passengers continued to grow. At the start of operations, in October 2023, the average number of Whoosh passengers was at 13 thousand passengers per day. In June 2024, the number increased to 17.8 thousand passengers per day and jumped to 19.9 thousand passengers per day during the school holidays in July 2024. The peak occurred in December 2024, when Whoosh had an average of passengers per day stable at 20.2 thousand passengers per day.
JABODEBEK LRT Jabodebek LRT officially began full commercial operations on August 28, 2023, and was inaugurated by President Joko Widodo at Cawang Station. Jabodebek LRT serves two lines, namely Dukuh Atas BNI–Jati Mulya and Dukuh Atas BNI– Harjamukti with a total of 18 stations and a track length of 44.43 km. Jabodebek LRT has 31 Trainsets made by PT INKA with a daily number of trips of 366 on weekdays and 270 trips on weekends. LRT Jabodebek users can make payments using the KAI Commuter Multi Trip Card, Access by KAI, LinkAja, and Electronic Money Card.
7 Annual and Sustainability Report 2024 | PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) Kontribusi KAI Untuk Indonesia KAIs Contribution To Indonesia LRT Jabodebek menggunakan sistem Communication-Based Train Control (CBTC) dengan Grade of Automation (GoA) level 3. Sistem CBCT-GoA3 memungkinkan pengoperasian dilakukan secara otomatis tanpa masinis, namun mensyaratkan masih terdapat petugas operasional (Train Attendant) di dalam kereta untuk penanganan kondisi darurat dan pelayanan kepada pelanggan. LRT Jabodebek juga dilengkapi oleh Automatic Train Protection (ATP) serta Interlocking & Zone Controller. LRT Jabodebek terlindungi dari over speed dan jaminan pengereman yang andal. Adapun interlocking & zone controller berfungsi untuk menjamin tidak ada kesalahan pembentukan rute serta mendistribusikan otorisasi kontrol operasional LRT.
Jabodebek LRT uses the Communication-Based Train Control (CBTC) system with Grade of Automation (GoA) level 3. The CBCT-GoA3 system allows operations to be carried out automatically without a train driver, but it still requires Train Attendants on the train to handle emergency conditions and serve customers. Jabodebek LRT is also equipped with Automatic Train Protection (ATP) and Interlocking & Zone Controller. Jabodebek LRT is protected from overspeeding and guarantees reliable braking. The interlocking & zone controller functions to ensure that there are no errors in route formation and to distribute LRT operational control authorization.

• 9 September 2015: Groundbreaking LRT Jabodebek oleh Presiden Jokowi di dekat rencana Stasiun TMII.
• 29 Juli 2016 : Perpres 65/2016 Menegaskan kembali peran PT Adhi Karya, dan menetapkan PT KAI sebagai penyelenggara sarana LRT Jabodebek (operasi dan pengelolaan kereta).
• 3 Mei 2017: Perpres 49/2017: Memperluas peran PT KAI mencakup operasi, perawatan, pengusahaan sarana dan prasarana, serta sistem pembayaran (AFC).

Gubernur DKI Jakarta Heru Budi Hartono.

13 Annual and Sustainability Report 2024 | PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) Penyelesaian Implementasi Energi Baru Terbarukan di Stasiun dan Balai Yasa PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) terus memperkuat komitmennya terhadap pelestarian lingkungan dan pembangunan berkelanjutan melalui pemanfaatan energi baru dan terbarukan. Hingga akhir tahun 2024, KAI telah berhasil memasang Pembangkit Listrik Tenaga Surya (PLTS) di berbagai titik operasional perusahaan mulai dari stasiun, balai yasa, griya karya, hingga perkantoran. Kapasitas energi yang dihasilkan secara signifikan mengurangi ketergantungan terhadap sumber energi berbasis fosil. Instalasi PLTS ini merupakan bentuk nyata kontribusi KAI dalam mendukung program pemerintah menuju transisi energi bersih dan terbarukan. KAI tidak hanya fokus pada layanan transportasi, tetapi juga pada keberlanjutan dan tanggung jawab lingkungan. KAI juga melakukan Upaya untuk mengatasi perubahan iklim melalui program dekarbonisasi dengan menggunakan sumber Energi Baru Terbarukan (EBT). Dalam hal ini KAI telah mengimplementasikan Pembangkit Listrik Tenaga Surya (PLTS) atau Solar Panel pada Gedung Jakarta Railway Center, 53 Stasiun KAI, Balai Yasa Lahat, Balai Yasa Surabaya Gubeng, Balai Yasa Tegal, GK Soka, GK Cipinang, GK Banjar, GK Kertosono, Kantor Daop 2, serta Kantor Divre III.
PLTS tersebut dioperasikan melalui sistem Solar Panel on Grid yang menggabungkan suplai listrik dari jaringan listrik PLN dan jaringan listrik Solar Panel untuk memenuhi kebutuhan listrik di area operasional. Hal ini menunjukkan bahwa implementasi energi bersih oleh KAI bersifat nasional dan inklusif. Stasiun dan fasilitas lainnya yang telah menggunakan PLTS kini mendapat pasokan listrik ramah lingkungan untuk mendukung operasional pada siang hari termasuk pencahayaan, pendinginan, dan sistem pendukung lainnya.
Kontribusi KAI Untuk Indonesia KAIs Contribution To Indonesia Completion of Renewable Energy Implementation at Stations and Railway Workshop PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) continues strengthening its commitment to environmental preservation and sustainable development through new and renewable energy usage. By the end of 2024, KAI successfully installed Solar Power Plants (PLTS) at various operational points of the company ranging from stations, workshops, workhouses, to offices. The energy capacity generated significantly reduces dependence on fossil-based energy sources. The installation of PLTS is a concrete form of KAI’s contribution to supporting the government’s program towards a clean and renewable energy transition. KAI focuses not only on transportation services, but also on sustainability and environmental responsibility. KAI also makes efforts to address climate change through a decarbonization program using New and Renewable Energy (EBT) sources. In this case, KAI has implemented Solar Power Plants (PLTS) or Solar Panels at the Jakarta Railway Center Building, 53 KAI Stations, Lahat Railway Workshop, Surabaya Gubeng Railway Workshop, Tegal Railway Workshop, Soka GK, Cipinang GK, Banjar GK, Kertosono GK, Operational Area 2 Office, and Regional Division III Office.
The PLTS is operated through a Solar Panel on Grid system that combines electricity supply from the PLN electricity network and the Solar Panel electricity network to meet electricity needs in the operational area. This shows that the clean energy implementation by KAI is national and inclusive. Stations and other facilities that have utilized PLTS now receive environmentally friendly electricity supplies to support daytime operations including lighting, cooling, and other supporting systems.
14 Memperkuat Layanan dan Menjamin Keselamatan untuk Wujudkan Keberlanjutan Empowering Services and Ensuring Safety to Cultivate Sustainability PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) | Laporan Tahunan dan Keberlanjutan 2024 Kontribusi KAI Untuk Indonesia KAIs Contribution To Indonesia The solar energy that KAI uses not only saves operational costs, but it helps reduce carbon emissions as well, which is in line with KAI’s mission to develop resources and technology by prioritizing ESG.
Solar energy usage is also applied in production facilities such as Balai Yasa to support railway maintenance activities. This is expected to strengthen energy efficiency and work productivity.
In the future, KAI will continue the program to install PLTS gradually at other stations, Railway Workshops, and other supporting facilities within the KAI Group environment. The target is to form an operational system entirely based on green energy. These concrete steps are hoped to assist KAI in becoming a pioneer in providing reliable, comfortable, and environmentally friendly public transportation services.
SOLAR PANEL TOTAL CAPACITY In 2024, KAI installed solar panels at 20 new locations as follows: • Stations (10 locations) Total capacity of 368.30 kWp and reduced emissions by 103.33 tons of CO2.
• Railway Workshop (4 locations) Total capacity of 1,312.30 kWp and reduced emissions by 368.09 tons of CO2.
• Regional Division Office (1 location) Total capacity of 122.10 kWp and reduced emissions by 34.25 tons of CO2.
• Regional Operation Office (1 location) Total capacity of 40.00 kWp and reduced emissions by 11.22 tons of CO2.
• Griya Karya (4 locations) Total capacity of 71.50 kWp and reduced emissions by 20.06 tons of CO2.
Energi surya yang KAI gunakan tidak hanya menghemat biaya operasional, tetapi juga mengurangi emisi karbon, yang sejalan dengan misi KAI dalam mengembangkan sumber daya dan teknologi dengan mengedepankan ESG.
Pemanfaatan energi matahari ini juga diterapkan di fasilitas produksi seperti Balai Yasa untuk mendukung aktivitas perawatan sarana perkeretaapian. Hal ini diharapkan dapat memperkuat efisiensi energi dan produktivitas kerja.
Ke depan, KAI akan terus melanjutkan program pemasangan PLTS secara bertahap di stasiun-stasiun lain, Balai Yasa serta fasilitas pendukung lainnya yang berada dalam lingkungan KAI Group. Targetnya adalah membentuk sistem operasional yang sepenuhnya berbasis pada energi hijau. Dengan langkah-langkah konkret ini, KAI berharap dapat menjadi pelopor dalam menghadirkan layanan transportasi publik yang tidak hanya andal dan nyaman, tetapi juga ramah lingkungan.
TOTAL KAPASITAS PLTS Di tahun 2024, KAI merealisasikan pemasangan panel surya di 20 lokasi baru sebagai berikut: • Stasiun (10 lokasi) Total kapasitas sejumlah 368,30 kWp dan berhasil mengurangi emisi sebesar 103,33 Ton CO2.
• Balai Yasa (4 lokasi) Total kapasitas sejumlah 1.312,30 kWp dan berhasil mengurangi emisi sebesar 368,09 Ton CO2.
• Kantor Divre (1 lokasi) Total kapasitas sejumlah 122,10 kWp dan berhasil mengurangi emisi sebesar 34,25 Ton CO2.
• Kantor Daop (1 lokasi) Total kapasitas sejumlah 40,00 kWp dan berhasil mengurangi emisi sebesar 11,22 Ton CO2.
• Griya Karya (4 lokasi) Total kapasitas sejumlah 71,50 kWp dan berhasil mengurangi emisi sebesar 20,06 Ton CO2.

The launching of train ticket purchase vending machine named E-Kiosk.

Transformation towards service company initiated by Commercial Division establishment.

Verenigde Spoorwegenbedrifj developed railway track in Java Island, Deli Spoorwegen Maatscappij built railway track in Sumatera, while Staat Spoorwegen developed built railway track in Batavia.

KAI operated New Yogyakarta International Airport train at Kulonprogo.

29 Annual and Sustainability Report 2024 | PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) Kilas Kinerja 2024 2024 Performance Highlight Informasi Obligasi, Sukuk, dan/atau Obligasi Konversi Information on Bonds, Sukuk, and/or Convertible Bonds INFORMASI OBLIGASI Perseroan menerbitkan Obligasi melalui mekanisme Penawaran Umum Berkelanjutan (PUB) Obligasi Berkelanjutan I Kereta Api Indonesia Tahap II Tahun 2024 dengan jumlah pokok sebesar Rp700.000.000.000,- yang surat pernyataannya efektifnya telah diperoleh dari Otoritas Jasa Keuangan No. S-148/D.04.2022 dan telah dicatatkan pada Bursa Efek Indonesia pada tanggal 12 Agustus 2024 sesuai surat BEI No. S-08240/BEI.PP3/08-2024 Pada tanggal 13 November 2024, Perseroan telah mendapatkan surat pernyataan efektif dari Otoritas Jasa Keuangan (OJK) No. S-153/D.04/2024 atas Penawaran Umum Berkelanjutan (PUB) Obligasi Berkelanjutan II Kereta Api Indonesia Tahap I Tahun 2024 dengan jumlah pokok sebesar Rp1.500.000.000.000,- dan telah dicatatkan pada Bursa Efek Indonesia pada tanggal 20 November 2024 sesuai surat BEI No. S-12133/BEI.PP3/11-2024.
INFORMASI SUKUK Perseroan menerbitkan Sukuk melalui mekanisme Penawaran Umum Berkelanjutan (PUB) Sukuk Ijarah Berkelanjutan I Kereta Api Indonesia Tahap II Tahun 2024 dengan jumlah pokok sebesar Rp300.000.000.000,- yang surat pernyataannya efektifnya telah diperoleh dari Otoritas Jasa Keuangan No. S-148/D.04.2022 dan telah dicatatkan pada Bursa Efek Indonesia pada tanggal 12 Agustus 2024 sesuai surat BEI No. S-08240/BEI.PP3/08-2024.
INFORMATION ON BONDS The Company issued Bonds through the Continuous Public Offering (PUB) mechanism of Continuous Bonds I Kereta Api Indonesia Phase II Year 2024 with a principal amount of Rp700,000,000,000 whose effective statement letter has been obtained from the Financial Services Authority No. S-148/D.04.2022 and has been listed on the Indonesia Stock Exchange on August 12, 2024, according to IDX letter No. S-08240/BEI.PP3/08-2024.
On November 13, 2024, the Company obtained an effective statement letter from the Financial Services Authority (OJK) No. S-153/D.04/2024 on the Continuous Public Offering (PUB) of Continuous Bonds II of Kereta Api Indonesia Phase I Year 2024 with a principal amount of Rp1,500,000,000,000 and has been listed on the Indonesia Stock Exchange on November 20, 2024, according to IDX letter No. S-12133/BEI.PP3/11-2024.
INFORMATION ON SUKUK The Company issued Sukuk through the Continuous Public Offering (PUB) mechanism of Continuous Sukuk Ijarah I Kereta Api Indonesia Phase II Year 2024 with a principal amount of Rp300,000,000,000 whose effective statement letter has been obtained from the Financial Services Authority No. S-148/D.04.2022 and has been listed on the Indonesia Stock Exchange on August 12, 2024, according to IDX letter No. S-08240/BEI.PP3/08-2024.

31 Annual and Sustainability Report 2024 | PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) Kilas Kinerja 2024 2024 Performance Highlight Peristiwa Penting Significant Events 10 15 24 25 Rabu, 10 Januari 2024 / Wednesday, January 10, 2024 Kamis, 15 Februari 2024 / Thursday, February 15, 2024 Rabu, 24 Januari 2024 / Wednesday, January 24, 2024 Minggu, 25 Februari 2024 / Sunday, February 25, 2024 Sukseskan Gerakan Satu Juta Pohon, KAI Tanam Pohon dan Hijaukan Stasiun Serentak di Berbagai Daerah PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) turut menyukseskan program Hari Gerakan Satu Juta Pohon dengan melakukan penanaman pohon serentak pada Rabu 10 Januari 2024 di berbagai wilayah kerjanya yang mencakup Daerah Operasi, Divisi Regional, Balai Yasa, dan Anak Perusahaan. Penanaman pohon secara serentak ini juga merupakan salah satu bagian dari Tanggung Jawab Sosial dan Lingkungan KAI melalui program KAI Go Green.
Tingkatkan Daya Angkut, KAI Tanda Tangani Kontrak Kerja Sama Pengadaan Lokomotif dengan Progress Rail (Anak Perusahaan Caterpillar) PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) atau KAI bersama Progress Rail (anak perusahaan Caterpillar) yang berasal dari Amerika Serikat (AS), menandatangani kontrak kerja sama pengadaan 54 lokomotif.
Increase Carrying Capacity, KAI Signs Cooperation Contract for Locomotive Procurement with Progress Rail (Caterpillar Subsidiary) PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) or KAI together with Progress Rail (a subsidiary of Caterpillar) from the United States (US), signed a cooperation contract for the procurement of 54 locomotives.
Tingkatkan Layanan, KAI Luncurkan 3 KA Baru PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) meluncurkan 3 KA baru yaitu KA Papandayan relasi Garut-Gambir (PP), KA Pangandaran relasi Banjar-Gambir (PP), dan KA Malabar keberangkatan pagi hari relasi Bandung-Malang (PP) pada Rabu tanggal 24 Januari 2024.
Edukasi Tentang Perkeretaapian, KAI Hadirkan Pengalaman Travelling By Train Bagi Anak-anak di Kidzania Surabaya PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) bersama KidZania Surabaya menghadirkan “KAI City Tour Tram” sebagai salah satu sumber edukasi yang bermanfaat bagi anak-anak. Adanya “KAI City Tour Tram” dapat menjadi tempat bermain dan juga tempat belajar bagaimana cara menggunakan kendaraan umum kereta api serta menambah pengalaman serta pengetahuan anak terkait profesi yang berhubungan dengan kereta api.
Education About Railways, KAI Presents Travelling By Train Experience for Children at Kidzania Surabaya PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) together with KidZania Surabaya presents “KAI City Tour Tram” as one of the useful educational sources for children. The presence of “KAI City Tour Tram” can be a place to both play and learn how to use public transportation trains as well as increase children’s experience and knowledge related to professions related to trains.
Improve Services, KAI Launches 3 New Trains PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) launched 3 new trains, namely the Papandayan train for the Garut–Gambir (PP) route, the Pangandaran train for the Banjar–Gambir (PP) route, and the Malabar train for morning departures for the Bandung–Malang (PP) route on Wednesday, January 24, 2024.
Success of One Million Trees Movement, KAI Plants Trees and Conducts Station Afforestation Simultaneously in Various Regions PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) also contributed to the success of the One Million Tree Movement Day program by simultaneously planting trees on Wednesday, January 10, 2024, in various work areas covering Operational Areas, Regional Divisions, Railway Workshops, and Subsidiaries. This simultaneous tree planting is also part of KAI’s Social and Environmental Responsibility through the KAI Go Green.
32 Memperkuat Layanan dan Menjamin Keselamatan untuk Wujudkan Keberlanjutan Empowering Services and Ensuring Safety to Cultivate Sustainability PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) | Laporan Tahunan dan Keberlanjutan 2024 Peristiwa Penting Significant Events 26 07 05 08 Senin, 26 Februari 2024 / Monday, February 26, 2024 Kamis, 7 Maret 2024 / Thursday, March 7, 2024 Selasa, 5 Maret 2024 / Tuesday, March 5, 2024 Jumat, 8 Maret 2024 / Friday, March 8, 2024 Peringati Hari Kanker Anak Sedunia, KAI Ajak Anak Pejuang Kanker Bertualang PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) bersama Yayasan Kasih Anak Kanker Indonesia (YKAKI) Cabang Bandung menyelenggarakan acara menarik yang bertajuk “Langkah Kasih Petualangan Kereta Api Bersama YKAKI” di Stasiun Bandung pada Senin (26/2). Acara ini digelar dalam rangka memperingati Hari Kanker Anak Sedunia yang jatuh pada tanggal 15 Februari.
Commemorate World Childhood Cancer Day, KAI Invites Children with Cancer on an Adventure PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) together with the Indonesian Cancer Child Love Foundation (YKAKI) Bandung Branch held an interesting event called “Langkakah Kasih Kereta Adventure with YKAKI” at Bandung Station on Monday (26/2). This event was held to commemorate World Childhood Cancer Day, which falls on February 15.
Pastikan Keandalan Lokomotif, KAI Tanda Tangani Perjanjian Jangka Panjang dengan Perusahaan Manufaktur AS PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) bersama Wabtec Corporation System, LLC (perusahaan manufaktur asal Amerika Serikat) dan PT Imeco Inter Sarana menandatangani kontrak Long Term Parts Agreement (LTPA) atau perjanjian jangka panjang pengadaan suku cadang untuk perawatan lokomotif CC201/CC203/CC204 dan BB203 secara multi years sejak tahun 2025 sampai dengan 2030 Ensure Locomotive Reliability, KAI Signs Long-Term Agreement with US Manufacturing Company PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) together with Wabtec Corporation System, LLC (a manufacturing company from the United States) and PT Imeco Inter Sarana signed a Long-Term Parts Agreement (LTPA) for the procurement of spare parts for the maintenance of CC201/CC203/CC204 and BB203 locomotives on a multi-year basis from 2025 to 2030.
Pergantian Komisaris dan Direksi PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) Perubahan Direksi dan Komisaris PT KAI berdasarkan pada Surat Keputusan Menteri BUMN SK-61/MBU/03/2024 tanggal 5 Maret 2024. Dalam perombakan ini, Elen Setiadi sebagai Komisaris PT KAI. Kemudian mengangkat Dadan Rudiansyah sebagai Direktur Keselamatan dan Keamanan PT KAI serta Rosma Handayani sebagai Direktur SDM dan Umum PT KAI. Selain itu, Kementerian BUMN memberhentikan dengan hormat Riza Primadi sebagai Komisaris Independen KAI, Sandry Pasambuna sebagai Direktur Keselamatan dan Keamanan KAI, dan Suparno sebagai Direktur SDM dan Umum KAI.
Change of Commissioners and Directors of PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) The change of the Directors and Commissioners of PT KAI is based on the Decree of the Minister of SOEs SK-61/MBU/03/2024 dated March 5, 2024. In this reshuffle, Elen Setiadi was appointed as Commissioner of PT KAI. Then Dadan Rudiansyah was appointed as Managing Director of Safety and Security of PT KAI and Rosma Handayani as Managing Director of Human Capital and General Affairs of PT KAI. In addition, the Ministry of State-Owned Enterprises honorably dismissed Riza Primadi as Independent Commissioner of KAI, Sandry Pasambuna as Managing Director of Safety and Security of KAI, and Suparno as Managing Director of Human Capital and General Affairs of KAI.
KAI Raih Penghargaan Best Crisis Handling BUMN dari Menteri BUMN pada BCOMSS 2024 PT Kereta Api Indonesia (KAI) (Persero) memborong penghargaan dalam ajang BUMN Corporate Communication and Sustainability Summit (BCOMSS) 2024 yang digelar Kementerian BUMN. KAI meraih penghargaan kategori ‘Best Crisis Handling BUMN’ dan pemenang kedua ‘Individual Social Media Ranger Activation’ atas nama Nurul Wulandari.
KAI Receives Best Crisis Handling BUMN Award from the Minister of State-Owned Enterprises at BCOMSS 2024 PT Kereta Api Indonesia (KAI) (Persero) received awards at the BUMN Corporate Communication and Sustainability Summit (BCOMSS) 2024 held by the Ministry of State-Owned Enterprises. KAI received the award for the ‘Best Crisis Handling BUMN’ category and the second winner for ‘Individual Social Media Ranger Activation’ on behalf of Nurul Wulandari.
33 Annual and Sustainability Report 2024 | PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) Kilas Kinerja 2024 2024 Performance Highlight Peristiwa Penting Significant Events 14 06 18 09 Kamis, 14 Maret 2024 / Thursday, March 14, 2024 Sabtu, 6 April 2024 / Saturday, April 6, 2024 Senin, 18 Maret 2024 / Monday, March 18, 2024 Selasa, 9 April 2024 / Tuesday, April 9, 2024 KAI Raih Penghargaan Perusahaan BUMN dengan Inovasi Bisnis Perusahaan Terbaik dan Strategi Pertumbuhan Perusahaan Terbaik PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) berhasil mendapatkan penghargaan sebagai Terbaik Pertama Perusahaan BUMN dengan katagori “Inovasi Bisnis Perusahaan Terbaik” dan Terbaik Kedua Perusahaan BUMN dengan kategori ‘Strategi Pertumbuhan Perusahaan Terbaik’ dalam ajang Anugerah BUMN 2024 yang digelar BUMN Track, KAI Wins BUMN Company Award with Best Corporate Business Innovation and Best Corporate Growth Strategy PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) successfully won the award as the First Best BUMN Company with the category of “Best Corporate Business Innovation” and the Second Best BUMN Company with the category of ‘Best Corporate Growth Strategy’ in the 2024 BUMN Awards held by BUMN Track.
Dirut KAI Berikan Apresiasi kepada Pelanggan Kereta Suite Class Compartment dengan Hijab Buttonscarves KAI bekerja sama dengan brand hijab Buttonscarves membagikan hijab gratis bagi penumpang Kereta Suite Class Compartment KA Bima dan KA Argo Semeru serta beberapa KA Luxury keberangkatan 5-9 April 2024.
KAI President Director Gives Appreciation to Suite Class Compartment Train Customers with Buttonscarves Hijab KAI in collaboration with the Buttonscarves hijab brand distributed free hijabs for Suite Class Compartment Train passengers of the Bima and Argo Semeru trains as well as several Luxury trains departing April 5-9, 2024.
Dukung Kemenhub, KAI Berkomitmen Hadirkan Angkutan Lebaran sesuai Slogan “Mudik Ceria, Penuh Makna” PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) menghadirkan Angkutan Lebaran Tahun 2024 sesuai dengan slogan Kementerian Perhubungan slogan “Mudik Ceria, Penuh Makna”.
Support Ministry of Transportation, KAI Commits to Presenting Eid Transportation in Accordance with the “Cheerful Homecoming, Full of Meaning” Slogan PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) presents the 2024 Eid Transportation in accordance with the slogan of the Ministry of Transportation, “Cheerful Homecoming, Full of Meaning”.
Mudik Lebaran, KAI Sukses Antarkan 848 Ribu Penumpang KA Jarak Jauh PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) mencatat telah terdapat 848.344 penumpang KA jarak jauh atau rata-rata 169.668 penumpang per hari pada masa puncak mudik tanggal 5 s.d 9 April 2024. Angka tersebut mencapai 113% dari total tempat duduk yang disediakan sebanyak 750.592 tempat duduk (persentase melebihi 100% merupakan angka okupansi dinamis dimana terdapat penumpang yang turun-naik di stasiun antara stasiun awal dengan stasiun tujuan).
Eid Homecoming, KAI Successfully Transports 848 Thousand Long-Distance Train Passengers PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) noted that there were 848,344 long-distance train passengers or an average of 169,668 passengers per day during the peak homecoming period from April 5 to 9, 2024. This figure reached 113% of the total seats provided of 750,592 seats (the percentage exceeding 100% is the dynamic occupancy figure where there were passengers getting on and off at stations between the starting station and the destination station).
34 Memperkuat Layanan dan Menjamin Keselamatan untuk Wujudkan Keberlanjutan Empowering Services and Ensuring Safety to Cultivate Sustainability PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) | Laporan Tahunan dan Keberlanjutan 2024 Peristiwa Penting Significant Events 13 20 15 22 Sabtu, 13 April 2024 / Saturday, April 13, 2024 Sabtu, 20 April 2024 / Saturday, April 20, 2024 Senin, 15 April 2024 / Monday, April 15, 2024 Senin, 22 April 2024 / Monday, April 23, 2024 Momen Mudik, KAI Luncurkan Film Berjudul “Ruang Tunggu” PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) meluncurkan film berjudul “Ruang Tunggu”. Film pendek garapan rumah produksi PT Visualkan Kreasi Indonesia tersebut mendeskripsikan keterikatan antara masyarakat terhadap moda transportasi kereta api di Indonesia yang begitu mendalam. Film Ruang Tunggu adalah prekuel film pendek berjudul “Pulang” yang diproduksi KAI pada tahun 2023 dan menjadi Film Terbaik pada Festival Film TVRI Jawa Barat.
Homecoming Moment, KAI Launches Film Titled “Ruang Tunggu” PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) launched a film titled “Ruang Tunggu”. The short film produced by the production house PT Visualkan Kreasi Indonesia describes the deep attachment between the community and the train transportation mode in Indonesia. The film Ruang Tunggu is a prequel to the short film titled “Pulang” produced by KAI in 2023 and became the Best Film at the West Java TVRI Film Festival.
KAI Gelar Rekrutmen Program Management Trainee Tahun 2024, Pendaftaran Dibuka Hingga 22 April 2024 PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) bekerja sama dengan PT Dayalima Recruitment saat ini sedang membuka rekrutmen untuk program Management Trainee Tahun 2024. Pendaftaran mulai 17-22 April 2024.
KAI Holds Recruitment for Management Trainee Program in 2024, Registration Open Until April 22, 2024 PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) in collaboration with PT Dayalima Recruitment is currently opening recruitment for the Management Trainee program in 2024. Registration starts from April 17-22, 2024.
KAI Gelar Promo “Mudik Belakangan Ekstra Hemat”, Naik KA Cuma Bayar 80% PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) menyediakan promo Mudik Belakangan Ekstra Hemat, di mana pelanggan dapat membeli tiket mudik dari Stasiun Gambir dan Pasarsenen ke sejumlah daerah dengan cukup membayar dengan tarif 80% saja.
KAI Holds “Mudik Belakangan Ekstra Hemat” Promo, Take the Train and Only Pay 80% PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) provides a Mudik Belakangan Ekstra Hemat (Travel Back to Hometown Later for Extra Savings) promo, where customers can buy homecoming tickets from Gambir and Pasarsenen Stations to a number of areas by only paying 80% of the fare.
KAI Gelar Promo Bursa Pariwisata, Dapatkan Tiket Kereta dengan Diskon 20% PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) menyediakan promo Bursa Pariwisata, dimana pelanggan dapat membeli tiket kereta api dari Surabaya dan Malang ke sejumlah daerah dengan potongan harga tiket 20%. KAI Holds Tourism Exchange Promo, Get Train Tickets with 20% Discount PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) provides a Tourism Exchange promo, where customers can buy train tickets from Surabaya and Malang to several areas with a 20% discount on tickets.

37 Annual and Sustainability Report 2024 | PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) Kilas Kinerja 2024 2024 Performance Highlight Peristiwa Penting Significant Events 23 12 08 15 Selasa, 23 Juli 2024 / Tuesday, July 23, 2024 Senin, 12 Agustus 2024 / Monday, August 12, 2024 Kamis, 8 Agustus 2024 / Thursday, August 8, 2024 Kamis, 15 Agustus 2024 / Thursday, August 15, 2024 KAI Dukung Program Kementerian ESDM Uji Coba Penerapaan B40 untuk Kereta Api PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) mendukung Kementerian Energi dan Sumber Daya Mineral (ESDM) dalam uji coba penerapaan B40 untuk kereta api. Uji coba ini dilakukan di Stasiun Lempuyangan, Yogyakarta pada Senin (22/7) dengan menggunakan KA Bogowonto relasi Lempuyangan - Pasar Senen. B40, campuran solar 60% dan bahan bakar nabati dari kelapa sawit 40%, diharapkan menjadi solusi strategis untuk mengurangi konsumsi solar dan emisi gas buang. KAI kini menggunakan 300 juta liter bahan bakar B35.
KAI Supports Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources Program to Trial Implementation of B40 for Trains PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) supports the Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources (ESDM) in the trial implementation of B40 for trains, conducted at Lempuyangan Station, Yogyakarta on Monday (22/7) using the Bogowonto train on the Lempuyangan–Pasar Senen route. B40, a mixture of 60% diesel and 40% palm oil biofuel, is expected to be a strategic solution to reduce diesel consumption and exhaust emissions. KAI is currently using 300 million liters of B35 fuel.
Jelang HUT RI Ke-79, Masinis Indonesia Telah Berhasil Operasikan Woosh dengan Kecepatan 350 Km/Jam PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) mengapresiasi keberhasilan masinis Whoosh asal Indonesia yang kini telah berhasil mengoperasikan Kereta Cepat Whoosh dengan kecepatan 350 km/jam. As many as 39 of the 72 Indonesian train drivers seconded by KAI have entered stage 2 of the on-the-job training process.

Salah satu langkah nyata yang telah dilakukan adalah penggantian komponen prasarana kereta api khususnya pada kontruksi rel di jembatan baja yang sebelumnya menggunakan bantalan dari bahan kayu menjadi bahan sintetis.

Penandatanganan Kontrak IMO, KAI Perkuat Komitmen dalam Menjaga Keandalan Prasarana Kereta Api KAI telah melaksanakan Penandatanganan Kontrak Kegiatan Perawatan Berkala dan Pengoperasian Prasarana Perkeretaapian Milik Negara (Infrastructure Maintenance and Operation/IMO) dengan Balai Teknik Perkeretaapian Kelas I Jakarta, bertempat di Ruang Rapat Lt. 14 Gedung Karya, Kementerian Perhubungan Republik Indonesia pada Jumat (8/11).

KAI Berhasil Meraih Piala Silver dari Ajang Contact Center Asia Pacific Awards 2024 KAI berhasil meraih piala silver untuk kategori Customer Experience. Dalam ajang Contact Center Asia Pacific (CC APAC) Awards 2024 yang diikuti berbagai negara pada tanggal 23 - 25 Oktober 2024 yang lalu di Singapura. Penghargaan ini melengkapi kesuksesan KAI sebelumnya dalam ajang The Best Contact Center Indonesia (TBCCI) 2024, di mana KAI mendapat gelar juara #5th runner up dengan perolehan 24 medali (8 Platinum, 8 Gold, 6 Silver, dan 2 Bronze) melalui layanan Contact Center 121 (CC121) di tingkat nasional. Berbekal prestasi ini, KAI mendapat kesempatan untuk mewakili Indonesia di tingkat regional Asia Pasifik dan menampilkan inovasi pelayanan pelanggan di ajang CC APAC 2024. KAI berhasil meraih pencapaian tertinggi di antara kontingen yang mewakili Indonesia pada ajang CC APAC 2024. KAI Successfully Wins Silver Cup from Contact Center Asia Pacific Awards 2024 KAI successfully won the silver trophy for the Customer Experience category. In the Contact Center Asia Pacific (CC APAC) Awards 2024 event which was attended by various countries on October 23-25, 2024 in Singapore. This award complements KAI’s previous success in The Best Contact Center Indonesia (TBCCI) 2024 event, where KAI won the #5th runner up title with 24 medals (8 Platinum, 8 Gold, 6 Silver, and 2 Bronze) through the Contact Center 121 (CC121) service at the national level. Armed with this achievement, KAI had the opportunity to represent Indonesia at the Asia Pacific regional level and showcase customer service innovations at the CC APAC 2024 event. KAI successfully obtained the highest achievement among the contingents representing Indonesia at the CC APAC 2024 event.

42 Memperkuat Layanan dan Menjamin Keselamatan untuk Wujudkan Keberlanjutan Empowering Services and Ensuring Safety to Cultivate Sustainability PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) | Laporan Tahunan dan Keberlanjutan 2024 Peristiwa Penting Significant Events 13 22 15 22 Rabu, 13 November 2024 / Wednesday, November 13, 2024 Jumat, 22 November 2024 / Friday, November 22, 2024 Jumat, 15 November 2024 / Friday, November 15, 2024 Jumat, 22 November 2024 / Friday, November 22, 2024 LRT Jabodebek Terapkan Sistem Cuci Kereta Otomatis dengan Teknologi Canggih dan Ramah Lingkungan Sejak mulai beroperasi, LRT Jabodebek mengandalkan fasilitas Automatic Train Wash Plant (ATWP), sebuah sistem pencucian kereta otomatis berteknologi tinggi yang tidak hanya cepat dan efisien, tetapi juga ramah lingkungan.ATWP ini beroperasi pada satu jalur khusus di Depo LRT Jabodebek, di mana setiap rangkaian kereta dapat dicuci secara otomatis dengan akurasi dan efisiensi tinggi. Sistem ini dilengkapi sensor kecepatan yang otomatis memulai proses pencucian saat kereta mendekati area dengan kecepatan di bawah 5 km/jam.
Jabodebek LRT Implements Automatic Train Washing System with Advanced and Environmentally Friendly Technology Since it began operating, Jabodebek LRT has relied on the Automatic Train Wash Plant (ATWP) facility, a high-tech automatic train washing system that is not only fast and efficient, but also environmentally friendly. The ATWP operates on a special track at the Jabodebek LRT Depot, where each train set can be washed automatically with high accuracy and efficiency. This system is equipped with a speed sensor that automatically starts the washing process when the train approaches an area at a speed below 5 km/h.

44 Memperkuat Layanan dan Menjamin Keselamatan untuk Wujudkan Keberlanjutan Empowering Services and Ensuring Safety to Cultivate Sustainability PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) | Laporan Tahunan dan Keberlanjutan 2024 Peristiwa Penting Significant Events 04 09 06 09 Rabu, 4 Desember 2024 / Wednesday, December 4, 2024 Senin, 9 Desember 2024 / Monday, December 9, 2024 Jumat, 6 Desember 2024 / Friday, December 6, 2024 Senin, 9 Desember 2024 / Monday, December 9, 2024 Perjanjian Strategis KAI-BI, Wujudkan Distribusi Barang Berharga Milik Negara (BBMN) yang Aman dan Ramah Lingkungan PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) dan Bank Indonesia (BI) resmi menandatangani Perjanjian Jasa Pengangkutan Barang Milik Negara (BBMN) di Ballroom Jakarta Railway Center pada Rabu (4/12). KAI-BI Strategic Agreement, Realize Safe and Environmentally Friendly Distribution of State-Owned Valuable Goods (BBMN) PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) and Bank Indonesia (BI) officially signed the State-Owned Goods (BBMN) Transportation Service Agreement at the Jakarta Railway Center Ballroom on Wednesday (12/4). 45 Annual and Sustainability Report 2024 | PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) Kilas Kinerja 2024 2024 Performance Highlight Peristiwa Penting Significant Events 18 21 21 Rabu, 18 Desember 2024 / Wednesday, December 18, 2024 Sabtu, 21 Desember 2024 / Saturday, December 21, 2024 Sabtu, 21 Desember 2024 / Saturday, December 21, 2024 KAI Kembali Raih Predikat Badan Publik Informatif KAI kembali menunjukkan komitmennya dalam menerapkan keterbukaan informasi publik dengan meraih predikat Badan Publik Informatif untuk kategori BUMN pada Anugerah Keterbukaan Informasi Publik 2024. KAI Wins Informative Public Agency Title Once Again KAI has once again demonstrated its commitment to implementing public information transparency by winning the Informative Public Agency title for the BUMN category at the Public Information Transparency Award 2024, given by the Indonesian Central Information Commission at an event held at the Mövenpick Hotel, Jakarta, Tuesday (12/17). Upaya Peningkatan Keselamatan, KAI Kembangkan Inovasi Track-Mod dan Smart Rail KAI Luncurkan Track-Mod dan Smart Rail untuk Tingkatkan Keselamatan Prasarana Kereta Api PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) melalui Direktorat Keselamatan dan Keamanan resmi meluncurkan dua inovasi terbaru dalam pemeliharaan prasarana kereta api, Track-Mod dan Smart Rail. Track-Mod adalah alat ukur geometri jalur yang mampu mengumpulkan data secara real-time dengan validitas tinggi dalam pemeriksaan. Alat ini dirancang khusus untuk memantau dan mengukur parameter geometri jalur kereta api 1.067 mm dengan presisi tinggi. Smart Rail hadir sebagai alat ukur portabel yang dirancang untuk mengukur kondisi jalan rel kereta api berdasarkan parameter goyangan keras. Smart Rail menggunakan sensor pengukuran deteksi tiga sumbu yang terintegrasi dengan aplikasi smartphone Android, sehingga memberikan data yang lebih objektif dan efisien dalam pemeliharaan serta deteksi anomali.
Safety Improvement Efforts, KAI Develops Track-Mod and Smart Rail Innovations KAI Launches Track-Mod and Smart Rail to Improve Railway Infrastructure Safety PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) through the Directorate of Safety and Security officially launched two of the latest innovations in railway infrastructure maintenance, Track-Mod and Smart Rail. Track-Mod is a track geometry measuring tool that is capable of collecting data in real-time with high validity in inspections. This tool is specifically designed to monitor and measure 1,067 mm railway track geometry parameters with high precision. Smart Rail is present as a portable measuring tool designed to measure railway track conditions based on hard shaking parameters. Smart Rail uses a three-axis detection measurement sensor integrated with an Android smartphone application, thus providing more objective and efficient data in maintenance and anomaly detection.
KAI Terapkan Kebijakan Kereta Khusus Wanita di LRT Jabodebek Sepanjang Jam Operasional pada Hari Kerja PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) mengambil langkah untuk menyesuaikan kebijakan ini. Mulai tanggal 23 Desember 2024, kereta khusus wanita akan berlaku sepanjang jam operasional LRT Jabodebek pada hari kerja (Senin hingga Jumat, kecuali hari libur nasional). Adapun hari Sabtu, Minggu, dan hari libur nasional, rangkaian kereta akan beroperasi secara normal tanpa pembagian khusus. Langkah ini diambil untuk semakin meningkatkan kenyamanan dan keamanan pengguna wanita dalam menggunakan transportasi umum.
KAI Implements Women-Only Train Policy on Jabodebek LRT Throughout Operational Hours on Weekdays PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) is taking steps to adjust this policy. Starting December 23, 2024, women-only trains will apply throughout the Jabodebek LRT’s operational hours on weekdays (Monday to Friday, except national holidays). As for Saturdays, Sundays, and national holidays, the trains will operate normally without special divisions. This step was taken to further improve the comfort and safety of female users in using public transportation.

47 Annual and Sustainability Report 2024 | PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) Kilas Kinerja 2024 2024 Performance Highlight Laporan Manajemen Management Report Laporan Direksi Board of Directors’ Report Para Pemegang Saham dan Pemangku Kepentingan yang terhormat, Our Esteemed Shareholders and Stakeholders, Puji syukur ke hadirat Tuhan Yang Maha Esa, atas rahmat dan karunia-Nya, di tahun 2024 KAI berhasil mencatatkan pencapaian kinerja yang membanggakan. Analisis Makro Ekonomi 2024 2024 Macroeconomic Analysis Kondisi perekonomian global masih diambang ketidakpastian. Perlambatan pertumbuhan ekonomi di negara-negara maju hanya mampu tumbuh sebesar 1,8% pada tahun 2024. Kondisi ini juga diperburuk dengan kondisi pasar negara berkembang yang juga stagnan di angka 4,2%. Menurut International Monetary Fund (IMF) dalam laporan World Economic Outlook (WEO), di tahun 2024 pertumbuhan ekonomi global hanya mencapai 3,2%, atau tumbuh 0,1% dari tahun sebelumnya sebesar 3,1%.
We express our praise and gratitude to Almighty God, for His blessings enabled KAI to record an exceptional performance achievement in 2024. The efforts and innovations carried out have successfully brought various awards for KAI, making KAI always at the forefront, superior, and innovative.
Allow us to disclose the performance of the Board of Directors in 2024 through this report, which is a form of accountability to all shareholders and stakeholders, as well as contains the Company’s performance, the Company’s strategic strategies and policies, business prospects, challenges faced, and KAI’s involvement in the industry.
The global economic condition is still on the verge of uncertainty. The slowdown in economic growth in developed countries was only able to grow by 1.8% in 2024, which was also exacerbated by the condition of emerging markets stagnating at 4.2%. According to the International Monetary Fund (IMF) in the World Economic Outlook (WEO) report, global economic growth only reached 3.2% in 2024, or an increase of 0.1% from the previous year of 3.1%.
50 PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) | Laporan Tahunan dan Keberlanjutan 2024 Memperkuat Layanan dan Menjamin Keselamatan untuk Wujudkan Keberlanjutan Empowering Services and Ensuring Safety to Cultivate Sustainability Laporan Direksi Board of Directors’ Report DIDIEK HARTANTYO Direktur Utama President Director 51 Annual and Sustainability Report 2024 | PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) Laporan Manajemen Management Report Pelemahan ekonomi yang terjadi dipengaruhi oleh ketidakstabilan politik di beberapa negara Eropa dan berdampak hingga ke Asia. Hal ini mengakibatkan terjadinya ketidakseimbangan pada pasar global dan menambah kompleksitas terkait kebijakan fiskal dan moneter di beberapa negara. Selain itu, ketegangan geopolitik yang terjadi di kawasan Timur Tengah juga menjadi faktor pelemahan pada perekonomian global.
Meskipun perekonomian global masih dalam fase melemah, namun tidak demikian untuk perekonomian nasional yang mampu bertahan dengan stabil. Kami bersyukur bahwa perekonomian Indonesia berhasil tumbuh stabil dan solid sebesar 5,03% di tahun 2024. Menurut Kementerian Keuangan Republik Indonesia, pertumbuhan ini didorong oleh peningkatan sektor investasi dan manufaktur, serta permintaan dalam negeri yang membaik. Selain itu, Kementerian Koordinator Bidang Perekonomian Republik Indonesia melaporkan bahwa pemerintah bersama Bank Indonesia mampu berhasil menekan laju inflasi dan nilai tukar yang mencapai target inflasi sebesar 1,57% (YoY) dengan BI Rate 6,00%. Keberhasilan ini adalah hasil baik dari penerapan kebijakan yang konsisten, serta sinergi yang efektif dari tingkat pusat hingga daerah.
Lebih lanjut, berdasarkan data Badan Pusat Statistik (BPS) mencatat bahwa Produk Domestik Bruto (PDB) Indonesia mencapai Rp22.139,0 triliun dengan PDB per kapita mencapai Rp78,6 juta atau USD4.960,3 di tahun 2024. Kondisi ekonomi yang stabil dihasilkan dari kontribusi lapangan usaha yang terjaga.Dalam hal produksi, sektor yang memberikan kontribusi terbesar adalah Lapangan Usaha Jasa lainnya yang mencapai 9,80%. Sementara itu, dari perspektif pengeluaran, kontribusi tertinggi berasal dari Pengeluaran Konsumsi Lembaga Nonprofit yang Melayani Rumah Tangga (PK-LNPRT), yang mencapai 12,48%. Sedangkan sektor transportasi dan pergudangan yang merupakan sektor industri bisnis Perusahaan, menyumbang sebesar 8,69% terhadap PDB yang tercatat. Secara spasial, kontribusi Produk Domestik Regional Bruto (PDRB), Pulau Jawa mencatatkan kontribusi terbesar sebesar 57,02% dengan tingkat pertumbuhan mencapai 4,92%. Pulau Sumatera dengan kontribusi sebesar 22,12% dengan tingkat pertumbuhan mencapai 4,45%, Pulau Kalimantan dengan kontribusi sebesar 8,24% dengan tingkat pertumbuhan mencapai 5,52%, Pulau Sulawesi dengan kontribusi sebesar The occurring economic downturn was influenced by political instability in several European countries and had an impact on Asia, resulting in an imbalance in the global market and added complexity related to fiscal and monetary policies in several countries. In addition, geopolitical tensions in the Middle East region were a factor in the weakening of the global economy.
Although the global economy is still in a weakening phase, this is not the case for the national economy which has been able to survive stably. We are grateful that the Indonesian economy has managed to grow steadily and solidly by 5.03% in 2024. According to the Ministry of Finance of the Republic of Indonesia, this growth was driven by an increase in the investment and manufacturing sectors, as well as improving domestic demand. In addition, the Coordinating Ministry for Economic Affairs of the Republic of Indonesia reported that the government together with Bank Indonesia managed to successfully suppress both the inflation and the exchange rates which reached the inflation target of 1.57% (YoY) with a BI Rate of 6.00%. This success is a good result of consistent policy implementation, as well as effective synergy from the central to regional levels.
Furthermore, based on data from Statistics Indonesia (BPS), Indonesia’s Gross Domestic Product (GDP) reached Rp22,139.0 trillion with GDP per capita reaching Rp78.6 million or USD4,960.3 in 2024. The maintained business sector contributed to stable economic conditions. In terms of production, the sector providing the largest contribution was the Other Service Business Field which reached 9.80%. Meanwhile, from an expenditure perspective, the highest contribution originated from the Consumption Expenditure of Non-Profit Institutions Serving Households (PK-LNPRT), which reached 12.48%. On the other hand, the Company’s business industry sector, transportation and warehousing, contributed 8.69% to the recorded GDP.

Analisis Atas Kinerja Perusahaan Analysis of Company Performance KINERJA KEUANGAN Di tahun 2024, KAI berhasil mencatatkan pencapaian yang membanggakan dari berbagai aspek. KAI mencatatkan realisasi pendapatan sejumlah Rp36,11 triliun, mengalami peningkatan sebesar 29% dari tahun 2023 sejumlah Rp35,11 triliun. Peningkatan pendapatan diperoleh dari pendapatan angkutan dan usaha lainnya sebesar 29,40%. Pendapatan tahun 2024 berasal dari pendapatan angkutan penumpang terealisasi sebesar Rp11,92 triliun atau 109,2% terhadap anggaran sebesar Rp10,91 triliun dan pendapatan angkutan barang terealisasi sebesar Rp12,80 triliun atau 98,4% terhadap anggarannya sebesar Rp13,01 triliun. Lebih lanjut, Perusahaan mencatatkan laba usaha sejumlah Rp7,60 triliun, mengalami peningkatan sebesar 96,89% jika dibandingkan dari tahun sebelumnya sebesar Rp3,86 triliun. Dengan demikian, Perusahaan mencatatkan laba tahun berjalan sejumlah Rp2,22 triliun, meningkat sebesar 18,76% jika dibandingkan dengan tahun sebelumnya sejumlah Rp1,87 triliun. Perubahan ini disebabkan oleh meningkatnya pendapatan Perusahaan di tahun 2024.
From Statistics Indonesia (BPS), information on the Number of Railway Passengers for the last 3 (three) years is as follows: Number of Railway Passengers (in thousands of people) FINANCIAL PERFORMANCE KAI managed to record commendable achievements from various aspects in 2024. KAI recorded revenues realization of Rp36.11 trillion, an increase of 29% from 2023 of Rp35.11 trillion. The increase was obtained from transportation and other operating revenues of 29.40%. Revenue in 2024 came from passenger transportation revenue realized of Rp11.92 trillion or 109.2% of the budget of Rp10.91 trillion and freight transportation revenue realized of Rp12.80 trillion or 98.4% of its budget of Rp13.01 trillion. Furthermore, the Company recorded an operating profit of Rp7.60 trillion, an increase of 96.89% compared to the previous year of Rp3.86 trillion. Thus, the Company recorded a income for the year of Rp2.22 trillion, an increase of 18.76% compared to the previous year of Rp1.87 trillion. This change was due to the increase in the Company's revenue in 2024.

KINERJA PELAYANAN DAN KESELAMATAN 1. Waktu Peredaran Gerbong (WPG) Realisasi waktu peredaran gerbong rata-rata 1,44 hari atau 71,8% terhadap toleransi yaitu 2,01 hari. Fakta di bawah toleransi menandakan kinerja operasi baik hal ini dikarenakan terpenuhinya gerbong SO untuk memenuhi stamformasi KA barang atas permintaan customer, berkurangnya kelambatan KA barang, serta memaksimalkan penggunaan gerbong SO, dan program WPG 2024.
2. Lokomotif Mogok Realisasi frekuensi lokomotif mogok tahun 2024 terdapat 218 kejadian atau 42,8% terhadap normal kendalinya (toleransi) sebanyak 509 kejadian. Realisasi lokomotif mogok di bawah toleransi. Kategori gangguan yang terjadi pada lokomotif selama tahun 2024 yaitu sistem kontrol listrik (L) 74 kali, motor diesel (MD) 61 kali, traksi motor (TM) 31 kali, sistem udara tekan (SUT) 18 kali, main generator (MG) 14 kali, Governoor (GOV) sebanyak 9 kali, mekanik bawah (MB) 7 kali, dan mekanik atas (MA) 4 kali. Fakta di bawah toleransi menunjukkan kinerja yang lebih baik, disebabkan karena peningkatan frekuensi perawatan 2. Freight Transport In 2024, the freight transport displayed good growth. KAI has succeeded in providing efficiency in terms of necessary incurred costs, increasing public interest in using freight transport services. In addition, the capacity of carriages owned can transport around 50 tons of goods or the equivalent of 2 container trucks. This transport capacity is also another factor deemed important due to the large capacity required in freight transport.
Throughout 2024, the realization of freight transportation revenue was Rp12.80 trillion or 98.4% of the budget of Rp13.01 trillion and the volume of goods reached 69,201,670 tons or 101.3% of the budget of 68,319,148 tons.
SERVICE AND SAFETY PERFORMANCE 1. Wagon Turnaround Time (WTT) The average wagon turnaround time realization was 1.44 days or 71.8% against the tolerance of 2.01 days. The fact that it was below tolerance indicates good operational performance due to the availability of SO wagons to meet freight train formation requests from customers, reduced freight train delays, maximized utilization of SO wagons, and implementation of the 2024 WTT program.
2. Locomotive Breakdowns In 2024, there were 218 locomotive breakdown incidents or 42.8% against the control limit (tolerance) of 509 incidents. The breakdown occurrences were below tolerance. The categories of locomotive failures during 2024 were: electrical control system (L) 74 times, diesel engine (MD) 61 times, traction motor (TM) 31 times, compressed air system (SUT) 18 times, main generator (MG) 14 times, governor (GOV) 9 times, undercarriage mechanical (MB) 7 times, and superstructure mechanical (MA) 4 times. The below-tolerance performance shows improved results, caused by increased frequency of 58 PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) | Laporan Tahunan dan Keberlanjutan 2024 Memperkuat Layanan dan Menjamin Keselamatan untuk Wujudkan Keberlanjutan Empowering Services and Ensuring Safety to Cultivate Sustainability lokomotif yang dilakukan secara berkala dan optimalserta adanya kontrak kerjasama spare part perawatan sarana dengan pabrikan.

Train Accidents During 2024, there were 5 train accident incidents consisting of: Daop 1 Jakarta 1 incident, Daop 2 Bandung 2 incidents, Daop 8 Surabaya 1 incident, and Divre I North Sumatra 1 incident. Management continuously evaluates the causes of these accidents and ensures they do not recur through coordination with external parties, ensuring the safety culture is understood and implemented by all KAI personnel, and implementing railway safety management systems.
Average Train Delays a) Passenger Trains Departing passenger trains were delayed by 0.09 minutes against the tolerance of 0.30 minutes, and arriving passenger trains were 3.54 minutes early against the delay tolerance of 2.00 minutes. The realization of passenger train departure and arrival delays was below tolerance (target achieved), due to improved infrastructure quality, timetable changes (Gapeka) effective June 1, 2023, and low operational disruptions.
b) Freight Trains Departing freight trains were on average 76.37 minutes early against the delay tolerance of 5.00 minutes, and arriving freight trains were 75.41 minutes early against the delay tolerance of 10.00 minutes. The realization of freight train departure and arrival delays was below tolerance. This was due to coordination and supervision of loading/ unloading SOPs between operations and Commercial units to reduce delays caused by loading/unloading wait times, as well as tactical management of train overtaking/ crossing.
Average Train Punctuality a) Passenger Trains The realization of departing passenger train punctuality was 99.77% against the target of 99.09%, and the realization of arriving passenger train punctuality was 96.05% against the punctuality tolerance of 92.00%. The percentage realization of departing and arriving passenger train punctuality was above tolerance. This was due to several improvements in monitoring on-time departure and arrival programs as well as reduced rolling stock and infrastructure disruptions.

Peran Direksi dalam Perumusan Strategi dan Kebijakan Strategis Perusahaan The Role of the Board of Directors In Formulation of the Company’s Strategic Strategies and Policies Direksi berperan penting dalam proses perumusan strategi dan kebijakan strategis Perseroan. Perumusan strategi dan kebijakan strategis Perseroan disusun setiap tahunnya, berdasarkan arahan Dewan Komisaris dan Pemegang Saham. Direksi merumukan strategi dan kebijakan strategi yang dituangkan dalam Rencana Jangka Panjang Perusahaan (RJPP). RJPP disusun sebagai pedoman dalam menjalankan kegiatan operasional secara terarah dan berkesinambungan, guna mencapai visi dan misi Perseroan. RJPP juga menjadi acuan utama bagi Direksi dalam menetapkan langkah-langkah strategis agar seluruh aktivitas operasional mendukung pencapaian tujuan jangka panjang perusahaan. Pada tahun 2024, Perseroan telah memiliki 4 (empat) strategi yang telah dijalankan yaitu strategi ESG (Environmental, Social and Governance), strategi manajemen risiko, strategi transformasi digital dan strategi pertumbuhan. Adapun keempat strategi tersebut telah sejalan dengan tujuan strategis yang tercantum dalam RJPP 2020-2024. KAI telah menetapkan tujuan strategis utama yang tercantum dalam RJPP, di antaranya meningkatkan pangsa pasar, meningkatkan nilai manfaat uang, transformasi kualitas layanan dan keamanan, mewujudkan keberlanjutan finansial serta tercapainya sinergi (termasuk sinergi antar BUMN). Direksi memastikan bahwa program yang dijalankan sepanjang tahun 2024 berjalan sesuai dengan strategi dan kebijakan strategis yang telah ditetapkan. Direksi bertanggung jawab dalam mengomunikasikan strategi yang telah dirumuskan kepada seluruh jajaran manajemen dan memastikan implementasinya secara konsisten di seluruh lini operasional. Selain itu, untuk melakukan perencanaan strategis dan kebijakan strategis, Direksi juga melakukan pengawasan dan evaluasi atas pelaksanaan investasi yang telah ditetapkan dalam RJPP. Direksi memantau pelaksanaan kebijakan strategis melalui evaluasi kinerja secara berkala, serta melakukan penyesuaian strategi bila diperlukan guna menjaga relevansi dan ketahanan perusahaan dalam menghadapi the daily experience of millions of passengers who use KAI services as their access to mobilization.
The Board of Directors plays a crucial role in the formulation process of the Company’s strategic strategies and policies. The formulation of the Company’s strategic strategies and policies is prepared annually, based on the direction of the Board of Commissioners and Shareholders. The Board of Directors formulates strategic strategies and policies outlined in the Company’s Long-Term Plan (RJPP).
The RJPP is prepared as a guideline for conducting operational activities in a focused and sustainable manner, in order to achieve the Company’s vision and mission. The RJPP is also the main reference for the Board of Directors in determining strategic steps so that all operational activities support the achievement of the Company’s long-term goals.
In 2024, the Company has 4 (four) strategies that have been implemented, namely the ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance) strategy, risk management strategy, digital transformation strategy, and growth strategy. The four strategies are in line with the strategic objectives stated in the 2020-2024 RJPP. KAI has set the main strategic objectives listed in the RJPP, including increasing market share, increasing the value of money, transforming service quality and safety, realizing financial sustainability, and achieving synergy (including synergy between SOEs).
The Board of Directors ensures that the programs implemented throughout 2024 are in accordance with the strategic strategies and policies that have been set. The Board of Directors is responsible for communicating the formulated strategies to all management levels and ensuring their consistent implementation across all operational lines.
In addition, the Board of Directors supervises and evaluates the investment implementation set in the RJPP to carry out strategic planning and strategic policies. The Board of Directors monitors the implementation of strategic policies through periodic performance evaluations and makes strategic adjustments if deemed necessary to maintain the Company’s relevance and resilience in facing changing 63 Annual and Sustainability Report 2024 | PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) Laporan Manajemen Management Report dinamika bisnis yang terus berubah. Pengawasan dan evaluasi dilakukan melalui diskusi intensif yang dilakukan baik pada rapat internal maupun rapat gabungan bersama Dewan Komisaris. Upaya Direksi Untuk Memastikan Implementasi Strategi Berjalan dengan Optimal Board of Directors’ Efforts to Ensure Optimal Strategy Implementation Dalam menjalankan perannya, Direksi memiliki tanggung jawab untuk memastikan strategi yang telah dibuat berjalan dengan optimal. Oleh karna itu, Direksi melakukan pengawasan terhadap pelaksanaan program strategis. Direksi secara aktif melakukan rapat koordinasi secara berkala dengan manajemen untuk memastikan strategi dan kebijakan strategis dijalankan dengan baik oleh seluruh unit bisnis. Beberapa upaya yang dilakukan Direksi untuk memastikan implementasi strategi berjalan optimal di antaranya dengan memastikan proyek-proyek strategis dilaksanakan sesuai jadwalnya, memberikan dukungan dan arahan kepada pelaksanaan investasi, melakukan update guna mendukung mitigasi risiko dan tindaklanjutnya, serta menetapkan realisasi pelaksanaan investasi dalam KPI. Pada layanan angkutan barang, KAI mengambil langkah strategi dengan meningkatkan penggunaan teknologi dan sistem informasi dengan lebih optimal. Melalui pemanfaatan teknologi yang lebih andal, diharapkan dapat berdampak baik terhadap operasional. Sehingga akan menghasilkan kapasitas angkutan barang yang lebih efisien dengan keandalan layanan yang terbaik, serta mampu mengurangi kemacetan di jalur-jalur padat. Pada tahun 2024, Perseroan menggunakan sistem angkutan barang berbasis digital (Rail Cargo Access), peningkatan frekuensi KA yang semula 14 KA menjadi 16 KA, hingga penambahan hari operasi pada beberapa mitra.
Pada layanan angkutan penumpang, Perseroan melakukan berbagai strategi untuk meningkatkan kinerja angkutan penumpang dan meningkatkan daya saing di antara moda transportasi lainnya seperti pesawat maupun bus antar kota. KAI melakukan peningkatan layanan guna meningkatkan kepuasan pelanggan seperti inovasi Face Recognition Boarding Gate, pengembangan aplikasi Access by KAI, pengadaan KA Luxury, penerapan marketing automation, serta peremajaan sarana 612 kereta. Selain itu di tahun 2024 KAI juga meningkatkan promosi baik secara online maupun offline untuk menarik minat pelanggan. business dynamics. Supervision and evaluation are executed through intensive discussions held both at internal meetings and joint meetings with the Board of Commissioners.
In carrying out its role, the Board of Directors is responsible for ensuring that the constructed strategies are performed optimally. Therefore, the Board of Directors supervises the implementation of strategic programs. The Board of Directors actively holds regular coordination meetings with management to ensure that strategic strategies and policies are implemented properly by all business units.
Some of the efforts made by the Board of Directors to ensure optimal strategy implementation include ensuring that strategic projects are implemented according to schedule, providing support and direction for investment implementation, conducting updates to support risk mitigation and follow-up, and determining the realization of investment implementation in KPIs.
In freight transport services, KAI takes strategic steps by increasing the use of technology and information systems more optimally. The use of more reliable technology is expected to have a positive impact on operations. Thus, it may produce a more efficient freight transport capacity with the best service reliability, and be able to reduce congestion on busy routes. In 2024, the Company utilized a digital-based freight transport system (Rail Cargo Access), increasing the frequency of trains from 14 trains to 16 trains, and adding operating days to several partners.
The Company implements various strategies in passenger transport services to improve passenger transport performance and increase competitiveness among other modes of transportation such as airplanes and intercity buses. KAI is improving services to increase customer satisfaction such as the Face Recognition Boarding Gate innovation, developing the Access by KAI application, procuring Luxury Trains, implementing marketing automation, and rejuvenating 612 train facilities. Additionally, KAI increased online and offline promotions in 2024 to attract customer interest.
