In alignment with the Company’s objectives, KAI’s operations are focused on the transportation sector while optimizing the use of its resources to deliver high-quality, competitive goods and/or services to achieve profitability and enhance the Company’s value, adhering to the principles of a Limited Company.
PRODUCTS AND SERVICES [OJK C.4] [GRI 2-6] The Company is a state-owned enterprise that provides, regulates, and manages railway transportation services across Indonesia. In response to evolving business dynamics and market trends, the Company also engages in additional supportive business activities to optimize its resource utilization.
KAI’s operations are categorized into several business segments, each serving as a source of income for the Company. These segments include passenger transportation, freight transportation, railway support services, non-transportation income, and government subsidies encompassing PSO, IMO, and Pioneer.
• PASSENGER TRAIN TRANSPORTATION As a railway operator in Indonesia, KAI manages an extensive range of passenger trains, including both Main Trains (Commercial and Non-Commercial) and local services across Java and Sumatra. The operation of passenger train services is not only carried out by KAI as the parent company but also by its subsidiaries, namely PT Kereta Commuter Indonesia, PT Railink, and PT Kereta Api Pariwisata. PT Kereta Commuter Indonesia (KAI Commuter), commonly known as KAI Commuter, is a subsidiary of KAI entrusted with managing the KRL Commuter Line in Jakarta, Bogor, Depok, Tangerang, and Bekasi (Jabodetabek). Since October 1, 2020, KAI has assigned KAI Commuter to operate local trains in the Jakarta Area Operation District (Daop 1 Jakarta).
111 Annual and Sustainability Report 2024 | PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) Profil Perusahaan Company Profile Seiring berlakunya Grafik Perjalanan Kereta Api (Gapeka) Tahun 2021 per 1 Maret 2021, KAI Commuter mengoperasikan KRL di luar wilayah Jabodetabek yaitu KRL relasi Yogyakarta - Solo Balapan (PP) menggantikan KA Prambanan Ekspres yang saat ini hanya melayani Yogyakarta - Kutoarjo (PP). Ekspansi KAI Commuter tidak berhenti di 2 wilayah tersebut, pada April 2022, KA Lokal di Wilayah 2 Bandung dan Wilayah 8 Surabaya dengan izin operasi di November semakin memperluas wilayah operasi KAI Commuter. Di akhir tahun 2022 KAI Commuter diberikan tugas untuk mengoperasikan Kereta Bandara. Setelah Switch Over (SO) 5 Manggarai pada 2022, pola operasi di Wilayah Jabodetabek mengalami perubahan. Perjalanan pada lintas Bogor/Nambo/Depok hanya ke Jakarta Kota, sedangkan lintas Cikarang/Bekasi perjalanan terbagi atas full racket (Cikarang/Bekasi–Kampung Bandan via Manggarai untuk kembali ke Cikarang/Bekasi via Pasar Senen dan Cikarang/Bekasi-Kampung Bandan via Pasar Senen untuk kembali ke Cikarang/Bekasi via Manggarai). Untuk half racket (Cikarang/Bekasi-Kampung Bandan/Angke via Manggarai untuk kembali ke Cikarang/ Bekasi via Manggarai. Sementara untuk lintas Tanah Abang-Rangkasbitung dan lintas Duri-Tangerang masih tetap sama. Sementara untuk kereta bandara selain Bandara Soekarno-Hatta, KAI mendelegasikan kepada PT Railink (KAI Bandara), anak perusahaan KAI yang menghadirkan layanan transportasi publik berbasis railway berupa Kereta Api Bandara. Sejak didirikan pada 28 September 2006, KAI Bandara mengoperasikan KA Bandara Kualanamu sebagai KA Bandara pertama di Indonesia pada 25 Juli 2013. KAI Bandara mendatangkan 4 (empat) rangkaian kereta eksklusif dan modern yang berstandar internasional dengan rute Stasiun Medan – Stasiun Kualanamu (PP). Pada 28 September 2022 KAI Bandara Kualanamu membuka layanan baru di Stasiun Bandar Khalipah Medan, sehingga rute perjalanan menjadi Stasiun Medan - Stasiun Bandar Khalipah – Stasiun Kualanamu (PP). Setahun kemudian, pada 1 September 2023 KA Bandara kembali menambah rute perjalanan dari Stasiun Medan – Kualanamu (PP) dengan penambahan 2 (dua) stasiun pemberhentian yaitu Araskabu, dan Batangkuis, sehingga rute saat ini menjadi Stasiun Medan- Stasiun Bandar With the implementation of the 2021 Train Schedule (Gapeka) as of March 1, 2021, KAI Commuter operates commuter trains outside the Jabodetabek area, namely the Yogyakarta - Solo Balapan commuter train, replacing the Prambanan Express train, which currently only serves the Yogyakarta - Kutoarjo route. KAI Commuter’s expansion doesn’t stop at these two areas; in April 2022, local trains in Region 2 Bandung and Region 8 Surabaya, with operating permits granted in November, further expand KAI Commuter’s operational area. At the end of 2022, KAI Commuter was tasked with operating Airport Trains. Following the Switch Over (SO) at Manggarai 5 in 2022, there have been operational changes in the Jabodetabek area. For the Bogor/Nambo/Depok routes, the journey is now only to Jakarta Kota, while for the Cikarang/Bekasi routes, the journey is divided into full racket (Cikarang/ Bekasi–Kampung Bandan via Manggarai to return to Cikarang/Bekasi via Pasar Senen and Cikarang/Bekasi– Kampung Bandan via Pasar Senen to return to Cikarang/ Bekasi via Manggarai). As for half racket routes (Cikarang/ Bekasi–Kampung Bandan/Angke via Manggarai to return to Cikarang/Bekasi via Manggarai). Meanwhile, the Tanah Abang–Rangkasbitung and Duri–Tangerang routes remain unchanged. Regarding airport trains other than Soekarno-Hatta Airport, KAI has delegated the task to PT Railink (KAI Airport), a subsidiary of KAI that provides public transportation services based on railway infrastructure in the form of Airport Trains. Established on September 28, 2006, KAI Airport operates the Kualanamu Airport Train as Indonesia’s first Airport Train on July 25, 2013. KAI Airport introduced 4 (four) exclusive and modern train sets with international standards on the route from Medan Station to Kualanamu Station (round trip). On September 28, 2022, KAI Airport Kualanamu opened a new service at Bandar Khalipah Medan Station, thus expanding the travel route to Medan Station–Bandar Khalipah Station–Kualanamu Station (round trip). A year later, on September 1, 2023, the Airport Train added another route from Medan Station to Kualanamu Station (round trip) with the addition of 2 (two) additional stops at Araskabu and Batangkuis stations, making the current route from Medan Station to Bandar Khalipah Station– 112 PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) | Laporan Tahunan dan Keberlanjutan 2024 Memperkuat Layanan dan Menjamin Keselamatan untuk Wujudkan Keberlanjutan Empowering Services and Ensuring Safety to Cultivate Sustainability Khalipah – Stasiun Batangkuis – Stasiun Araskabu – Stasiun Kualanamu (PP). Pada tanggal 1 September 2023 pula KA Lokal Srilelawangsa mulai dioperasikan oleh KAI Bandara dengan sistem yang sama dengan KA Bandara yaitu berbasis Airport Railway Ticketing System (ARTS) dengan relasi Medan, Binjai, Kuala Bingai. Pada tanggal 26 Desember 2017, KAI Bandara menambah perjalanan KA Bandara Soekarno Hatta (Basoetta) yang kini pengelolaannya telah beralih ke KAI Commuter. Mulai 1 April tahun 2022, KAI Bandara mendapatkan penugasan sebagai penyedia layanan dan sistem pembelian tiket di Kereta Api Bandara Yogyakarta International Airport. KAI Bandara YIA melayani tiga stasiun yaitu stasiun Yogyakarta, Wates, dan YIA. Pada November 2022 KAI Bandara mendapatkan izin operasi untuk menjadi operator penuh KA Bandara Yogyakarta. Kemudian, KAI Wisata dijalankan oleh PT Kereta Api Pariwisata yang menawarkan produk jasa/layanan meliputi paket perjalanan wisata untuk perorangan (FIT) ataupun rombongan dengan sistem pola carter, dengan menggunakan kereta api sebagai transportasi utama. Sejumlah yang disewakan antara lain Kereta Istimewa, Kereta Panoramic, Kereta Wisata Bali, Kereta Wisata Imperial, Kereta Wisata Jawa, Kereta Wisata Nusantara, Kereta Wisata Priority, Kereta Wisata Sumatera, Kereta Wisata Toraja dan Kereta Uap di Museum Ambarawa. KAI Wisata yang diberikan kepercayaan fokus pada bidang jasa pariwisata kereta api telah memiliki 12 lini bisnis saat ini diantaranya mengelola: 1. Kereta wisata.
2. Hotel Transit Gambir.
3. Lounge Anggrek.
4. Luxury Lounge.
5. Shower n Locker.
6. Heritage Building Lawang Sewu & Indonesia Railway Museum Ambarawa.
7. Ticketing & Pengelolaan Dokumen Perjalanan.
8. Tenaga Frontliner & Contact Centre.
9. Tour & Mice.
10. Periklanan, Podcast & Pengelolaan Social Media.
11. Aplikasi E-Porter.
12. Sewa Kendaraan Restorasi.
Batangkuis Station–Araskabu Station–Kualanamu Station (round trip). On September 1, 2023, the Srilelawangsa Local Train also began operating under KAI Airport with the same system as the Airport Train, based on the Airport Railway Ticketing System (ARTS), with routes covering Medan, Binjai, and Kuala Bingai. On December 26, 2017, KAI Airport added flights for the Soekarno-Hatta Airport Train (Basoetta), which is now managed by KAI Commuter. Starting April 1, 2022, KAI Airport was tasked with providing ticketing services and ticket purchasing systems for the Yogyakarta International Airport Train. KAI Airport YIA serves three stations: Yogyakarta Station, Wates Station, and YIA Station. In November 2022, KAI Airport obtained an operating permit to become the full operator of the Yogyakarta Airport Train. Furthermore, KAI Wisata, operated by PT Kereta Api Pariwisata, offers tourism service products, including travel packages for individuals (FIT) or groups with a charter pattern system, using trains as the main mode of transportation. Some of the trains available for rent include the Special Train, Panoramic Train, Bali Tourism Train, Imperial Tourism Train, Java Tourism Train, Nusantara Tourism Train, Priority Tourism Train, Sumatra Tourism Train, Toraja Tourism Train, and Steam Train at the Ambarawa Museum. KAI Wisata, entrusted with focusing on railway tourism services, currently manages 12 business lines, including: 1. Tourist train services.
2. Gambir Transit Hotel.
3. Anggrek Lounge.
4. Luxury Lounge.
5. Shower and Locker facilities.
6. Heritage attractions like Lawang Sewu & the Indonesia Railway Museum in Ambarawa.
7. Ticketing and travel document management.
8. Frontliner and contact center staff.
9. Tour and MICE.
10. Advertising, podcasting, and social media management.
11. E-Porter application services.
12. Vehicle rental services.
113 Annual and Sustainability Report 2024 | PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) Profil Perusahaan Company Profile • RESTORASI Setiap rangkaian kereta api milik KAI dilengkapi dengan kereta yang berfungsi sebagai restorasi, atau gerbong restoran. Restorasi pada rangkaian kereta api tersebut menyediakan layanan makan dan minum bagi pelanggan selama perjalanan. KAI memiliki anak perusahaan PT Reska Multi Usaha (KAI Services) sebagai pelaksana restorasi yang juga menunjang kebijakan dan program KAI selaku perusahaan induk pada usaha restoran kereta api serta usaha terkait lainnya. Bidang usaha KAI Services terbagi ke dalam 3 (tiga) bisnis inti, yaitu: 1. On Board Services Terdiri dari restoran kereta dan jasa kebersihan di kereta serta fasilitas penunjang lainnya (passenger amenities). 2. Integrated Facility Service Terdiri dari keamanan, parkir, jasa kebersihan, dan alih daya. 3. Commercial Services Terdiri dari kafe, katering, dan layanan umum • ANGKUTAN BARANG Selain angkutan penumpang, Perseroan juga menyediakan jasa angkutan barang mulai dari skala kecil hingga skala besar termasuk komoditas industri. Untuk layanan angkutan barang, KAI melalui anak perusahaannya, PT Kereta Api Logistik (KAI Logistik) sebagai Badan Usaha Angkutan Multimoda, melakukan usaha di bidang layanan distribusi logistik dengan berbagai segmentasi produk diantaranya KALOG Express untuk layanan kurir dan kargo, KALOG Plus untuk mengakomodir kebutuhan pengiriman barang dalam jumlah yang lebih besar, serta layanan penunjang untuk memastikan terpenuhinya kebutuhan logistik yang beragam seperti angkutan kontainer, Freight Forwarding, depot/warehousing dan kegiatan keterminalan lainnya. Selain itu, KAI Logistik juga menghadirkan KALOG Pro untuk segmentasi logistik business to business dengan menawarkan keunggulan dan pelayanan prima serta menyediakan layanan one stop solution/end to end services guna mewujudkan layanan total logistics solution seperti layanan angkutan multi commodity, project logistic, keterminalan dan penanganan batu bara.
• RESTORATION Every train set owned by KAI is equipped with a carriage serving as a restaurant, or dining car. These dining cars provide food and beverage services for passengers during their journey. KAI has a subsidiary named PT Reska Multi Usaha (KAI Services) tasked with executing the restoration services while also supporting KAI’s policies and programs as the parent company in the train restaurant business and other related ventures. The business sectors of KAI Services are divided into 3 (three) core businesses, namely: 1. On Board Services This includes train restaurants and cleaning services onboard.
2. Integrated Facility Services This covers security, parking, cleaning services, and outsourcing solutions.
3. Commercial Services This encompasses cafes, catering, and various public services.
• FREIGHT TRANSPORTATION In addition to passenger transportation, the Company also provides freight transportation services ranging from small to large scale, including industrial commodities. For freight transportation services, KAI, through its subsidiary PT Kereta Api Logistik (KAI Logistics) as a Multimodal Transportation Business Entity, engages in logistics distribution services with various product segmentations. This includes KALOG Express for courier and cargo services, KALOG Plus to accommodate larger shipment quantities, as well as supporting services to ensure diverse logistics needs are met, such as container transportation, Freight Forwarding, depot/warehousing, and other terminal activities. Moreover, KAI Logistics also introduces KALOG Pro for business-to-business logistics segmentation, offering superior advantages and premium services, as well as providing one-stop solutions/ end-to-end services to realize total logistics solutions such as multi-commodity transportation services, project logistics, terminal operations, and coal handling.
114 PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) | Laporan Tahunan dan Keberlanjutan 2024 Memperkuat Layanan dan Menjamin Keselamatan untuk Wujudkan Keberlanjutan Empowering Services and Ensuring Safety to Cultivate Sustainability KAI Logistik memiliki orientasi pengembangan bisnis sebagai penyedia jasa layanan distribusi logistik secara total (Total Logistics Solution) melalui End-to-End Services atau sebagai SCM Service Provider dengan dukungan teknologi informasi. Untuk memfasilitasi layanan logistik secara terpadu, KAI Logistik telah membangun sejumlah infrastruktur jasa logistik, antara lain terminal kereta api di pulau Jawa serta fasilitas dan infrastruktur yang dimodernisasi untuk penanganan batu bara di Sumatera Selatan. KAI Logistics has a business development orientation as a total logistics distribution service provider through Endto-End Services or as an SCM Service Provider with IT support. To facilitate integrated logistics services, KAI Logistics has built several logistics service infrastructures, including railway terminals in Java and modernized facilities and infrastructure for coal handling in South Sumatra.

Services and Ensuring Safety to Cultivate Sustainability Hubungan Afiliasi Anggota Direksi Affiliation of the Board of Directors KAI memastikan bahwa masing-masing anggota Direksi tidak memiliki hubungan afiliasi, baik berupa hubungan keuangan maupun keluarga, dengan anggota Dewan Komisaris, sesama anggota Direksi, ataupun pemegang saham dan pengendali Perseroan. Selain itu, anggota Direksi juga dipastikan tidak memiliki hubungan kepengurusan dalam bentuk apa pun yang dapat mengganggu independensi dan/atau berpotensi menghadirkan benturan kepentingan dalam pelaksanaan tugas dan tanggung jawab masing-masing.
KAI menjamin bahwa seluruh anggota Direksi dapat senantiasa bertindak independen dan terbebas dari intervensi. Hal tersebut dilaksanakan dalam rangka menjamin terjaganya objektivitas Direksi dalam menjalankan tugas dan tanggung jawabnya dalam mengelola Perseroan.

Additionally, members of the Board of Directors are also ensured not to have any management relationships in any form that could compromise independence and/or potentially create conflicts of interest in the execution of their respective duties and responsibilities.
KAI ensures that all members of the Board of Directors can always act independently and free from intervention. This is done to ensure the objectivity of the Board of Directors in carrying out their duties and responsibilities in managing the Company.

54 tahun / 54 years old Usia / Age 147 Annual and Sustainability Report 2024 | PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) Profil Perusahaan Company Profile Hubungan Afiliasi Dewan Komisaris Board of Commissioners Affiliate Relations KAI telah memastikan bahwa masing-masing anggota Dewan Komisaris tidak memiliki hubungan afiliasi, baik berupa hubungan keuangan maupun keluarga, dengan sesama anggota Dewan Komisaris, anggota Direksi, ataupun pemegang saham dan pengendali Perseroan. Selain itu, anggota Dewan Komisaris juga dipastikan tidak memiliki hubungan kepengurusan dalam bentuk apa pun yang dapat mengganggu independensi dan/atau berpotensi menghadirkan benturan kepentingan dalam pelaksanaan tugas dan tanggung jawab masing-masing. KAI menjamin bahwa seluruh anggota Dewan Komisaris dapat senantiasa bertindak independen dan terbebas dari intervensi. Hal tersebut dilaksanakan dalam rangka menjamin terjaganya independensi Dewan Komisaris dalam menjalankan tugas dan tanggung jawabnya sebagai organ pengawas dalam tata kelola Perseroan.

Additionally, members of the Board of Commissioners are also ensured not to have any management relationships in any form that could compromise independence and/or potentially create conflicts of interest in the execution of their respective duties and responsibilities.
KAI guarantees that all members of the Board of Commissioners can always act independently and free from intervention. This is done to ensure the independence of the Board of Commissioners in carrying out their duties and responsibilities as the supervisory body in the governance of the Company.

Perekonomian dan Industri Economic and Industrial Review Ekonomi global mengalami perlambatan secara signifikan di tahun 2024. Dana Moneter Internasional (IMF) menyampaikan perlambatan ekonomi global terjadi akibat adanya peningkatan inflasi dan penguatan dolar Amerika Serikat (AS). IMF mencatatkan pertumbuhan ekonomi dunia pada tahun 2024 sebesar 3,5%, sedikit meningkat dari tahun 2023 sebesar 3,2%. Meskipun mengalami peningkatan, nilai ini masih berada di bawah rata-rata pertumbuhan historis sebelum pandemi yang berkisar di angka 3,8% hingga 4%. Hal ini mencerminkan bahwa pemulihan ekonomi global masih menghadapi tantangan, seperti ketegangan geopolitik, suku bunga tinggi, serta ketidakpastian pasar keuangan.
Di awal tahun, ketegangan politik global diketahui masih tergolong tinggi akibat berlanjutnya konflik Rusia-Ukraina. Kondisi ini membuat dinamika geopolitik dunia cepat berubah dan berdampak pada perkembangan pasar global, dan diperkirakan akan terus berlanjut. Berdasarkan data Bank Indonesia, pertumbuhan ekonomi global melambat berada di kisaran 3,2%. Pertumbuhan ekonomi sejumlah negara maju seperti AS juga mengalami perlambatan dari 2,9% pada tahun 2023 menjadi 2,8% di tahun 2024. Lebih lanjut, di kawasan Eropa kondisi ekonomi masih tergolong lemah dengan capaian angka di bawah historis yaitu 0,8%. Begitu pula dengan pertumbuhan ekonomi Jepang yang terkontraksi 0,1% setelah tumbuh 1,9% pada tahun 2023. Berbeda dengan beberapa negara maju, ekonomi negara berkembang justru mengalami penguatan di sepanjang tahun 2024. Pertumbuhan ekonomi negara berkembang seperti Indonesia, Singapura, Malaysia, Thailand dan Filipina (ASEAN-5) menunjukkan pertumbuhan yang meningkat. Di tahun 2024, pertumbuhan ekonomi ASEAN-5 mengalami peningkatan dari 4,0% menjadi 4,8%. The global economy experienced a significant slowdown in 2024. According to the International Monetary Fund (IMF), this slowdown was attributed to rising inflation and the strengthening of the United States (US) dollar. The IMF recorded world economic growth at 3.5% for 2024, a slight increase from 3.2% in 2023. However, this growth remained below the pre-pandemic average of 3.8% to 4%, indicating that the global economic recovery continued to face challenges, including geopolitical tensions, high interest rates, and uncertainty in financial markets.
At the beginning of the year, political tensions worldwide remained high due to the ongoing Russia-Ukraine conflict. This situation has caused rapid changes in global geopolitics, affecting market developments, and it is expected to persist.
Data from Bank Indonesia indicates that global economic growth has slowed to approximately 3.2%. The economic growth of several developed countries, including the US, has also declined, from 2.9% in 2023 to 2.8% in 2024. Economic conditions in the European region remain relatively weak, with growth figures below the historical level of 0.8%. Japan’s economy contracted by 0.1% after growing by 1.9% in 2023.
In contrast, several developing countries have experienced economic strengthening throughout 2024. The economies of the ASEAN-5 countries, namely Indonesia, Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, and the Philippines, showed increased growth, with the economic growth of the ASEAN-5 rising from 4.0% to 4.8% in 2024. According to Statistics Indonesia, Indonesia’s economy grew by 5.03%, with 174 PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) | Laporan Tahunan dan Keberlanjutan 2024 Memperkuat Layanan dan Menjamin Keselamatan untuk Wujudkan Keberlanjutan Empowering Services and Ensuring Safety to Cultivate Sustainability Analisis dan Pembahasan Manajemen Management Discussion and Analysis Menurut Badan Pusat Statistik, ekonomi Indonesia tumbuh sebesar 5,03% dengan capaian Produk Domestik Bruto (PDB) per kapita sebesar Rp78,6 juta atau USD4.960,3. Pertumbuhan ekonomi ini ditopang oleh adanya kenaikan investasi dan terjaganya konsumsi rumah tangga serta peningkatan belanja Pemerintah pada akhir tahun. Lebih lanjut, pada Industri Transportasi dan Pergudangan berhasil mencatatkan pertumbuhan baik sebesar 8,6%. Hal ini menjadi menjadikan lapangan usaha dengan pertumbuhan tertinggi kedua setelah Jasa Lainnya sebesar 9,80%. Kemudian, terlihat adanya peningkatan pada volume penumpang di sepanjang tahun 2024 sebesar 17,81%, dari 388,78 juta orang menjadi 504,6 juta a Gross Domestic Product (GDP) per capita of Rp78.6 million, or USD4,960.3. This growth was supported by increased investment, sustained household consumption, and a rise in government spending at the year’s end.
Furthermore, the Transportation and Warehousing Industry recorded positive growth of 8.6%, making it the sector with the second highest growth rate after Other Services, which grew by 9.80%. In 2024, the passenger volume also saw an increase of 17.81%, rising from 388.78 million to 504.6 million people. Similarly, freight transportation experienced a volume increase of 9.42%, 175 Annual and Sustainability Report 2024 | PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) Analisis dan Pembahasan Manajemen Management Discussion and Analysis orang. Begitu pula dengan angkutan barang yang mengalami peningkatan volume sebesar 9,42% menjadi 73,5 ton. Dalam industri transportasi, perkeretaapian di tahun 2024 mengalami kondisi yang baik. Terlihat adanya peningkatan terhadap permintaan perjalanan domestik dan logistik barang di Indonesia. Kondisi ini memberikan peluang besar bagi KAI untuk dapat mengoptimalkan dan memanfaatkan perannya pada industri.
Tinjauan Operasi Operational Review Di tahun 2024, KAI berhasil mencatatkan pertumbuhan cemerlang. Capaian ini didorong oleh berbagai program strategis yang telah dijalankan secara konsisten, termasuk optimalisasi operasional, penguatan layanan, serta inovasi produk yang adaptif terhadap kebutuhan pasar. Strategi yang ditetapkan menjadi faktor penting dalam tercapainya target setiap segmen usaha. Lebih lanjut, di sepanjang tahun 2024, KAI terus meningkatkan layanan Kereta Cepat Jakarta Bandung (KCJB) Whoosh dan LRT Jabodebek yang merupakan Proyek Strategis Nasional amanat Pemerintah Indonesia. Dalam menjalankan usahanya, KAI membagi kegiatan operasional ke dalam beberapa segmen usaha sesuai dengan Pernyataan Standar Akuntansi Keuangan (PSAK) yang berlaku di Indonesia (PSAK 5) tentang Segmen Operasi. Segmen usaha KAI terdiri dari Jasa Angkutan, Jasa Non-Angkutan, dan Konstruksi. Segmen usaha tersebut dibagi ke dalam beberapa segmen usaha turunan yang menjadi sumber pendapatan bagi Perseroan, yaitu angkutan penumpang, angkutan barang, serta pendukung angkutan kereta api, pendapatan non- angkutan, dan kompensasi Pemerintah yang terdiri dari Public Service Obligation (PSO), Infrastructure Maintenance and Operation (IMO), dan Perintis.
Segmen usaha KAI Segmen Usaha Business Segment Jasa Angkutan Transportation Services Jasa Non Angkutan Non-Transportation Services Konstruksi Construction reaching 73.5 tons.
In the transportation sector, railways in 2024 encountered favorable conditions, demonstrated by an increase in demand for domestic travel and goods logistics in Indonesia. This situation presents significant opportunities for KAI to optimize and enhance its role within the industry.
In 2024, KAI achieved remarkable growth, driven by various strategic programs that were consistently implemented. These include operational optimization, service enhancement, and product innovations that align with market needs. The strategies established were crucial in meeting the targets across each business segment. Throughout 2024, KAI continued to enhance the services of the Jakarta-Bandung High-Speed Train (KCJB) Whoosh and the Jabodebek (Jakarta, Bogor, Depok, Bekasi) LRT, both of which are National Strategic Projects mandated by the Indonesian Government.
In conducting its business, KAI organizes its operational activities into various business segments, as stipulated by the applicable Financial Accounting Standards Statement (PSAK 5) in Indonesia. KAI’s business segments include Transportation Services, Non-Transportation Services, and Construction. These segments further comprise several derivative business areas that generate income for the Company, including passenger transportation, freight transportation, railway transportation support, non-transportation income, and government compensation, which consists of Public Service Obligations (PSO), Infrastructure Maintenance and Operation (IMO), and Pioneers.

Kinerja Jasa Angkutan Transportation Services Performance Di tahun 2024, Perseroan berhasil mencatatkan total pendapatan sebesar Rp36,11 triliun, berasal dari jasa angkutan, jasa non-angkutan serta konstruksi. Jumlah ini meningkat 2,85% dibandingkan dengan tahun sebelumnya sebesar Rp35,107 triliun dan mampu mencapai 8,88% dari target sebesar Rp33,16 triliun. Dari seluruh segmen usaha KAI, jasa angkutan merupakan segmen dengan kontribusi terbesar sepanjang tahun 2024. Segmen jasa angkutan ini meliputi angkutan barang dan angkutan penumpang. Segmen jasa angkutan barang berkontribusi sebesar 35,45% terhadap pendapatan dengan realisasi sebesar Rp12,80 triliun. Realisasi ini meningkat KAI has established several strategies to support performance, both financially and operationally. The key strategic programs for 2024 include: 1. Revenue Growth 2. Optimizing Operational Performance and Sustainability based on ESG principles 3. Improving Operational Safety 4. Integrated Transformation, Innovation, and Digitalization 5. Commitment and mutual agreement and collaborate to establish cooperation to achieve the best performance.
6. Implement orderly documentation to prepare all administrative processes according to procedures.
7. Focus on the target of achieving timely completion of investment projects.
8. Establish good and intense communication with all parties.
9. Prepare a Detailed Timeline and Submit proposals on time.
10. Immediately make decisions on problems that occur.

13. Conduct evaluations and open discussion spaces in finding solutions to problems that occur and encourage acceleration and always be disciplined in executing according to time targets.
14. Create and compile detailed, comprehensive and sustainable work plans.
In 2024, the Company achieved total revenue of Rp36.11 trillion from the transportation, non-transportation, and construction services. This amount represents an increase of 2.85% compared to the previous year's revenue of Rp35.107 trillion and reached 8.88% of the target set at Rp33.16 trillion.
Among all of KAI's business segments, transportation services provided the largest contribution in 2024. This segment encompasses both freight and passenger transportation. The freight transportation service segment accounted for 35.45% of total revenue, amounting to Rp12.80 trillion, which reflects an increase of 9.92% from the 2023 figure of Rp11.646 trillion. 177 Annual and Sustainability Report 2024 | PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) Analisis dan Pembahasan Manajemen Management Discussion and Analysis 9,92% dibandingkan dengan tahun 2023 sebesar Rp11,646 triliun. KAI berkomitmen untuk terus menghadirkan inovasi yang mendukung kebutuhan pelanggan di era digital, salah satunya dengan menghadirkan Access by KAI dan face recognition boarding gate untuk mempermudah para pelanggan. Hal ini merupakan bukti nyata bahwa KAI terus berkomitmen memberikan pelayanan terbaik kepada pelanggan baik dari sisi operasional, digitalisasi maupun inovasi keberlanjutan. Moda transportasi kereta api ringan LRT memiliki lintasan sepanjang 41,2 kilometer yang diharapkan menjadi alternatif transportasi nyaman dan aman bagi masyarakat. Selain layanan prima, sejumlah stasiun LRT juga sudah terintegrasi dengan berbagai moda transportasi lain, antara lain dengan Kereta Rel Listrik (KRL), Bus Rapid Transit/Bus Raya Terpadu (BRT), Transjakarta, JakLingko/MikroTrans, hingga KCJB. Meanwhile, passenger transportation services contributed 33.01% to the total revenue, generating Rp11.92 trillion, which is an increase of 19.89% compared to the previous year's revenue of Rp9.942 trillion. Meanwhile, revenue from other business segments, excluding transportation services, reached a total of 31.54%.

KAI is committed to continually introducing innovations that meet customer needs in the digital age. This includes initiatives like Access by KAI and the introduction of face recognition boarding gates, designed to enhance customer convenience. These efforts demonstrate KAI’s commitment to providing the best service to customers, focusing on operations, digitalization, and sustainable innovation.

Keberadaan LRT dan KCJB juga menjadi perwujudan komitmen Pemerintah melakukan modernisasi transportasi massal yang efisien, ramah lingkungan, serta terintegrasi dengan moda transportasi lainnya. Keberadaan LRT Jabodebek dan KCJB Whoosh mendapatkan sambutan positif dari masyarakat.

Jumlah ini meningkat 16,6% dari tahun sebelumnya sebesar 388.776.604 orang dan mampu mencapai 103,0% dari target. Peningkatan penumpang KA utama didorong oleh penumpang KA utama kelas eksekutif yang mencatatkan peningkatan 15,23% dari 16.427.175 orang pada tahun 2023 menjadi 18.923.496 orang pada tahun 2024. Peningkatan ini disebabkan oleh animo masyarakat dan wisatawan asing menggunakan moda jasa angkutan kereta api meningkat sehingga dapat dilakukan optimalisasi rangkaian, optimalisasi frekuensi KA, optimalisasi tarif, dan penyesuaian alokasi subclass tempat duduk pada saat peak season (angkutan Lebaran, libur sekolah, angkutan Nataru), beberapa KA tambahan pada relasi-relasi potensial dapat dijalankan dan penambahan KA Luxury di beberapa KA. Selain itu dilakukan rerouting KA Argo Parahyangan menjadi 3 KA Baru yaitu KA Malabar 2, KA Pangandaran dan KA Papandayan, perpanjangan relasi KA Blambangan Ekspres sampai dengan stasiun Pasar Senen per 25 Juli 2024 sebagai upaya untuk peningkatan volume dan pendapatan di rute-rute yang potensial.
Meanwhile, the KCJB Whoosh is Indonesia’s first fast train and the fastest in Southeast Asia, reaching speeds of up to 350 kilometers per hour. The introduction of the LRT and KCJB reflects the government’s commitment to modernizing mass transportation to be efficient, environmentally friendly, and integrated with other travel options. Both the LRT Jabodebek and the KCJB Whoosh have received positive feedback from the public.
Information about the performance of transportation services in 2024 is as follows: Passenger Train Transport Performence (In person) In 2024, KAI recorded a main train passenger volume of 453,343,189 people. This figure increased by 103.0% from the previous year's total of 388,776,604 passengers, achieving 103.0% of the target. The growth in main train passengers was mainly driven by the executive class, which reported an increase of 15.23%, rising from 16,427,175 passengers in 2023 to 18,823,496 in 2024. This increase was attributed to This increase is due to the increasing enthusiasm of the public and foreign tourists to use the railway transportation mode so that optimization of the series, optimization of train frequency, optimization of fares, and adjustment of subclass allocation of seats during the peak season (Lebaran transportation, school holidays, Nataru transportation) can be carried out, several additional trains on potential relations can be run and the addition of Luxury trains on several trains. In addition, the Argo Parahyangan train was rerouted into 3 new trains, namely the Malabar 2 train, the Pangandaran train and the Papandayan train, the extension of the Blambangan Ekspres train relationship to Pasar Senen station as of July 25, 2024 as an effort to increase volume and income on potential routes.

KA utama kelas ekonomi turut mencatatkan kinerja baiknya. KA utama kelas ekonomi melayani 30.524.135 orang, meningkat 12,1% dibandingkan dengan tahun sebelumnya sebesar 27.233.710 orang. Pangsa Pasar Angkutan Penumpang KAI mengidentifikasi pangsa pasar angkutan penumpang dapat dilihat berdasarkan segmentasi pasar dan metode pembelian tiket. Target pasar pengguna jasa kereta api terbagi ke dalam 2 (dua) kategori, yaitu pelanggan yang melakukan pembelian tiket melalui aplikasi (online) dan pelanggan yang melakukan pembelian tiket secara langsung pada loket yang ada di stasiun (offline). Seiring dengan digitalisasi yang terus berkembang dan perubahan gaya hidup Masyarakat, pembelian tiket secara online mengalami peningkatan. Masyarakat cenderung melakukan pembelian tiket secara online dengan berbagai variasi aplikasi yang beragam. Mendukung hal tersebut, KAI melakukan berbagai strategi untuk memberikan kemudahan bagi pelanggan yang ingin melakukan pembelian tiket.

Passenger Transportation Market Share KAI analyzed the passenger transportation market share based on market segmentation and ticket purchasing methods. The target market for train service users is divided into 2 (two) categories: customers who purchase tickets through applications (online) and customers who buy tickets directly at the station counter (offline). With the ongoing development of digitalization and changing lifestyles, online ticket purchases have seen growth. People increasingly prefer to buy tickets online through various applications. To facilitate this trend, KAI has implemented several strategies to enhance the convenience of ticket purchases for its customers.

ANGKUTAN BARANG Segmen angkutan barang pada umumnya berfokus pada angkutan batu bara yang merepresentasikan lebih dari 75% porsi pendapatan angkutan barang pada KAI selama periode 2018-2022. Selain batu bara, KAI juga mengangkut beberapa komoditas lain seperti peti kemas, semen, dan bahan bakar minyak mentah (BBM) atau minyak sawit mentah (CPO).

The implementation of KAI’s strategic initiatives in 2024 also supported the increase in revenue for the passenger transportation service business segment as seen in the following table: Passenger Transportation Services Revenue (In thousands of Rupiah) In 2024, the passenger transportation service segment generated revenue of Rp11.91 trillion, an increase of 19.9% or 109.2% of the target. Overall, the growth was primarily driven by the revenue from the executive class main train, which reached Rp5.19 trillion, reflecting an increase of 15.3% compared to that of the previous year at 4.51 trillion. The executive class main train with the highest revenue is the KA Taksaka, KA Sembrani, KA Argo Bromo Anggrek, KA Argo Semeru, and KA Bima.
FREIGHT TRANSPORTATION The freight transportation segment mainly focuses on coal, which accounts for over 75% of KAI’s freight revenue from 2018 to 2022. In addition to coal, KAI also transports various other commodities, including containers, cement, crude oil (BBM), and crude palm oil (CPO).
183 Annual and Sustainability Report 2024 | PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) Analisis dan Pembahasan Manajemen Management Discussion and Analysis Di sepanjang tahun 2024, sektor angkutan barang berhasil mencatatkan kinerja positif. Volume barang tercatat sebesar 69,2 ton barang, naik 8,65% dibandingkan dengan volume tahun 2023 sebesar 63.694.966 ton barang dan berhasil mencapai 1,29% dari target yang telah di tentukan.
Peningkatan volume barang didorong oleh realisasi batu bara yang mencapai 55.645.263 ton, disusul oleh peti kemas sebesar 5.821.791 ton, semen sebesar 3.489.261 ton, BBM sebesar 2.667.441 ton, barang lainnya sebesar 1.353.049 ton dan General Cargo dan BHP sebesar 224.865 ton.
KAI memberikan layanan dengan fasilitas yang memberikan nilai tambah bagi pelanggan, seperti pelayanan yang tepat waktu, layanan first mile dan last mile yang cost-competitive, serta kapasitas angkut yang besar dan bahkan disertai dengan layanan pick up. Pelayanan yang masih terkonsentrasi di Jawa dan Sumatra membuka peluang yang sangat besar bagi KAI untuk melakukan ekspansi bisnis ke luar Jawa dan Sumatra. Potensi pasar batu bara, serta potensi pengembangan kapasitas bongkar muat, seperti pengembangan Terminal Kramasan, menawarkan peluang untuk meningkatkan kapabilitas operasional dan memperluas jaringan. Selain itu, munculnya teknologi ramah lingkungan juga menjadi kesempatan bagi KAI untuk menggaet pangsa pasar yang lebih besar mengingat kereta api cenderung lebih ramah lingkungan jika dibandingkan dengan moda transportasi darat lainnya Kinerja Angkutan KA Barang (Dalam satuan ton) Uraian / Description 2024 2023 Rasio / Ratio Realisasi / Realization Target Terhadap 2023 / To 2023 Terhadap Target / To Target Batu Bara / Coal 11.335.116.542 11.630.887.626 10.190.706.710 11,2 97,5 Peti Kemas / Container 475.928.231 438.343.382 414.804.866 14,7 108,6 BBM / Fuel 387.122.082 372.815.171 385.496.853 0,4 103,8 Semen / Cement 215.410.264 220.837.091 272.245.319 (20,9) 97,5 General Cargo dan Barang Hantaran Potongan (BHP) / General Cargo and Delivery Freight Unit (BHP) 223.833.310 193.478.701 230.744.572 (3,0) 115,7 Lainnya / Others 163.361.568 149.383.373 152.064.050 7,4 109,4 Jumlah / Total 12.800.771.997 13.005.745.344 11.646.062.370 9,9 98,4 In 2024, the freight transportation sector demonstrated positive performance, with a recorded volume of 69,201,670 tons of goods. This reflects an increase of 8.6% compared to the previous year's volume of 63,694,966 tons and achieved 1.3% of the set target.
The increase in goods volume was attributed to coal transportation reaching 55,645,263 tons, followed by containers at 5,821,791 tons, cement at 3,489,261 tons, fuel at 2,667,441 tons, plantations at 693,412 tons, other goods at 635,457 tons, General Cargo and BHP at 224,865 tons, and fertilizers of 24,180 tons.
KAI provides services by offering value-added features, such as timely delivery, cost-effective first mile and last mile services, large transport capacity, and pickup services. Services concentrated in Java and Sumatra present significant opportunities for KAI to expand its operations beyond Java and Sumatra.
The coal market’s potential, along with the opportunities for developing loading and unloading capacity, such as the development of the Kramasan Terminal, will present opportunities to improve operational capabilities and facilitate network expansion. Additionally, the introduction of environmentally friendly technology offers KAI a chance to capture a larger market share, especially since trains are generally more environmentally friendly compared to other land transportation modes.

Keterangan: Data publik yang tersedia / Description: From the available public data Pada segmen usaha jasa angkutan barang, KAI berupaya memperluas angkutan ekspor-impor multicommodity, membangun terminal bongkar muat multi user di Kramasan, melanjutkan pengembangan container yard Batubara Merapi 2, hingga mengoptimalkan dan memperluas bisnis kurir termasuk pengiriman keluar Pulau Jawa dan Sumatera. KAI telah menentukan sejumlah langkah strategis untuk meningkatkan produktivitas jasa angkutan barang. Dengan demikian KAI dapat menjaga stabilitas usaha sehingga dapat bertahan dan berkembang di tengah berbagai ancaman. Langkah Strategis Pada Jasa Angkutan Barang Dalam upaya meningkatkan daya saing dan memperkuat posisi di pasar, berikut adalah langkah strategis yang dilakukan oleh KAI sepanjang tahun 2024: 1. Kenaikan Tarif Batubara sebesar 4% dan Non Batubara sebesar 2-5%; Freight Transportation Market Share KAI provides freight transportation services and holds a market share that includes several types of companies, such as: • Manufacturing companies such as cement, fuel, and coal; • Plantation companies such as CPO and latex; • Logistics companies such as container transport and hazardous waste (B3) These companies prefer using trains over other modes of transportation due to trains’ large carrying capacity and high punctuality in delivering goods. At the national level, KAI operates railway lines on the islands of Java and Sumatra.
Information on the market share of freight trains based on the volume of goods transported is available in the following table: In the freight transportation service sector, KAI strives to expand its multicommodity export-import transportation. construct a multi-user loading and unloading terminal in Kramasan, continue the development of the Batubara Merapi 2 container yard, and optimize the courier business, which includes shipping services outside of Java and Sumatera.
KAI has outlined several strategic measures to enhance the productivity of its freight transportation services. Therefore, KAI aims to maintain business stability, ensuring that it can thrive and grow despite various challenges.
Strategic Initiatives in Freight Transportation Services To increase competitiveness and strengthen its market position, KAI implemented the following strategic initiatives throughout 2024: 1. Increase in Coal Tariff by 4% and Non-Coal by 2-5%; 185 Annual and Sustainability Report 2024 | PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) Analisis dan Pembahasan Manajemen Management Discussion and Analysis 2. Optimalisasi KA Batubara Sumsel dengan pemindahan Sarana ex KA merugi dari Jawa ke Sumatera Selatan, penambahan SF KA Batubara, modifikasi trainset/gerbong KKBW, dan efektivitas waktu tunggu terminal (WTT); 3. Investasi Sarana 54 Lokomotif CC205, 1.125 GD 54 Ton dan 966 GB 50 Ton; 4. Pengoperasian jalur 11 CY FMS dan jalur 12 CY WBS di Stasiun Simpang; 5. Pembangunan CY MIP di Stasiun Merapi dan TULS Kramasan oleh PT KAI LOGISTIK; 6. Menjalankan uji coba program angkutan National Logistics Ecosystem (NLE); dan 7. Menjalankan program Sinergi Produk General Cargo (GenCo) oleh KAI Group, ASDP Group dan DAMRI.
Sejumlah langkah strategis yang dijalankan KAI untuk meningkatkan kinerja jasa angkutan barang turut mendorong pendapatan pada segmen ini mencapai 98,7% target. Rawatan terencana dan gangguan Train Loading System (TLS), Rotary Coal Dumper (RCD) dan Apron Feeder (AF); 2. Dampak Kecelakaan Kereta Api (KKA) dan Non Kecelakaan Kereta Api (NKKA); 3. Dampak Window Time (WT); 4. Terdapat mitra yang tidak berjalan maksimal (PT Bima Putra Abadi Citranusa, PT Bukit Bara Alam, PT Bara Manunggal Sakti, PT Golden Great Borneo) dampak penurunan harga batubara dunia.
5. Pembatasan hauling pada saat Lebaran, Natal dan tahun baru selama 24 hari.
Upaya : 1. Minimalisir kendala alat produksi Train Loading System (TLS), Rotary Coal Dumper (RCD) dan Apron Feeder (AF).
2. Efektivitas waktu perjalanan kereta api (WPKA) semula 1,92 menjadi 1,82 untuk KA Baratarahan dan efektifitas WPKA semula 0,87 menjadi 0,71 untuk KA Barapati.
3. Optimasi penambahan SF 61 KA Baratarahan.
4. Modif gerbong KKBW 45 Ton sebagai pengganti trainset (TS) Rumania.
5. Penambahan stamformasi (SF) semula 30 GB menjadi 32 GB KA Barapati.
6. Optimasi TS Idle Mitra Swasta.
7. Optimalisasi 2 TS GD 42 dari Jawa pada KA Baraswasta.
8. Pengoperasian Double Track ME-MLI.
9. Uji coba Angkutan Batubara Swasta PT Kereta Api Logistik relasi Muaralawai – Simpang tmt 20 Desember 2024 dengan SF 61.
Peti Kemas Hingga 31 Desember 2024, realisasi pendapatan peti kemas mencapai Rp475,9 miliar atau 108,6% dari target sebesar Rp438,3 miliar. Volume tercapai 5,8 juta ton atau 109,5 % dari target sebesar 5,3 juta ton. Realisasi pendapatan dan volume peti kemas mencapai anggaran dikarenakan: 1. Penambahan Hari Operasi pada beberapa mitra antara lain PT KALOG dan PT BWI.
2. Optimasi potensi market dengan mengakomodir Angkutan Balen Limbah B3.
3. Peningkatan volume Petikemas PT SMNT dan PT PIL di Divre I.
4. Penambahan SF KA Kalmas semula 20 GD menjadi 30 GD.
Justification: 1. Planned maintenance and disruption of Train Loading System (TLS), Rotary Coal Dumper (RCD) and Apron Feeder (AF); 2. Impact of Train Accidents (KKA) and Non-Train Accidents (NKKA); 3. Impact of Window Time (WT); 4. There are partners that are not running optimally (PT Bima Putra Abadi Citranusa, PT Bukit Bara Alam, PT Bara Manunggal Sakti, PT Golden Great Borneo) due to the decline in world coal prices.
5. Hauling restrictions during Eid, Christmas and New Year for 24 days.
Efforts: 1. Minimizing the constraints of Train Loading System (TLS), Rotary Coal Dumper (RCD) and Apron Feeder (AF) production tools.
2. Effectiveness of train travel time (WPKA) originally 1.92 to 1.82 for KA Baratarahan and effectiveness of WPKA originally 0.87 to 0.71 for KA Barapati.
3. Optimization of the addition of SF 61 KA Baratarahan.
4. Modification of KKBW 45 Ton carriages as a replacement for the Rumanian trainset (TS).
5. Addition of stamformation (SF) originally 30 GB to 32 GB KA Barapati.
6. Optimization of TS Idle Private Partners.
7. Optimization of 2 TS GD 42 from Java on KA Baraswasta.
8. Operation of Double Track ME-MLI.
9. Trial of Private Coal Transportation of PT Kereta Api Logistik on the Muaralawai – Simpang route on December 20, 2024 with SF 61.
Containers As of December 31, 2024, the realized container revenue totaled Rp475.9 billion, which is 108.6% of the budgeted amount of Rp438.3 billion. The volume achieved was 5.8 million tons, representing 109.5% of the target of 5.3 million tons. The realization of revenue and container volume met/did not meet the budget for the following reasons: 1. Additional Operating Days for several partners including PT KALOG and PT BWI.
2. Optimization of market potential by accommodating B3 Waste Balen Transportation.
3. Increase in the volume of PT SMNT and PT PIL Containers in Divre I.
4. Addition of SF KA Kalmas from 20 GD to 30 GD.
187 Annual and Sustainability Report 2024 | PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) Analisis dan Pembahasan Manajemen Management Discussion and Analysis BBM Realisasi pendapatan sebesar Rp387,1 miliar atau 103,8% dari target sebesar Rp372,8 miliar dan volume tercapai 2,6 juta ton atau 102,9% dari target sebesar 2,5 juta ton. Capaian volume dan pendapatan ini disebabkan oleh meningkatnya angkutan bahan bakar minyak (BBM) dari PT Pertamina khususnya pada masa Peak Season (masa liburan Natal, Tahun Baru, Idul Fitri, Idul Adha dan masa liburan sekolah/hari besar keagamaan).
Semen Hingga 31 Desember 2024, realisasi pendapatan semen mencapai 97,5% dari target sebesar Rp220,8 miliar. Volume tercapai 3,4 juta ton atau 91,9 % dari target sebesar 3,7 juta ton.
Justifikasi : 1. Angkutan Semen PT ITP relasi Nambo – Kalimas stop beroperasi bulan Februari 2024 dan Arjawinangun – Semarang Poncol stop operasi bulan Maret 2024 (armada kirim Sumsel).
2. Penurunan volume KA Semen Padang dampak kebijakan Holding Semen Indonesia membatasi area penjualan.
Upaya: 1. Koordinasi antara KAI, KALOG dan PT ITP terkait isu-isu dan peningkatan PO Angkutan Semen dari Stasiun Arjawinangun dan Nambo.
2. Melakukan negosiasi dengan PT Semen Padang untuk meningkatkan volume angkutan dari 75.000 gerbong menjadi 79.000 gerbong dan meminimalisir gangguan alat produksi.
Perkebunan Realisasi pendapatan perkebunan sebesar Rp139 miliar atau 95,8% dari target sebesar Rp145 miliar dan volume tercapai 693 ribu ton atau 85,1% dari target sebesar 815 ribu ton. Ketidakcapaian volume dan pendapatan ini disebabkan oleh: • Justifikasi: Angkutan CPO PTPN III belum maksimal dikarenakan market CPO lebih banyak yang menggunakan Truk (tidak ada jalur KA).
• Upaya: Melakukan negosiasi dengan PTPN untuk penerapan target minimum dan mengoptimalkan DO sesuai dengan program angkutan.
Fuel The realization of revenue of Rp387.1 billion or 103.8% of the target of Rp372.8 billion and the volume achieved 2.6 million tons or 102.9% of the target of 2.5 million tons. The achievement of volume and revenue was due to the increase in fuel transportation from PT Pertamina, especially during the Peak Season (Christmas, New Year, Eid al-Fitr, Eid al-Adha holidays and school holidays/religious holidays).
Cement Until December 31, 2024, cement revenue realization reached 97.5% of the target of Rp220.8 billion. Volume reached 3.4 million tons or 91.9% of the target of 3.7 million tons.
Justification: 1. PT ITP Cement Transportation on the Nambo – Kalimas route will stop operating in February 2024 and Arjawinangun – Semarang Poncol will stop operating in March 2024 (South Sumatra delivery fleet).
2. The decrease in the volume of Semen Padang trains is the impact of the Semen Indonesia Holding policy to limit sales areas.
Efforts: 1. Coordination between KAI, KALOG and PT ITP regarding issues and improvements in PO Angkutan Semen from Arjawinangun and Nambo Stations.
2. Negotiating with PT Semen Padang to increase the volume of transportation from 75,000 carriages to 79,000 carriages and minimize disruptions to production equipment.
Plantation The realization of plantation income was Rp139 billion or 95.8% of the target of Rp145 billion and the volume achieved was 693 thousand tons or 85.1% of the target of 815 thousand tons. The failure to achieve volume and income was caused by: • Justification: PTPN III CPO transportation is not yet optimal because the CPO market uses more trucks (there are no railway lines).
• Efforts: Negotiating with PTPN for the implementation of minimum targets and optimizing DO in accordance with the transportation program.

Ketidakcapaian volume dan pendapatan ini disebabkan oleh : • Justifikasi: KA Parcel Selatan (ONS), KA BHP Tawangalun dan KA BHP Joglosemarkerto di tahun 2024 tidak beroperasi dampak penurunan market.
• Upaya : 1. Menjalankan BHP KA Pandalungan relasi Gambir – Jember mulai bulan Januari 2024.
2. Menjalankan BHP KA Blambangan Ekpress relasi Pasar Senen – Ketapang mulai bulan Agustus 2024.

Realisasi pendapatan dan volume angkutan barang lainya tidak mencapai target dikarenakan : • Justifikasi : 1. Angkutan Pupuk relasi Cilacap – Pupuk berhenti menggunakan Kereta Api (dampak peralihan distribusi pupuk semula dari PT Pusri Cilacap menjadi PT Pupuk Kujang dan tidak menggunakan KA).
2. Persentase Pendapatan lebih tinggi dari Volume dikarenakan adanya kenaikan tarif.
• Upaya : Penambahan Perjalanan KA Pupuk relasi Cilacap – Ceper dari yang sebelumnya seminggu sekali menjadi seminggu 3 (tiga) kali. Upaya Peningkatan Kinerja Angkutan Barang Untuk meningkatkan kinerja angkutan barang, KAI menjalin kerja sama dengan pelaku usaha di bidang logistik maupun pemilik barang untuk menciptakan sistem logistik yang efektif dan efisien. Kerja sama yang dijalin oleh KAI di antaranya: 1. Kerja sama jasa pengangkutan barang komoditi batu bara, peti kemas, semen, BBM/ BBK Pertamina, CPO, Pupuk, Pulp, dan angkutan barang paketan pada kereta bagasi. Pada 2024.
2. Integrasi aplikasi komoditi batu bara antara PT KAI dengan PT Bukit Asam.
General Cargo and BHP As of December 31, 2024, the realization of revenue was Rp162 billion or 94.2% of the target of Rp172 billion and the volume achieved was 224 thousand tons or 84.8% of the target of 265 thousand tons. The failure to achieve this volume and revenue was caused by: • Justification: The South Parcel Train (ONS), BHP Tawangalun Train and BHP Joglosemarkerto Train will not operate in 2024 due to the impact of the market decline.
• Efforts: 1. Running the BHP of the Pandalungan train on the Gambir – Jember route starting in January 2024.
2. Running the BHP of the Blambangan Express train on the Pasar Senen – Ketapang route starting in August 2024.
Other Freight Transportation The realization of fertilizer revenue reached IDR2.7 billion or 79.9% of the target of IDR3.4 billion. The volume achieved was 24 thousand tons or 64.5% of the target of 37 thousand tons. The realization of revenue and volume of other goods transportation did not reach the target due to: • Justification: 1. Fertilizer transportation on the Cilacap - Pupuk route stopped using the Train (the impact of the transfer of fertilizer distribution from PT Pusri Cilacap to PT Pupuk Kujang and no longer using the Train).
2. The percentage of Revenue was higher than the Volume due to an increase in tariffs.
• Efforts: Additional Fertilizer Train Trips on the Cilacap - Ceper route from once a week to 3 (three) times a week.
Other Freight Transportation To improve the performance of freight transportation, KAI collaborates with business actors in the logistics sector and goods owners to create an effective and efficient logistics system. The collaborations established by KAI include: 1. Cooperation in the transportation services of coal commodities, containers, cement, BBM/BBK Pertamina, CPO, Fertilizer, Pulp, and package goods transportation on baggage trains. In 2024.
2. Integration of coal commodity applications between PT KAI and PT Bukit Asam.

Pendapatan pada segmen ini umumnya berasal dari pendapatan suplisi, bagasi, pendapatan administrasi pembatalan tiket, loading unloading, jasa prapurna, service on train serta restorasi dari anak perusahaan.
Pada tahun 2024 pendapatan jasa pendukung angkutan KA mencapai Rp1,01 triliun atau 98,1% dari target. Realisasi pendapatan mengalami penurunan dikarenakan oleh penurunan komoditi dan pemberhentian sementara kegiatan bongkar muat dibeberapa relasi sehingga berdampak pada pendapatan loading dan unloading.
KINERJA JASA NON-ANGKUTAN Segmen jasa non-angkutan KAI meliputi beberapa komponen, yaitu pendapatan optimalisasi aset, pekerjaan pihak ketiga dan lainnya dengan rincian sebagai berikut: • Pendapatan Optimalisasi Aset Pendapatan optimalisasi aset merupakan pendapatan sewa menyewa properti di dalam dan di luar stasiun. Pendapatan ini meliputi sewa sarana, sewa lahan parkir, sewa bufet/kios stasiun, sewa gudang/ruang stasiun, sewa rumah peristirahatan, sewa mes dan wisma, sewa rumah perusahaan, sewa bangunan, dan sewa tanah.
• Pekerjaan Pihak Ketiga Pekerjaan pihak ketiga merupakan pendapatan yang berasal dari penjualan jasa teknis. Pendapatan ini meliputi perawatan kereta makan, perawatan rangka dasar, dan pendapatan penjualan jasa pekerjaan teknis.
• Pendapatan Non-Angkutan Lainnya Pendapatan non-angkutan lainnya meliputi periklanan/ advertising, percetakan, kesehatan medis, pengembalian kas TGR.
3. Non-railway transportation cooperation, namely a cooperation agreement with KAI Logistik subsidiaries or other third parties to handle Lo-Lo.
4. Implementation of the NLE program for the integration and synergy of the NLE program for the integration and synergy of railway lines with ports through an MoU between PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) and PSA Indonesia PTE, LTD 5. Product synergy for the integration of end-to-end multimodal general cargo (Genco) transportation across islands by involving KAI Logistik subsidiaries and other third parties RAILWAY TRANSPORTATION SUPPORTING SERVICES PERFORMANCE Railway transportation supporting services consist of pre-finish, loading and unloading services, on-train services, and restoration services, among others. Revenue in this segment primarily comes from supply revenue, baggage fees, ticket cancellation administration, loading/unloading, pre-finish services, on-train services, and restoration services from subsidiaries. In 2024, revenue from supporting services for rail transportation reached Rp1.01 trillion, which is 98.1% of the target. Revenue realization decreased due to a decrease in commodities and the temporary suspension of loading and unloading activities in several relations, which had an impact on loading and unloading revenue.
NON-TRANSPORTATION SERVICES PERFORMANCE KAI’s non-transportation service segment includes several components, namely asset optimization revenue, third-party work, and others, detailed as follows: • Asset Optimization Revenue Asset Optimization Revenue consists of rental income from properties inside and outside stations. It includes rental of Rolling Stock, parking spaces, station buffets/ kiosks, warehouses/station rooms, rest houses, dormitories and guesthouses, company houses, buildings, and land.
• Third-Party Work Third-Party Work consists of revenue from the sale of technical services. It includes the maintenance of dining cars, underframe maintenance, and revenue from the sale of technical work services.

Kilometer penumpang adalah perkalian antara kilometer tempuh dengan jumlah volume penumpang. Realisasi di atas anggaran, dikarenakan tercapainya target volume penumpang KRL dan volume KA jarak jauh lainnya, serta terdapat rerouting KA Argo Parahyangan menjadi KA rute baru dengan jarak lebih jauh, perpanjangan relasi KA Blambangan Ekspres sampai dengan Stasiun Pasarsenen dan Perpanjangan relasi KA Bandara BIAS semula relasi Klaten - Stasiun Bandara Adi Soemarmo menjadi Stasiun Bandara Adi Soemarmo - Madiun per 10 Desember 2024.
Kilometer Ton Angkutan Barang Secara total realisasi sebesar 19.995.600 Km-ton atau 103,4% dari anggarannya sebesar 19.343.689 Km-ton. Kilometer ton angkutan barang adalah perkalian antara kilometer tempuh dengan jumlah ton. Realisasi km-ton barang di atas anggaran dikarenakan oleh: • Tercapainya Angkutan Batubara PT BA Tarahan dan Kertapati; • Terdapat kerjasama dengan mitra baru peti kemas di tahun berjalan; • Peningkatan Angkutan BBM di beberapa daerah Kinerja Pelayanan dan Keselamatan No Uraian / Description Satuan / Unit Realisasi 2023 / 2023 Realization Tahun / Year 2024 Rasio / Ratio (%) Toleransi / Tolerance Realisasi / Realization (6-4):4 1 2 3 4 5 6 1 WPG (Rata-rata)* / WPG (Average)* Hari / Day 1,69 2,01 1,44 (14,6) 2 Lokomotif Mogok / Locomotive Breakdowns Frekuensi / Frequency 207 509 218 5,3 3 Kecelakaan KA / Train Accideng Frekuensi / Frequency 8 11 5 (37,5) *) Untuk bagian ini, semakin tinggi fakta menunjukkan kinerja yang menurun / The higher the value of this factor, the worse the performance was.
Waktu Peredaran Gerbong (WPG) Realisasi waktu peredaran gerbong rata-rata 1,44 hari atau 71,8% terhadap toleransi yaitu 2,01 hari. Fakta di bawah toleransi menandakan kinerja operasi baik hal ini dikarenakan terpenuhinya gerbong SO untuk memenuhi stamformasi KA barang atas permintaan customer, berkurangnya kelambatan KA barang, serta memaksimalkan penggunaan gerbong SO, dan program WPG 2024.
Passenger Transportation Kilometers The total achieved was 28,770,159 Km-pnp, which is 103.1% of the budgeted amount of 27,912,529 Km-pnp. Passenger kilometers are calculated by multiplying the kilometers traveled by the number of passengers. The budget surplus is attributed to several factors, including the successful achievement of KRL passenger targets and an increase in long-distance train volumes. Additionally, the rerouting of the Argo Parahyangan train to a longer route, the extension of the Blambangan Ekspres train service to Pasarsenen Station, and the expansion of the BIAS Airport Train service, which now travels from Adi Soemarmo Airport Station to Madiun instead of just from Klaten to Adi Soemarmo Airport Station, effective December 10, 2024, all contributed to this increase.
Freight Transportation Ton Kilometers The total achieved was 19,995,600 Km-tons, which is 103.4% of the budgeted amount of 19,343,689 Km-tons. Kilometer-tons for goods transport are calculated by multiplying the kilometers traveled by the number of tons transported. The reasons for exceeding the budget include: • Successful transportation of coal by PT BA at Tarahan and Kertapati. • New partnerships established with container transport companies this year. • An increase in fuel transportation across several areas.
Service and Safety Performance Carriage Circulation Time (WPG) The average carriage circulation time achieved is 1.44 days, which represents 71.8% of the tolerance limit of 2.01 days. This performance, being below the tolerance threshold, indicates good operational efficiency. This success can be attributed to the effective deployment of SO carriages to meet freight train transformations as requested by customers. Additionally, it reflects reduced delays in freight trains, maximized utilization of SO carriages, and the initiatives outlined in the 2024 WPG program.
193 Annual and Sustainability Report 2024 | PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) Analisis dan Pembahasan Manajemen Management Discussion and Analysis Lokomotif Mogok Realisasi frekuensi lokomotif mogok tahun 2024 terdapat 218 kejadian atau 42,8% terhadap normal kendalinya (toleransi) sebanyak 509 kejadian. Realisasi lokomotif mogok di bawah toleransi. Kategori gangguan yang terjadi pada lokomotif selama tahun 2024 yaitu sistem kontrol listrik (L) 74 kali, motor diesel (MD) 61 kali, traksi motor (TM) 31 kali, sistem udara tekan (SUT) 18 kali, main generator (MG) 14 kali, Governoor (GOV) sebanyak 9 kali, mekanik bawah (MB) 7 kali, dan mekanik atas (MA) 4 kali. Fakta di bawah toleransi menunjukkan kinerja yang lebih baik, disebabkan karena peningkatan frekuensi perawatan lokomotif yang dilakukan secara berkala dan optimalserta adanya kontrak kerjasama spare part perawatan sarana dengan pabrikan.
Kecelakaan KA Selama periode tahun 2024 terjadi 5 kali kejadian kecelakaan KA yang terdiri dari: Daop 1 Jakarta 1 kejadian, Daop 2 Bandung 2 kejadian, Daop 8 Surabaya 1 kejadian, dan Divre I Sumatera Utara 1 kejadian. Manajemen senantiasa melakukan evaluasi penyebab kecelakaan tersebut dan memastikan kejadian tersebut tidak terjadi lagi melalui koordinasi dengan pihak eksternal, memastikan budaya keselamatan telah dipahami dan diterapkan oleh seluruh Insan KAI, serta mengimplementasikan sistem manajemen keselamatan perkeretaapian.
Kinerja Pelayanan dan Keselamatan Manajemen memastikan kejadian tersebut tidak terjadi lagi melalui koordinasi dengan pihak eksternal serta memastikan budaya keselamatan telah dipahami dan diterapkan oleh seluruh insan KAI.

This figure is below the tolerance limit, indicating improved performance. The breakdown incidents were categorized as follows: electrical control system (L) - 74 times, diesel motor (MD) - 61 times, traction motor (TM) - 31 times, compressed air system (SUT) - 18 times, main generator (MG) - 14 times, governor (GOV) - 9 times, lower mechanics (MB) - 7 times, and upper mechanics (MA) - 4 times. This improved performance is due to an increase in the frequency and quality of periodic locomotive maintenance, as well as a cooperative maintenance contract for spare parts with the manufacturer.
Train Accidents In 2024, there were a total of 5 train accidents: 1 incident in Daop 1 Jakarta, 2 incidents in Daop 2 Bandung, 1 incident in Daop 8 Surabaya, and 1 incident in Divre I North Sumatra. Management is actively evaluating the causes of these accidents to prevent future occurrences. This includes coordination with external parties, ensuring that a safety culture is properly understood and implemented by all KAI personnel, and the execution of a comprehensive railway safety management system.
Service and Safety Performance Management is committed to preventing future incidents through collaboration with external parties and by reinforcing a safety culture that is well understood and implemented by all KAI personnel.

RATA-RATA KETEPATAN KA Ketepatan KA Penumpang KA penumpang berangkat mengalami rata-rata ketepatan 99,77% menit dari toleransi 99,10 menit, sedangkan KA penumpang datang mengalami rata-rata ketepatan 96,05 menit dari toleransi 92,00 menit. Realisasi persentase ketepatan KA penumpang berangkat berada di atas toleransi AVERAGE TRAIN DELAY Passenger Train Delay Passenger trains departing experienced an average delay of 0.09 minutes, exceeding the tolerance of 0.30 minutes. Meanwhile, passenger trains arriving had an average delay of (3.54) minutes, also surpassing the tolerance of 2.00 minutes. The percentage of departing passenger trains that exceeded the delay tolerance was attributed to the optimal readiness of the facilities used, the reliability of the infrastructure, the arrangement of passenger flow and information to passengers at the departure station which was good, the regularity in the arrangement and control of train operations, and the low level of disruptions that occurred at the train departure stations.
Freight Train Delay Freight trains departing experienced an average delay of (76.37) minutes, exceeding the tolerance of 5.00 minutes. On the other hand, freight trains arriving had an average delay of (75.41) minutes, which was above the tolerance of 10.00 minutes. The percentage of departing freight trains that exceeded the delay tolerance was due to the optimization of the capacity of the freight train departure station yard supported by the reliability of facilities and infrastructure as well as the role of the freight transportation unit in coordinating and providing information to expeditors or users of freight train transportation services.
AVERAGE TRAIN PUNCTUALITY Passenger Train Punctuality Departing passenger trains had an average punctuality of 99.77 minutes, from a tolerance of 99.10 minutes. Arrival passenger trains experienced an average punctuality of 96.05 minutes, from a tolerance of 92.00 minutes. ASPEK PEMASARAN Menghadapi dinamika pasar yang semakin kompetitif, Perseroan terus berupaya memperkuat strategi pemasarannya secara terintegrasi. Fokus utama KAI adalah melanjutkan strategi penetrasi pasar yang sudah berjalan sebelumnya baik pada angkutan penumpang maupun angkutan barang. Langkah ini dilakukan untuk memastikan produk dan layanan Perseroan dapat menjangkau target konsumen secara efektif dan berkelanjutan.
KAI memiliki media sosial, website dan Access by KAI sebagai sarana komunikasi terkait produk dan jasa. KAI juga mengomunikasikan perkembangan ketentuan-ketentuan yang berlaku sebagai syarat naik kereta api serta informasi layanan terbaru dari KAI. KAI melakukan penjualan secara langsung kepada konsumen melalui sejumlah event dan kegiatan promosi. Terdapat 2 (dua) aspek pemasaran yang dilakukan oleh KAI yaitu pemasaran above the line dan pemasaran below the line. Pemasaran above the line dilakukan dengan cara sosialisasi dan promosi melalui media sosial dengan memanfaatkan trafik tinggi sehingga dapat langsung berinteraksi dengan target konsumen melalui media sosial dan media internal KAI. KAI juga membuat video berisi konten liputan khusus, peluncuran fitur Access by KAI, maupun inovasi terbaru dari KAI lainnya yang ditayangkan melalui media sosial, di stasiun-stasiun, serta di kereta api.
Sedangkan aspek pemasaran below the line dilakukan dengan sosialisasi maupun aktivasi yang meningkatkan brand image KAI. Misalnya melalui event yang dijalankan dengan menyasar kaum milenial, meningkatkan engagement KAI dengan pelanggan dengan kegiatan Sapa Pelanggan; surprise gift bagi pelanggan yang loyal; member Access by KAI; serta melakukan sponsorship untuk menambah aktivasi bagi pengguna KAI Access. so that passenger occupancy has also started to increase, as well as the impact of the many holidays and joint leave set by the Government so that it stimulates the growth of the number of passengers during the peak season and allows for additional frequencies and maximization of stamformation adjusted to demand.
MARKETING ASPECT In response to increasingly competitive market dynamics, the Company is committed to strengthening its integrated marketing strategy. KAI’s primary focus is to continue the market penetration strategies for both passenger and freight transportation, ensuring that the Company’s products and services effectively and sustainably reach target consumers.
KAI utilizes social media, a dedicated website, and the Access by KAI application to communicate information about its products and services. They also provide updates on policies and conditions for boarding trains, along with the latest service information. Direct sales to consumers are conducted through various events and promotional activities.
KAI employs 2 (two) marketing strategies: above-the-line marketing and below-the-line marketing. Above-the-line marketing includes social media outreach and promotions utilizing high-traffic platforms, ensuring that KAI’s internal media can directly interact with target consumers. KAI produces videos featuring special coverage, launches of the Access by KAI feature, and other innovations, which are shared on social media, at train stations, and on trains.
Below-the-line marketing is carried out through outreach and activation activities to enhance KAI’s brand image. This includes events targeting millennials, customer engagement initiatives like Sapa Pelanggan, surprise gifts for loyal customers, Access by KAI membership benefits, and sponsorship activities to enhance KAI Access user engagement.
197 Annual and Sustainability Report 2024 | PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) Analisis dan Pembahasan Manajemen Management Discussion and Analysis Integrasi dan Aliansi KAI terus berupaya meningkatkan kerja sama dengan berbagai pihak untuk memaksimalkan saluran penjualan, baik di channel Business to Business (B2B) dan e-commerce. Sepanjang tahun 2024 KAI menjalin kerja sama mitra B2B dan mitra lainnya guna meningkatkan layanan di Access by KAI. Selain itu, KAI juga menjalin kerja sama intermoda untuk layanan first mile dan last mile untuk memberikan pelayanan lebih kepada pelanggan. KAI juga telah melakukan integrasi dengan sejumlah pihak ketiga.
Strategi Harga KAI telah menerapkan strategi penentuan tarif harga pada segmen angkutan penumpang, dengan rincian sebagai berikut: 1. Setting tarif masih pada range TBA (Tarif Batas Atas) –TBB (Tarif Batas Bawah).
2. Penyesuaian tarif pada masa low dan peak season.
3. Penerapan tarif promo pada masa- masa tertentu. 4. Promosi tarif khusus.
5. Memberikan potongan harga tiket bagi lansia, wartawan dan berbagai instansi lainnya yang sudah bekerja sama dengan Perusahaan (TNI, POLRI, LVRI, Alumni dan Civitas Universitas).
Pemasaran & Branding Dalam mencapai visi dan misinya, KAI telah merumuskan sejumlah inisiatif strategis dan juga enabler untuk KAI. KAI berhasil mengembangkan enablers yang mencakup Budaya & SDM, Manajemen Sarana, Manajemen Prasarana & Fasilitas, Manajemen Pihak eksternal, Ketangguhan Finansial, Teknologi Informasi, Keunggulan Operasi serta pemasaran & Branding. Adapun langkah pemasaran dan branding yang dilakukan oleh KAI di antaranya: Pemasaran • Targeted campaigns dengan marketing automation.
• Cross-promotion dan marketing bersama dengan mitra usaha (termasuk mitra transportasi antarmoda).
• Implementasi green-oriented marketing.
• Pengembangan dan implementasi customer reward and appreciation program.
• Layanan Entertainment on Board.
Branding • Penyusunan strategi komunikasi jangka panjang.
• Pemenuhan KPI TJSL yang telah ditetapkan oleh RUPS setiap tahun.
Integration and Alliances KAI is committed to improving cooperation with various stakeholders to maximize sales channels for both Business to Business (B2B) and e-commerce. Throughout 2024, KAI collaborated with B2B partners and others to enhance services through Access by KAI. In addition, KAI also established intermodal cooperation for first mile and last mile services to provide better service to customers. KAI has also integrated with a number of third parties.
Pricing Strategy KAI has implemented a pricing strategy for the passenger transportation segment, which includes the following components: 1. Tariff setting within the range of TBA (Upper Limit Tariff) to TBB (Lower Limit Tariff).
2. Adjustments to tariffs during low and peak seasons.
3. Special promotional tariffs during certain periods.
4. Specific tariff promotions.
5. Ticket discounts for the elderly, journalists, and various agencies collaborating with the Company, including TNI, POLRI, LVRI, and university alumni.
Marketing & Branding To achieve its vision and mission, KAI has formulated several strategic initiatives and enablers. The Company has developed supports that include Culture & HR, Facilities Management, Infrastructure & Facilities Management, External Party Management, Financial Resilience, Information Technology, Operational Excellence, and Marketing & Branding. KAI’s marketing and branding initiatives include: Marketing • Targeted campaigns utilizing marketing automation.
• Cross-promotion with business partners, including those in intermodal transportation.
• Implementation of green-oriented marketing.
• Development of customer reward and appreciation programs.
• Onboard entertainment services.
Branding • Long-term communication strategy development.
• Fulfillment of CSR KPIs set by the GMS each year.

15.724.812.499 19,32 ASET Hingga 31 Desember 2024, realisasi aset KAI mencapai Rp97,10 triliun, mengalami peningkatan sebesar 19,32% atau sejumlah Rp15,72 triliun jika dibandingkan dengan realisasi tahun 2023 sebesar Rp81,37 triliun. Peningkatan nilai aset Perusahaan disebabkan oleh meningkatnya nilai aset lancar dan aset tidak lancar.
Aset Lancar Hingga 31 Desember 2024, Perusahaan mencatatkan nilai aset lancar sejumlah Rp16,83 triliun, mengalami peningkatan sebesar 29,19% atau sejumlah Rp3,80 triliun jika dibandingkan dengan perolehan aset lancar dari tahun sebelumnya sebesar Rp13,02 triliun. Perubahan ini disebabkan oleh meningkatnya nilai piutang usaha meliputi piutang berelasi sebesar 58,48% dan piutang lain-lain sebesar 3.938,08%.
Kas dan Setara Kas Hingga 31 Desember 2024, kas dan setara kas Perusahaan sejumlah Rp4,93 triliun, mengalami penurunan sebesar 4,14% atau sejumlah Rp212,61 miliar jika di bandingkan perolehan tahun sebelumnya sebesar Rp5,14 triliun. Perubahan ini disebabkan oleh menurunnya nilai deposito berjangka pihak berelasi.
ASSETS As of December 31, 2024, KAI's total asset realization reached Rp97.10 trillion, an increase of 19.32% or Rp15.72 trillion compared to 2023 at Rp81.37 trillion. This was attributed to the increase in current assets and non-current assets.
Current Assets As of December 31, 2024, the Company reported current assets of Rp16.83 trillion. This amount reflects an increase/ of 29.19% or Rp3.80 trillion from the previous year’s total of Rp13.02 trillion. This change was due to the increase in the value of trade receivables including related receivables of 58.48% and other receivables of 3,938.08%.
Cash and Cash Equivalents As of December 31, 2024, the Company's cash and cash equivalents amounted to Rp4.93 trillion, which is a decrease of 4.14% or Rp212.61 billion compared to that of 2023 at Rp5.14 trillion. This change was caused by a decrease in the value of related party time deposits. 201 Annual and Sustainability Report 2024 | PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) Analisis dan Pembahasan Manajemen Management Discussion and Analysis Dana Dibatasi Penggunaannya (Dalam ribuan rupiah) Uraian / Description 2024 2023 Kenaikan (Penurunan) / Increase (Decrease) Nominal / Nominal Persentase / Percentage Pihak Berelasi / Related Parties 3.268.240.606 2.560.880.158 707.360.448 27,62 Pihak Ketiga / Third Parties PT Bank Central Asia Tbk 26.932.515 26.932.515 0 0,00 China Development Bank 14.983 -14.983 100,00 Jumlah / Total 3.295.188.104 2.587.812.673 707.375.431 27,33 Hingga 31 Desember 2024, dana dibatasi penggunaannya tercatat sebesar Rp3,30 triliun, mengalami peningkatan sebesar 27,33% atau sejumlah Rp707,38 miliar jika dibandingkan dengan tahun sebelumnya sebesar Rp2,59 triliun. Pendapatan Masih Akan Diterima (Dalam ribuan rupiah) Uraian / Description 2024 2023 Kenaikan (Penurunan) / Increase (Decrease) Nominal / Nominal Persentase / Percentage Pihak Berelasi - Neto / Related Parties - Net 912.721.971 439.036.344 473.685.627 107,89 Pihak Ketiga / Third Parties 332.746.667 324.703.696 8.042.971 2,48 Pendapatan Masih akan Diterima / Accrued Expenses 1.245.468.638 763.740.040 481.728.598 63,07 Pendapatan yang masih akan diterima terdiri dari pendapatan yang masih akan diterima dari pihak berelasi dan pendapatan yang masih akan diterima dari pihak ketiga. Pendapatan yang masih akan diterima dari pihak berelasi di antaranya adalah kompensasi kewajiban pelayanan publik (PSO) yang merupakan tagihan kepada Pemerintah atas kompensasi PSO berdasarkan Perjanjian antara Direktorat Jenderal Perkeretaapian dengan Perusahaan.
Di tahun 2024, Perusahaan memperoleh nilai pendapatan yang masih akan diterima sejumlah Rp1,25 miliar atau sebesar 63,07% dari perolehan tahun 2023 sebesar Rp763,74 miliar. Perubahan ini disebabkan oleh meningkatnya nilai pendapatan masih akan diterima dari pihak berelasi sebesar 107,89%.
The Company recorded a good value of other receivables, increasing by 3,938% or Rp2.49 trillion when compared to the realization in 2023 of Rp61.59 billion. This change was due to the increase in the value of receivables from related parties and third parties.
Inventories (In thousands of Rupiah) In 2024, the Company recorded inventories of Rp1.22 trillion. This amount decreased by 20.30% or Rp310.30 billion from the previous year of Rp1.53 trillion. This change was caused by the decrease in the value of spare parts for facilities and infrastructure in 2024.
Accrued Income (In thousands of Rupiah) Accrued income includes funds from both related parties and third parties. The accrued income from related parties consists of compensation for public service obligations (PSO), which is a bill submitted to the Government for PSO compensation based on the Agreement between the Directorate General of Railways and the Company.
In 2024, the Company’s accrued income totaled Rp1.25 billion, 63.07% compared to 2023 at Rp763.74 billion. This change can be attributed to the increase in the value of accrued income from related parties, by 107.89%.
