Indikator Keberagaman / Diversity Indicators Persentase / Percentage (%) 1 Persentase perempuan dalam total tenaga kerja / Percentage of women in total workforce 5,63% 2 Persentase perempuan yang menduduki semua posisi manajemen / Percentage of women holding all management positions 5,74% 3 Persentase perempuan yang menduduki semua posisi top manajemen / Percentage of women holding all top management positions 0,07% 4 Persentase perempuan yang menduduki posisi manajemen junior / Percentage of women holding junior management positions 3,57% 5 Persentase perempuan yang menduduki posisi manajemen pada fungsi penghasil pendapatan / Percentage of women holding management positions in revenue-generating functions 0,98% 6 Persentase perempuan yang menduduki posisi terkait STEM (sebagai % dari total posisi STEM) / Percentage of women holding STEM-related positions (as % of total STEM positions) 0,65% Tenaga Kerja Anak dan Tenaga Kerja Paksa [OJK F.19] [GRI 408-1, 409-1] Dalam menjalankan kegiatan usahanya, KAI menentang keras praktik tenaga kerja anak di lingkungan Perseroan. Hal ini tercermin dari kebijakan dan pelaksanaan rekrutmen yang dijalankan sesuai dengan Peraturan Direksi Nomor PER.U/ KH.102/ VII/1/KA2017 tanggal 14 Juli 2017 sebagaimana telah beberapa kali diubah terakhir dengan Peraturan Direksi Nomor PER.U/KH.102/V/1/KA-2021 tanggal 23 September 2021. Kebijakan tersebut mengatur salah satu persyaratan yang wajib dipenuhi oleh Pelamar Pengadaan Pekerja melalui jalur reguler tingkat pendidikan Sekolah Menengah Atas (SMA) adalah berusia minimal 18 (delapan belas) tahun dan maksimal 25 (dua puluh lima) tahun. Penerapan kebijakan tersebut sekaligus merupakan jaminan bahwa KAI tidak mempekerjakan tenaga kerja anak. Sampai dengan 31 Desember 2024, tidak terdapat insiden penggunaan tenaga kerja anak di dalam aktivitas operasional Perseroan.
Selain mengecam keras praktik tenaga kerja anak, KAI juga menentang keras praktik kerja paksa. KAI mengatur jam kerja berdasarkan regulasi ketenagakerjaan yang diatur dalam Perjanjian Kerja Bersama (PKB), yakni 8 jam sehari atau 40 jam environment, enriches the exchange of diverse ideas and perspectives, and improves innovative and problem-solving capabilities. Therefore, KAI is confident that it can attract and retain the best talent, increase employee engagement, and drive higher Company efficiency and performance. PT Kereta Api Indonesia has taken the initiative to increase the portion of women in the workforce and leadership positions. This is shown through the proportion of female employees spread across each management level with the following details.
Child Labor and Forced Labor [OJK F.19] [GRI 408-1, 409-1] In carrying out its business operations, KAI condemns the use of child labor within the Company. This is reflected in its recruitment policy and implementation, in accordance with the Board of Directors Regulation Number PER.U/KH.102/ VII/1/KA-2017 dated July 14, 2017, as amended several times, most recently by the Board of Directors Regulation Number PER.U/KH.102/V/1/KA-2021 dated September 23, 2021. The policy stipulates that one of the requirements for applicants applying through the regular recruitment channel with a high school education level is to be at least 18 (eighteen) years old and no more than 25 (twenty-five) years old. The implementation of this policy ensures that KAI does not employ child labor. As of December 31st, 2023, there have been no incidents of child labor in the Company’s operational activities.
In addition to strongly condemning child labor practices, KAI strongly opposes forced labor practices. KAI regulates working hours according to employment regulations outlined in the Collective Labor Agreement (PKB), with employees working 8 619 Annual and Sustainability Report 2024 | PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) Laporan Keberlanjutan Sustainability Report dalam seminggu. Pelaksanaan sistem shift dilakukan sesuai dengan ketentuan hukum yang berlaku, termasuk batas jam kerja maksimum. Sistem shift memungkinkan operasional kereta api 24 jam, namun tetap menjaga hak istirahat dan kesejahteraan pekerja. KAI juga memberikan hak cuti dan hari libur kepada pekerja, antara lain berupa cuti tahunan, cuti sakit, cuti menikah, cuti melahirkan/keguguran, cuti membaptiskan anak, cuti menikahkan anak, cuti istri melahirkan, cuti besar, cuti haid, cuti keagamaan, cuti menikah, cuti mengkhitankan anak, cuti menghadiri wisuda anak, cuti keluarga sakit, cuti istri melahirkan/keguguran, dan cuti keluarga meninggal. Di samping itu, Perseroan mengikutsertakan seluruhnya pada program jaminan sosial pemerintah untuk kesehatan, kecelakaan, jaminan hari tua serta pensiun, dan kematian. KAI juga terbuka dengan umpan balik dan musyawarah bersama pekerja. [GRI 401-2] Di sisi lain, sebagai bentuk dukungan terhadap implementasi hak asasi manusia, KAI berkomitmen untuk menjalin kerja sama dengan mitra bisnis yang memiliki prinsip dan kepedulian yang sama dengan KAI, yaitu tidak mempekerjakan pekerja anak dan kerja di bawah paksaan. Kami memastikan bahwa seluruh (100%) mitra usaha kami telah lolos seleksi standar sosial yang tinggi dan patuh terhadap regulasi dan kebijakan yang berlaku. Atas upaya itu, semua rantai pasok kami tidak memiliki dampak sosial negatif aktual dan signifikan sebagaimana yang tercantum pada Peraturan Direksi PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) No: PER.U/KM.101/VII/1/KA-2022 tentang Pedoman Pengadaan Barang dan Jasa. [GRI 2-27, 414-1, 414-2] Cuti Melahirkan [GRI 401-3] Sebagai upaya menyeluruh dalam memastikan pemenuhan hak-hak pekerja, KAI memberikan hak cuti melahirkan sesuai ketentuan perundang-undangan yang berlaku. Hak cuti melahirkan diberikan kepada seluruh pekerja perempuan dan hak cuti istri melahirkan bagi seluruh pekerja laki-laki. Pekerja perempuan yang akan melahirkan mendapatkan hak cuti sejumlah 3 (tiga) bulan, sedangkan pekerja laki-laki dengan istri melahirkan mendapatkan hak cuti sejumlah 3 (tiga) hari kerja. Ketentuan hak cuti melahirkan diatur melalui Peraturan Direksi Nomor PER. U/KH.201/IX/1/KA-2022 tentang Izin Tidak Masuk Bekerja dan/atau Tidak Melakukan Pekerjaan.
hours a day or 40 hours a week. The implementation of the shift system is carried out in accordance with applicable legal provisions, including maximum working hour limits. The shift system allows 24-hour train operations, but still maintains the right to rest and employee welfare.
KAI also grants leave and holidays to employees, including annual leave, sick leave, marriage leave, maternity/ miscarriage leave, child baptism leave, child marriage leave, spouse’s maternity leave, long leave, menstrual leave, religious leave, marriage leave, circumcision leave, attendance at children's graduations leave, family illness leave, spouse's miscarriage leave, and family bereavement leave. Furthermore, the Company includes all of them in the government social security programs for health, accident, old-age benefits, pensions, and death. KAI is open to feedback and consultations with employees as well. [GRI 401-2] On the other hand, as a form of support for the implementation of human rights, KAI is committed to collaborating with business partners who share KAI’s principles and concerns regarding the prohibition of child labor and forced labor. We ensure that all (100%) of our business partners undergo rigorous social standards selection and comply with relevant regulations and policies. Therefore, all our supply chains are free from any actual and significant negative social impacts, as stated in the Board of Directors Regulation of PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) No: PER.U/KM.101/VII/1/KA-2022 on Procurement Guidelines for Goods and Services. [GRI 2-27, 414-1, 414-2] Maternity Leave [GRI 401-3] As a comprehensive effort to ensure the fulfillment of employee rights, KAI provides maternity leave in accordance with applicable laws and regulations. Maternity leave rights are granted to all female employees and paternity leave rights to male employees whose wives are giving birth. Female employees who are about to give birth are entitled to 3 (three) months of leave, while male employees whose wives are giving birth are entitled to 3 (three) working days of leave. The provision of maternity leave for KAI employees is regulated through the Director's Regulation Number PER.U/KH.201/ IX/1/KA-2022 concerning Leave of Absence from Work and/ or Not Performing Work.

Dalam menetapkan besaran remunerasi pekerja mengacu pada standar pemenuhan kebutuhan hidup serta peraturan perundang-undangan yang berlaku terkait penetapan besaran gaji pekerja. Kami menjamin bahwa seluruh pekerja telah mendapatkan hak pemberian upah sesuai ketentuan Kementerian Ketenagakerjaan berdasarkan kota/kabupaten wilayah operasional mereka bekerja. Kami juga memastikan tidak ada perbedaan dalam besaran remunerasi berdasarkan jenis kelamin maupun faktor SARA. Dengan demikian, gaji gaji pokok dan remunerasi antara pekerja pria dan wanita KAI diberikan secara adil dan setara, yakni 1:1.
Sebagai wujud komitmen KAI dalam menyalurkan nilai ekonomi bagi pekerja sebagai pemangku kepentingan yang signifikan untuk keberlanjutan usaha, Perseroan telah memastikan bahwa upah yang diterima oleh pekerja pada tingkat paling rendah telah memenuhi atau melebihi besaran upah minimum yang ditetapkan peraturan perundangan-undangan yang berlaku. In 2024, 1,576 female employees took their maternity leave rights, and 100% of them returned to work. The number of people taking maternity leave decreased compared to the previous year by 1,534 people, and 100% have returned to work.
Employee Remuneration Policy [OJK F.20] [GRI 2-19, 202-1] KAI pays attention to employee remuneration as a form of supporting the realization of employee welfare. Determining the amount of employee remuneration refers to the standards for meeting living needs and the applicable laws and regulations related to employee salary determination.
We ensure that all employees receive wages in accordance with the Ministry of Manpower’s provisions based on the city/district of their operational work areas. We also ensure that there is no discriminatory practice in the amount of remuneration based on gender or SARA factors. Therefore, basic salaries and remuneration between male and female KAI employees are given fairly and equally, namely 1:1.
As a form of KAI’s commitment to providing economic value to employees as a significant stakeholder in business sustainability, the Company ensures that wages received by employees at the lowest levels meet or exceed the minimum wage determined by applicable laws and regulations.

Sebagai bentuk apresiasi atas pengabdian dan dedikasi pekerja yang telah bekerja dan berkontribusi terhadap kemajuan dan keberlanjutan bisnis KAI dalam jangka waktu yang lama, KAI berkomitmen memenuhi kesejahteraan pekerja secara menyeluruh hingga setelah berakhirnya masa kerja. Merujuk pada Peraturan Direksi Nomor PER.U/ KH.401/I/2/ KA-2023 tentang Penghasilan Pekerja Perjanjian Kerja Waktu Tidak Tertentu, pekerja KAI mendapatkan jaminan sosial hari tua dan pensiun wajib pemerintah. Besaran tunjangan pensiun yang diberikan oleh Perseroan telah diungkapkan pada bagian Tata Kelola Keberlanjutan dalam Laporan Tahunan dan Keberlanjutan ini.
KAI juga memberikan pelatihan kepada para pekerja yang akan memasuki pensiun. Pelatihan diberikan sejak kurang 3 tahun sebelum memasuki masa pensiun. Pelatihan tersebut bertujuan untuk mempersiapkan individu memasuki masa pensiun dengan lebih baik dan sejahtera, baik secara finansial, emosional, maupun psikologis. Comparison of Minimum Wage and Lowest Employee Compensation [GRI 3-3, 202-1, 405-2] Employee Welfare After the End of Employment Period [GRI 201-3, 3-3, 404-1, 404-2] The Company sets the employee retirement age at 56 years. As an appreciation for the devotion and dedication of employees who have worked and contributed to the progress and sustainability of KAI's business for a long period of time, KAI is committed to fulfilling employee welfare in its entirety until after the end of their employment period. Referring to the Board of Directors Regulation No. PER.U/KH.401/I/2/ KA-2023 on Income of Workers with Indefinite Employment Agreements, KAI employees receive old-age social security and mandatory government pensions. The amount of pension benefits provided by the Company has been disclosed in the Sustainability Governance section of this Annual and Sustainability Report.
KAI also provides training to employees who will retire. Training is provided since less than 3 years before entering retirement. The training aims to prepare individuals to enter retirement better and more prosperously, both financially, emotionally, and psychologically.
622 PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) | Laporan Tahunan dan Keberlanjutan 2024 Memperkuat Layanan dan Menjamin Keselamatan untuk Wujudkan Keberlanjutan Empowering Services and Ensuring Safety to Cultivate Sustainability Selain memberikan pelatihan, tiga bulan sebelum memasuki masa pensiun, Perseroan melakukan sosialisasi persiapan pensiun kepada seluruh (100%) pekerja dengan masa kerja 3 bulan. Dengan manfaat-manfaat yang diterima, Perseroan berharap seluruh pekerja dapat memiliki masa pensiun yang sejahtera dan berkualitas. Pada tahun 2024 jumlah pekerja KAI yang memasuki masa pensiun mencapai 459 orang.
Lingkungan Bekerja yang Layak dan Aman [OJK F.21] Aspek kenyamanan pekerja di tempat kerja merupakan salah satu perhatian manajemen KAI. Atas dasar itu, KAI senantiasa mengupayakan terciptanya lingkungan bekerja yang layak dan aman bagi seluruh pekerja. Perseroan menyediakan fasilitas kerja yang layak bagi pekerja dengan menyediakan beragam fasilitas yang nyaman, bersih, dan aman, berupa ruang kerja, toilet, dan ruang makan. KAI juga menyediakan fasilitas lain bagi pekerja, berupa tempat ibadah, kantin, pantry, area terbuka hijau, serta tempat parkir yang luas. Untuk meningkatkan keamanan, gedung KAI sudah memiliki alat deteksi asap serta fasilitas pembuangan sampah yang terintegrasi. Selain itu, pengelolaan kebersihan dilakukan secara terjadwal melalui penugasan cleaning service, yang bertugas setiap hari mengelola kebersihan area kerja baik di dalam maupun luar ruangan. Lingkungan kerja yang nyaman, aman, dan sehat juga tercermin melalui upaya Perseroan menghadirkan fasilitas kesehatan yang berkualitas, yaitu Klinik Mediska, yang dapat diakses oleh pekerja dan keluarganya. KAI juga menyediakan sarana dan prasarana olahraga bagi pekerja pada kantor pusat dan daerah yang sekaligus dimanfaatkan sebagai sarana pencapaian prestasi olahraga perusahaan. KAI juga memberikan fasilitas kesenian dan keagamaan bagi pekerja, khususnya di kantor pusat.
Seluruh fasilitas yang tersedia dipastikan dalam kondisi yang layak, aman, bersih, dan sehat. Bahkan lebih dari itu, fasilitas-fasilitas yang ada dilengkapi dengan suasana kerja yang inklusif dan tanpa diskriminasi. Manajemen KAI secara terus-menerus melakukan sosialisasi kepada seluruh pekerja untuk menciptakan lingkungan kerja bebas diskriminasi sebagaimana Surat Edaran Direksi PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) Nomor: SE.U/KL.403/VII/1/KA-2022 tentang Kebijakan Berperilaku Saling Menghargai di Tempat Kerja. In addition to providing training, three months before entering retirement, the Company conducts retirement preparation dissemination to all (100%) employees with a 3-month work period. With the benefits received, the Company hopes that all employees can have a prosperous and quality retirement. In 2024, the number of KAI employees entering retirement reached 459 people. Decent and Safe Working Environment [OJK F.21] The aspect of employee comfort in the workplace is one of KAI management’s concerns. On that basis, KAI always strives to create a decent and safe working environment for all employees. The Company provides adequate working facilities for employees, including comfortable, clean, and safe facilities such as workspaces, toilets, and dining areas. KAI also provides other facilities for employees, such as places of worship, canteens, pantries, green open spaces, and spacious parking areas. The buildings are equipped with smoke detectors and integrated waste disposal facilities. KAI maintains office cleanliness on a scheduled basis through the assignment of a cleaning service, that manages the cleanliness of work areas daily, both indoors and outdoors.
A comfortable, safe, and healthy working environment is also reflected in the Company’s efforts to provide quality health facilities, namely Mediska Clinics, which can be accessed by employees and their families. KAI also provides sports Rolling Stock and infrastructure for employees at the head office and regional offices, which are also used to achieve corporate sports achievements. KAI also offers arts and religious Rolling Stock for employees, especially at the head office.
All facilities are well-maintained, safe, clean, and healthy, complemented by an inclusive and non-discriminatory work environment. KAI Management continuously communicates with all employees to create a discrimination-free work environment as outlined in the Director's Circular of PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) Number: SE.U/KL.403/VII/1/KA-2022 concerning the Respectful Workplace Policy.
623 Annual and Sustainability Report 2024 | PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) Laporan Keberlanjutan Sustainability Report Perseroan mewajibkan seluruh pekerja untuk mengimplementasikan prinsip-prinsip Respectful Workplace Policy seperti mengakui dan menghargai perbedaan yang beragam dengan berbagai macam latar belakang etnis, ras, kebangsaan, warna kulit, usia, agama, jenis kelamin, disabilitas, sudut pandang, atau karakteristik individu lainnya. Dengan menerapkan prinsip-prinsip Respectful Workplace Policy dapat tercipta dan terbangun lingkungan kerja yang saling menghargai dan tidak melakukan diskriminasi, kekerasan, dan pelecehan dalam bentuk apapun. Pada periode 2024, tidak terdapat kejadian diskriminasi dalam bentuk apapun kepada pekerja maupun pelanggan dan mitra di ruang lingkup Perseroan. [GRI 3-3, 406-1] Kepuasan Pekerja Kepuasan pekerja di PT Kereta Api Indonesia merupakan faktor penting dalam mendukung keberhasilan perusahaan secara keseluruhan. Pekerja yang puas cenderung lebih produktif, termotivasi, dan memiliki loyalitas yang tinggi terhadap perusahaan. Hal ini secara langsung berpengaruh pada kualitas pelayanan yang diberikan kepada pelanggan, yang merupakan salah satu prioritas utama PT Kereta Api Indonesia sebagai penyedia transportasi publik. Perhitungan Employee Satisfaction Index (ESI) penting dalam menilai tingkat kepuasan pekerja di sebuah perusahaan. Angka ESI yang tinggi menunjukkan tingkat kepuasan yang baik, yang dapat berdampak positif pada produktivitas, loyalitas, dan retensi pekerja. Hal ini juga membantu perusahaan dalam mengidentifikasi potensi masalah sebelum berdampak lebih besar pada kinerja dan budaya kerja. Tingkat kepuasan pekerja KAI pada tahun 2024 meningkat dibandingkan tahuan 2023, yang mencapai 4,28 (skala 5). Komunitas ini merupakan wadah bagi para perempuan untuk meningkatkan kemampuan dan kepemimpinan. The Company requires all workers to implement the principles of the Respectful Workplace Policy, such as acknowledging and respecting diverse differences including ethnic background, race, nationality, skin color, age, religion, gender, disability, viewpoints, or other individual characteristics. Implementing the Respectful Workplace Policy principles aims to create and build a respectful work environment free from discrimination, violence, and harassment in any form. In 2024, there have been no reported incidents of discrimination in any form towards employees, customers, or partners within the Company. [GRI 3-3, 406-1] Employee Satisfaction Employee satisfaction at PT Kereta Api Indonesia is an important factor in supporting the overall success of the company. Satisfied employees tend to be more productive, motivated, and have high loyalty to the company. This directly affects the quality of service provided to customers, which is one of the main priorities of PT Kereta Api Indonesia as a public transportation provider.
Calculation of the Employee Satisfaction Index (ESI) is important in assessing the level of employee satisfaction in a company. A high ESI number indicates a good level of satisfaction, which can have a positive impact on employee productivity, loyalty, and retention. It also helps companies identify potential problems before they have a greater impact on performance and work culture. KAI's employee satisfaction level in 2024 increased compared to 2023, which reached 4.28 (scale 5). Komitmen kuat Perseroan untuk mendukung kesetaraan gender membawa hasil positif yang dibuktikan dengan pencapaian Perseroan yang kembali berhasil meraih penghargaan Best Woman Empowerment Company 2025 in Encouraging Woman's Right Protection to Provide Comfort and Safety dalam ajang HerStory Indonesia Best Women Empowerment Companies Awards (WECA) 2025. Penghargaan ini diberikan sebagai bentuk apresiasi atas komitmen KAI dalam mendorong perlindungan hak perempuan serta menciptakan lingkungan kerja yang nyaman dan aman bagi perempuan, terutama dalam mendukung keberlanjutan di sektor transportasi. Prestasi ini menjadi bukti bahwa KAI tidak hanya berkomitmen dalam memberikan layanan transportasi yang aman dan nyaman, tetapi juga menjadi pelopor dalam menciptakan lingkungan kerja yang mendukung kesejahteraan perempuan di industri transportasi Indonesia. KAI akan terus berupaya memastikan bahwa setiap perempuan yang bekerja di KAI merasa aman, dihargai, dan memiliki kesempatan yang sama dalam mengembangkan karier mereka. KAI meyakini, dengan lingkungan kerja yang lebih inklusif, KAI bisa menciptakan industri transportasi yang lebih baik dan berkelanjutan.
Keselamatan dan Kesehatan Kerja [GRI 3-3, 403-3, 403-8] Keselamatan dan kesehatan kerja (K3) menjadi prioritas utama bagi KAI mengingat dalam dalam industri perkeretaapian memiliki risiko yang tinggi. Kecelakaan kerja dapat menyebabkan cedera serius atau kematian, yang berdampak pada terhambatnya kinerja operasional Perseroan. KAI memahami, lingkungan kerja yang aman dan sehat tidak hanya melindungi pekerja, tetapi juga meningkatkan produktivitas dan moral kerja. KAI telah memiliki Kebijakan Health, Safety, Security and Environment (HSSE) nomor: KS.102/XII/1/KA-2022. Kebijakan tersebut merupakan wujud nyata atas komitmen PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) dan Anak Perusahaan untuk menjalankan bisnis transportasi perkeretaapian dan kegiatan usaha lainnya mengacu pada nilai-nilai utama Perusahaan AKHLAK untuk mendukung tujuan, visi, dan misi Perusahaan dengan memperhatikan keselamatan dan kesehatan kerja, keselamatan perkeretaapian, keamanan dan perlindungan terhadap lingkungan hidup untuk seluruh pekerja, aktivitas bisnis, dan aset Perusahaan dari segala ancaman kerugian The Company believes that equal rights and opportunities for women will have a sustainable impact on the Company’s business perceptions and decisions. The positive results brought by the Company’s strong commitment to supporting gender equality are proven through the Company’s achievement in winning the Best Woman Empowerment Company 2025 in Encouraging Woman’s Right Protection to Provide Comfort and Safety award at the HerStory Indonesia Best Women Empowerment Companies Awards (WECA) 2025 once again. This award was bestowed as a form of appreciation for KAI’s commitment to encouraging the protection of women’s rights and creating a comfortable and safe working environment for women, especially in supporting sustainability in the transportation sector.
This achievement proves that KAI is not only committed to providing safe and comfortable transportation services, but it also strives to become a pioneer in creating a working environment supporting women’s welfare in the Indonesian transportation industry. KAI will continue ensuring that every woman working at KAI feels safe, appreciated, and has equal opportunities to develop their career. KAI believes that creating a better, more sustainable transportation industry is possible through a more inclusive working environment.
Occupational Health and Safety [GRI 3-3, 403-3, 403-8] Occupational health and safety (OHS) has become the top priority to KAI, considering the high risk in the railway industry. Workplace accidents can cause serious injury or death, which has an impact on obstructing the Company’s operational performance.
KAI understands that a safe and healthy work environment not only protects employees, but also enhances productivity and morale. KAI has a Health, Safety, Security, and Environment (HSSE) Policy number: KS.102/XII/1/KA-2022. The policy is a real manifestation of the commitment of PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) and its subsidiaries to run the railway transportation business and other business operations referring to the Company’s main values AKHLAK to support the Company’s goals, vision, and mission by paying attention to occupational safety and health, railway safety, security and protection of the environment for all workers, business activities and Company assets from all threats of loss.
625 Annual and Sustainability Report 2024 | PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) Laporan Keberlanjutan Sustainability Report Merujuk pada kebijakan tersebut, KAI menerapkan dan meningkatkan kualitas keselamatan dan kesehatan kerja bagi seluruh (100%) pekerja baik tetap maupun mitra. KAI menerapkan standarisasi yang menjamin terpenuhinya keselamatan, kesehatan, dan keamanan di lingkungan kerja sesuai Standar Operasional Perusahaan (SOP). Hal tersebut tercermin melalui penerapan program promotive dan preventive kepada pekerja berupa medical check-up tahunan, pemeriksaan kebugaran pekerja, pemeriksaan awak sarana perkeretaapian sebelum berdinas, dan sosialisasi isu penyakit dan/atau kesehatan untuk pekerja dan keluarga pekerja, serta penerapan protokol kesehatan yang ketat, baik bagi pekerja maupun penumpang, sebagai upaya KAI dalam mencegah penyebaran penyakit menular di area operasional. [GRI 403-8] Selain itu, KAI juga memberikan layanan program konseling pekerja bagi pekerja yang membutuhkan tempat untuk bercerita ataupun mendapatkan dukungan psikologis melalui unit yang disediakan.
Untuk memastikan kesehatan pekerja, KAI memiliki fasilitas kesehatan Klinik Mediska yang memberikan layanan kesehatan bagi pekerja, keluarga pekerja, dan masyarakat. Pemberian fasilitas kesehatan tersebut diatur melalui Peraturan Direksi PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) Nomor PER.A/KL.104/I/1/ KA-2019 tentang Standardisasi Minimum Fasilitas Klinik Mediska. Per 31 Desember 2024, terdapat 55 Klinik Mediska yang dikelola KAI yang tersebar di seluruh wilayah operasional KAI. Di samping itu, KAI memberikan jaminan kesehatan bagi pekerja, keluarga pekerja, hingga calon pekerja, yang diatur melalui Peraturan Direksi PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) Nomor PER.U/KH.405/XI/1/KA-2020 tentang Jaminan Kesehatan. Dengan mengacu pada Peraturan Direksi PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) Nomor PER.U/KI.103/I/ l/KA-2021 tanggal 19 Januari 2021 Tentang Standar Stasiun, setiap stasiun memiliki Fasilitas Pos Kesehatan atau P3K untuk penanganan pertama pada kecelakaan dan insiden gawat darurat yang terjadi pada penumpang maupun pekerja selama 24 jam. [GRI 403-3] Operasional seluruh aktivitas pelayanan kesehatan kerja KAI menjadi tanggung jawab Vice President Health. Unit khusus ini memastikan layanan kesehatan kerja dilaksanakan secara optimal, yaitu dengan perencanaan dan koordinasi pelaksanaan kebijakan yang baik, melalui penyusunan norma serta standar acuan, penetapan serta penerapan prosedur, Referring to the policy, KAI implements and improves the quality of occupational health and safety for all (100%) employees, both permanent and partners. KAI applies standardization that ensures the fulfillment of safety, health, and security in the work environment according to the Company’s Standard Operating Procedures (SOP). This is reflected through the implementation of promotive and preventive programs for workers, such as annual medical check-ups, fitness checks for workers, pre-service examinations for railway personnel, and socialization related to disease and/or health issues for workers and their families, as well as the strict implementation of health protocols for both employees and passengers to prevent the spread of infectious diseases in operational areas. [GRI 403-8] Apart from that, KAI also provides employee counseling program services for employees who need a place to talk or get psychological support through the units provided.
To ensure employee health, KAI has health facilities in the form of Mediska Clinics that provide health services for employees, their families, and the community. The provision of these health facilities is regulated through the Director's Regulation of PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) Number PER.A/ KL.104/I/1/KA-2019 concerning Minimum Standardization of Mediska Clinic Facilities. As of December 31, 2024, there were 55 Mediska Clinics managed by KAI spread across all KAI operational areas. In addition, KAI provides health insurance for employees, their families, and prospective employees, which is regulated through the Board of Directors Regulation of PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) Number PER.U/KH.405/ XI/1/KA-2020 concerning Health Insurance. Referring to the Board of Directors Regulation of PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) Number PER.U/KI.103/I/1/KA-2021 dated January 19, 2021, concerning Station Standards, each station has a Health Post or First Aid (P3K) facility for first aid in accidents and emergency incidents that occur to passengers or employees 24 hours a day. [GRI 403-3] Operational activities of all KAI occupational health services are the responsibility of the Vice President of Health. This special unit ensures optimal implementation of occupational health services, through good policy planning and coordination, the establishment of norms and reference standards, the determination and implementation of procedures, and the 626 PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) | Laporan Tahunan dan Keberlanjutan 2024 Memperkuat Layanan dan Menjamin Keselamatan untuk Wujudkan Keberlanjutan Empowering Services and Ensuring Safety to Cultivate Sustainability hingga pemberian bimbingan serta supervisi bagi pihak pelaksana. Untuk menjaga kinerja operasional berjalan baik, secara berkala KAI melakukan penanganan yang sistematis, terarah, dan terukur terhadap kejadian luar biasa seperti adanya ancaman kesehatan akibat penyakit menular, wabah, epidemi, dan/atau pandemi dengan cara membuat perencanaan, berkoordinasi dan berkolaborasi dengan pihak terkait, serta memantau dan melakukan evaluasi.
Sistem Manajemen Keselamatan dan Kesehatan Kerja [GRI 403-1] Untuk mengoptimalkan pelaksanaan sistem K3, sejak tahun 2020 KAI menerapkan Sistem Manajemen Keselamatan Perkeretaapian (SMKP) yang mengacu pada: a. Peraturan Pemerintah Nomor 50 tahun 2012 tentang Sistem Manajemen Keselamatan dan Kesehatan Kerja; dan b. Peraturan Menteri Perhubungan Nomor PM 69 Tahun 2018 tentang Sistem Manajemen Keselamatan Perkeretaapian. Sesuai dengan Peraturan Direksi Nomor PER.U/ KS.102/III/1/KA-2020, SMKP wajib diterapkan secara berkelanjutan pada setiap satuan organisasi di Kantor Pusat dan Daerah. Implementasi SMKP meliputi keselamatan perkeretaapian serta keselamatan dan kesehatan kerja yang berlaku di seluruh lini bisnis KAI. Untuk mengetahui efektivitas penerapan SMKP, KAI melakukan audit internal SMKP sesuai Peraturan Direksi Nomor PER.S/KS.102/IV/32/KA-2020 tentang Prosedur Audit Internal dalam Sistem Manajemen Keselamatan Perkeretaapian yang telah dilakukan oleh Direktorat Keselamatan dan Keamanan pada tahun 2024. Audit internal pada tahun 2024 telah dilakukan di 14 wilayah Daerah Operasi, Divisi Regional, Balai Yasa Sarana dan Prasarana. Audit Internal SMKP di Daop/Divre maupun Balai Yasa di tahun 2024 dilaksanakan dengan kategori tingkat yang beragam baik tingkat awal, transisi dan lanjutan. KAI memastikan sertifikasi Sistem Manajemen Keselamatan dan Kesehatan Kerja yang dimiliki telah sesuai dengan Peraturan Pemerintah Nomor 50 tahun 2012. Pada tahun 2024, terdapat 1 (satu) wilayah yang telah melakukan resertifikasi dan mendapatkan kembali bendera emas dalam pencapaian penerapan SMK3 dari Kementerian Ketenagakerjaan.
provision of guidance and supervision for the implementing parties. To maintain good operational performance, KAI periodically conducts systematic, directed, and measurable handling of extraordinary events such as health threats due to infectious diseases, outbreaks, epidemics, and/or pandemics by planning, coordinating, and collaborating with related parties, as well as monitoring and evaluating.
Occupational Health and Safety Management System [GRI 403-1] To optimize the implementation of the OHS system, KAI has implemented the Railway Safety Management System (SMKP) since 2020 which refers to: a. Government Regulation Number 50 of 2012 concerning the Implementation of Occupational Health and Safety Management Systems; and b. Minister of Transportation Regulation Number PM 69 of 2018 concerning the Railway Safety Management System. In accordance with the Director's Regulation Number PER.U/KS.102/III/1/KA-2020, SMKP must be continuously implemented in every organizational unit at the Head Office and Regional Offices.
The SMKP implementation includes railway safety as well as occupational health and safety applicable across all KAI business lines. To evaluate the implementation of SMKP, KAI conducts internal SMKP audits in accordance with the Director's Regulation Number PER.S/KS.102/IV/32/KA-2020 concerning Internal Audit Procedures in the Railway Safety Management System, which was carried out by the Directorate of Safety and Security in 2024. In 2024, internal audits were conducted in 14 Operational Areas, Regional Divisions, as well as Facilities and Infrastructure Railway Workshops. Internal Audits of SMKP in Operational Areas/Regional Divisions and Railway Workshops in 2024 were conducted at various level categories, namely initial, transitional, and advanced levels. KAI ensures that the Occupational Health and Safety Management System certification complies with Government Regulation Number 50 of 2012. In 2024, 1 (one) region carried out recertification and once more received the gold flag in achieving the implementation of OHSMS from the Ministry of Manpower.
627 Annual and Sustainability Report 2024 | PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) Laporan Keberlanjutan Sustainability Report Penerapan aspek keselamatan dan kesehatan kerja (K3) yang dijalankan secara terencana dan terstruktur membawa Perseroan berhasil meraih penghargaan dalam bidang keselamatan dan kesehatan kerja pada tahun 2024 pada ajang pengharagaan Indonesia Safety Excellence Award dalam rangkaian OSH’s Asia Summit 2024 dengan kategori sebagai berikut: 1. The Best Safety Management in BUMN Company 2. The Best Safety Program 3. The Most Safety Culture 4. The Best Leadership on OSH Culture Penghargaan ini merupakan bentuk apresiasi terhadap implementasi aspek keselamatan dan kesehatan kerja (K3) yang dijalankan secara baik dan dan berkelanjutan dalam rangka mendukung kemajuan K3 nasional.
Selain menerapkan Sistem Manajemen Keselamatan Perkeretaapian, KAI juga telah menerapkan Sistem Manajemen Lingkungan yang mengacu pada ISO 14001:2015, dimana di dalamnya memasukkan isu eksternal terkait lingkungan yang ada di sekitar Perusahaan mulai tahun 2019 secara bertahap pada Unit Pelaksana Teknis di daerah, yaitu: 1. Sertifikasi ISO 14001:2015 melalui Badan Sertifikasi Sucofindo di Balai Yasa Mekanik Cirebon Prujakan pada Tahun 2019. 2. Sertifikasi ISO 14001:2015 melalui Badan Sertifikasi Sucofindo di Balai Yasa Yogyakarta pada Tahun 2020. 3. Sertifikasi ISO 14001:2015 melalui Badan Sertifikasi Sucofindo di Dipo Lokomotif pada Taf Cirebon Tahun 2022. 4. Sertifikasi ISO 14001:2015 melalui Badan Sertifikasi Sucofindo di Balai Yasa Tegal pada Tahun 2023.
Pada tahun 2024 KAI telah melaksanakan Gap Analisis ISO 14001:2015 di Balai Yasa Surabayagubeng serta awarenes maupun peningkatan kompetensi bidang lingkungan lainnya sebagai dasar dalam penerapan ISO 14001:2015 di tahun 2025. Untuk memastikan penerapan berjalan konsisten, maka Perseroan melakukan Audit Internal ISO 14001:2015 di wilayah-wilayah yang telah mengimplemetasikan ISO 14001:2015, antara lain Balai Yasa Mekanik Cirebonprujakan, Balai Yasa Yogyakarta, Dipo Lokomotif Cirebon, dan Balai Yasa Tegal serta Audit Surivellance oleh badan Sertifikasi ISO 14001:2015, yaitu Sucofindo.
The health, safety, and environment (OHS) implementation carried out in a planned and structured manner managed to make the Company receive awards in the field of occupational health and safety in 2024 at the Indonesia Safety Excellence Award in the OSH’s Asia Summit 2024 series with the following categories: 1. The Best Safety Management in BUMN Company 2. The Best Safety Program 3. The Most Safety Culture 4. The Best Leadership on OSH Culture These awards were given to appreciate the proper and sustainable implementation of occupational health and safety (OHS) aspects in support of national OHS advancement.
In addition to the implementation of the Railway Safety Management System, KAI has also implemented an Environmental Management System that refers to ISO 14001:2015, which includes external issues related to social issues around the Company starting in 2019 gradually at Technical Implementation Units in the regions, namely: 1. ISO 14001:2015 certification through Sucofindo Certification at Balai Yasa Mekanik Cirebon Prujakan in 2019.
2. ISO 14001:2015 certification through Sucofindo Certification at Balai Yasa Yogyakarta in 2020.
3. ISO 14001:2015 certification through Sucofindo Certification at Dipo Lokomotif Cirebon in 2022.
5. ISO 14001:2015 certification through Sucofindo Certification at Balai Yasa Tegal in 2023.
In 2024, KAI implemented ISO 14001:2015 Gap Analysis at Surabayagubeng Railway Workshop as well as awareness and improvement of other environmental competencies as a basis for implementing ISO 14001:2015 in 2025. To ensure consistent implementation, the Company conducted an ISO 14001:2015 Internal Audit in areas that have implemented ISO 14001:2015, including Cirebonprujakan Railway Mechanical Workshop, Yogyakarta Railway Workshop, Cirebon Locomotive Depot, and Tegal Railway Workshop, as well as a Surveillance Audit by the ISO 14001:2015 Certification Agency, namely Sucofindo.
628 PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) | Laporan Tahunan dan Keberlanjutan 2024 Memperkuat Layanan dan Menjamin Keselamatan untuk Wujudkan Keberlanjutan Empowering Services and Ensuring Safety to Cultivate Sustainability Penanggulangan Keadaan Darurat dan Kecelakaan Besar pada Lingkungan Kerja Sebagai perusahaan yang bergerak di bidang industri perkeretaapian, KAI mengelola risiko secara terstruktur agar tidak menimbulkan kerugian operasional. KAI telah menerapkan kebijakan penanggulangan keadaan darurat dan kecelakaan besar yang terjadi di lingkungan kerja. Penanganan awal pada kejadian kecelakaan mengacu pada Instruksi Direksi Nomor 13/KP.501/KA-2012 tentang Pertolongan Pertama Pada Kecelakaan (P3K) di Lingkungan Kerja PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero). Secara spesifik, kebijakan P3K di lingkungan KAI telah mengatur hal-hal terkait (1) petugas P3K di tempat kerja serta (2) fasilitas P3K di tempat kerja, mencakup persyaratan ruang dan kotak P3K.
Sementara penanganan keadaan darurat dan kecelakaan besar di KAI dijalankan sesuai dengan Keputusan Direksi PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) Nomor KEP.U/LL.507/VII/ 2/ KA-2015 tentang Standar Operasional Prosedur Penanganan Kondisi Darurat di Wilayah Stasiun, Depo, Balai Yasa dan Dalam Perjalanan Kereta Api serta Peraturan Direksi PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) Nomor PER.U/KT.204/XII/1/ KA-2018 tentang Standar Operasional Prosedur Tanggap Darurat Gangguan Operasional Kereta Api. KAI juga menerapkan upaya pencegahan dan penanggulangan kebakaran di Balai Yasa Sarana, Balai Yasa Prasarana, Dipo Sarana, Dipo Prasarana, dan Stasiun berdasarkan Keputusan Direksi PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) Nomor KEP.U/ KS.101/XII/2/KA-2016, sebagai upaya penanggulangan keadaan darurat dan kecelakaan besar pada lingkungan kerja.
Induksi Keselamatan kepada Pihak Internal maupun Eksternal KAI menerapkan induksi keselamatan yang diatur melalui Peraturan Direksi PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) Nomor PER-S/ KS.102/IV/26/KA-2020 tentang Prosedur Induksi Keselamatan dalam Sistem Manajemen Keselamatan Perkeretaapian. Penerapan induksi keselamatan merupakan kegiatan untuk mengkomunikasikan informasi Keselamatan Perkeretaapian serta Keselamatan dan Kesehatan Kerja kepada seluruh SDM, tamu, kontraktor, pengguna jasa, pemasok, dan pemangku kepentingan lain. Sesuai prosedur induksi keselamatan tersebut, materi yang diberikan pada kegiatan induksi mencakup hal-hal sebagai berikut: a. Kebijakan keselamatan perkeretaapian serta keselamatan dan kesehatan kerja Perusahaan; Emergency and Major Accident Response in the Workplace As a company engaged in the railway industry, KAI structurally manages risks so as not to cause operational losses. KAI has implemented policies for responding to emergencies and major accidents that occur in the workplace. Initial handling of accident incidents refers to the Director's Instruction Number 13/KP.501/KA-2012 concerning First Aid in Accidents (P3K) in the Workplace of PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero). Specifically, the P3K policy in the KAI environment regulates matters related to (1) P3K officers in the workplace and (2) P3K facilities in the workplace, including the requirements for P3K rooms and kits.
Meanwhile, emergency and major accident response at KAI is carried out in accordance with the Board of Directors Decree of PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) Number KEP.U/LL.507/ VII/2/KA-2015 concerning Standard Operating Procedures for Emergency Handling in Station Areas, Depots, Balai Yasa, and During Train Journeys, as well as the Board of Directors Regulation of PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) Number PER.U/KT.204/XII/1/KA-2018 concerning Standard Operating Procedures for Emergency Response to Train Operational Disruptions.
KAI also implements fire prevention and response efforts at Balai Yasa Sarana, Balai Yasa Prasarana, Dipo Sarana, Dipo Prasarana, and Stations based on the Board of Directors Decree of PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) Number KEP.U/ KS.101/XII/2/KA-2016, as an effort to deal with emergencies and major accidents in the workplace.
Safety Induction for Internal and External Parties KAI implements safety induction regulated through the Board of Directors Regulation of PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) Number PER-S/KS.102/IV/26/KA-2020 concerning Safety Induction Procedures in the Railway Safety Management System. The implementation of safety induction is an activity to communicate Railway Safety and Occupational Health and Safety information to all human resources, guests, contractors, service users, suppliers, and other stakeholders.
According to these safety induction procedures, the material provided in the induction activities includes the following: a. The Company’s railway safety and occupational health and safety policies; 629 Annual and Sustainability Report 2024 | PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) Laporan Keberlanjutan Sustainability Report b. Bahaya dan insiden yang mungkin ditimbulkan dari kegiatan operasional perkeretaapian dan proses kerja SDM KAI; c. Peran dan tanggung jawab SDM KAI, tamu, kontraktor, pengguna jasa, pemasok, dan pemangku kepentingan lainnya di dalam menerapkan Sistem Manajemen Keselamatan Perkeretaapian dan mengendalikan bahaya; d. Persyaratan keselamatan perkeretaapian serta keselamatan dan kesehatan kerja yang harus dipatuhi oleh SDM KAI, tamu, kontraktor, pengguna jasa, pemasok, dan pemangku kepentingan lainnya, seperti tanda/rambu yang harus dipatuhi, alat pelindung diri yang harus dikenakan, area kerja yang tidak boleh dimasuki, dan lain-lain; e. Cara melaporkan jika ada bahaya, tindakan tidak aman, kondisi tidak aman, insiden dan/atau keadaan darurat; f. Prosedur atau rencana tanggap darurat, seperti cara menyelamatkan diri, sarana jalan keluar dan evakuasi, titik kumpul dalam keadaan darurat, jenis alarm yang perlu diketahui (audible dan/atau visual), instruksi yang harus dipatuhi, serta apa yang boleh dan tidak boleh dilakukan ketika terjadi keadaan darurat; g. Fasilitas yang disediakan oleh Perusahaan serta lokasinya, seperti kamar mandi, ruang ibu menyusui, kotak P3K, klinik atau layanan kesehatan, sistem deteksi dan alarm kebakaran, alat pemadam api ringan, fasilitas ibadah, dan fasilitas lain yang dianggap perlu untuk diketahui; dan h. Imbauan penyampaian saran, umpan balik, dan keluhan mengenai keselamatan perkeretaapian serta keselamatan dan kesehatan kerja.
Pengungkapan Praktik Pelanggaran Ketentuan Ketenagakerjaan pada Pekerja pada Pihak Pemasok Untuk memastikan seluruh pekerja pihak pemasok mematuhi peraturan perundang-undangan, KAI KAI melakukan identifikasi terhadap praktik pelanggaran ketentuan ketenagakerjaan pada pekerja pihak pemasok yang digunakan pada 2024. Merujuk pada hasil identifikasi tersebut, tidak ditemukan adanya praktik pelanggaran terhadap ketentuan ketenagakerjaan yang dilakukan pihak pemasok atau mitra kerja KAI.
Daftar Pihak Pemasok Berdasarkan Klasifikasi Tingkat Sampai dengan 2024, KAI belum melakukan klasifikasi terhadap pihak pemasok berdasarkan tingkat risiko pekerjaan. Oleh karenanya, KAI tidak mengungkapkan informasi mengenai daftar pihak pemasok berdasarkan klasifikasi tersebut pada bagian ini. b. Hazards and incidents that may arise from railway operational activities and the work processes of KAI’s human resources; c. The roles and responsibilities of KAI’s human resources, guests, contractors, service users, suppliers, and other stakeholders in implementing the Railway Safety Management System and controlling hazards; d. Railway safety and occupational health and safety requirements that must be adhered to by KAI’s human resources, guests, contractors, service users, suppliers, and other stakeholders, such as signs that must be followed, personal protective equipment that must be worn, work areas that must not be entered, and others; e. How to report hazards, unsafe actions, unsafe conditions, incidents, and/or emergencies; f. Emergency procedures or plans, such as how to evacuate, exit routes and evacuation, emergency assembly points, types of alarms to be recognized (audible and/or visual), instructions to be followed, and what to do and not to do during an emergency; g. Facilities provided by the Company and their locations, such as bathrooms, nursing rooms, first aid kits, clinics or health services, fire detection and alarm systems, fire extinguishers, places of worship, and other facilities deemed necessary to be known; and h. Encouragement to provide suggestions, feedback, and complaints regarding railway safety and occupational health and safety.
Disclosure of Labor Regulation Violations by Supplier Employees To ensure the compliance of all supplier employees with laws and regulations, KAI identified practices of labor regulation violations among supplier employees used in 2024. Referring to the results of this identification, no violations of labor regulations were found to have been committed by KAI’s suppliers or partners.
List of Suppliers Based on Job Risk Classification As of 2024, KAI has not classified suppliers based on job risk levels. Therefore, KAI does not disclose information regarding the list of suppliers based on this classification in this section.
630 PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) | Laporan Tahunan dan Keberlanjutan 2024 Memperkuat Layanan dan Menjamin Keselamatan untuk Wujudkan Keberlanjutan Empowering Services and Ensuring Safety to Cultivate Sustainability Pengidentifikasian Bahaya, Penilaian Risiko, dan Investigasi Insiden [GRI 403-2] Sebagai upaya preventif untuk memitigasi risiko kecelakaan kereta api, kecelakaan kerja, penyakit akibat kerja dan pencemaran lingkungan hidup, KAI menerapkan proses Identifikasi Bahaya, Penilaian dan Pengendalian Risiko Keselamatan (IBPR). KAI mewajibkan seluruh Kepala Unit Pelaksana Teknis (UPT) di tingkat Daerah melakukan proses IBPR, untuk selanjutnya diperiksa oleh Quality Controller sebelum disetujui oleh Manajer unit terkait. Penerapan IBPR ini dijalankan sesuai ketentuan yang terdapat dalam SMKP. Bahaya yang telah diidentifikasi selanjutnya akan dinilai risikonya dan ditetapkan jenis pengendalian risikonya berdasarkan hierarki pengendalian risiko keselamatan, yang mencakup eliminasi, substitusi, rekayasa teknik, administrasi, dan alat pelindung diri. IBPR yang telah disetujui oleh Manager atau Senior Manager unit terkait akan dibahas di dalam Rapat Komite Keselamatan Tingkat Daerah yang dilaksanakan secara rutin setiap bulan, yang hasilnya dikirim kepada Direktorat Keselamatan dan Keamanan. Untuk mengetahui efektivitas penerapan IBPR, secara berkala Unit Safety Kantor Pusat melakukan evaluasi terkait dengan pelaksanaan proses IBPR yang berjalan di KAI. Hasil evaluasi dijadikan dasar bagi Perseroan dalam mengambil keputusan-keputusan strategis untuk memitigasi risiko keselamatan ataupun perbaikan terhadap pelaksanaan proses BPR yang sedang berlangsung. Setiap tahunnya, Unit Safety menyelenggarakan kegiatan sosialisasi, lokakarya, serta mendistribusikan materi IBPR di dalam pelatihan internal. Hal tersebut dilakukan sebagai upaya terus-menerus dalam meningkatkan kesadaran, pemahaman, dan kompetensi pekerja KAI terkait penerapan proses IBPR.
Di samping melakukan usaha preventif melalui proses IBPR, Perseroan juga memfasilitasi pelaporan bahaya sebagai upaya korektif untuk mencegah terjadinya kecelakaan. Pelaporan bahaya tersebut difasilitasi melalui aplikasi Safety Railway Information (SRI), yang dapat diakses oleh seluruh pekerja. Untuk mengakomodir pelapor yang tidak memiliki akses ke aplikasi Safety Railway Information maka disediakan media pelaporan melalui WhatsApp Center Safety Railway Information yang nantinya akan diteruskan ke aplikasi SRI. KAI menerapkan kebijakan untuk menjaga kerahasiaan identitas pelapor dan memberi jaminan bahwa tidak terdapat hukuman atau sanksi apa pun yang akan dikenakan bagi pelapor, berdasarkan Keputusan Direksi PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) Nomor KEP.U/KK.301/XII/1/KA-2016.
Hazard Identification, Risk Assessment, and Incident Investigation [GRI 403-2] As a preventive measure to mitigate the risks of train accidents, workplace accidents, occupational diseases, and environmental pollution, KAI implements the Hazard Identification, Risk Assessment, and Safety Risk Control (IBPR) process. KAI requires all Heads of Technical Implementation Units (UPT) at the regional level to carry out the IBPR process, which is then reviewed by the Quality Controller before being approved by the relevant unit Manager.
The implementation of IBPR is carried out in accordance with the provisions in the SMKP. Identified hazards are assessed for their risks and the type of risk control is determined based on the safety risk control hierarchy, which includes elimination, substitution, engineering controls, administrative controls, and personal protective equipment. IBPRs approved by the Manager or Senior Manager of the relevant unit are discussed in the Regional Safety Committee Meetings held monthly, with the results sent to the Directorate of Safety and Security.
To determine the effectiveness of IBPR implementation, the Central Office Safety Unit periodically evaluates the implementation of the IBPR process at KAI. The results of these evaluations become the basis for the Company in making strategic decisions for mitigating safety risks or improvements to the ongoing IBPR process. The Safety Unit conducts annual dissemination activities and workshops, as well as distributes IBPR materials in internal training. This is done as a continuous effort to increase awareness, understanding, and competence of KAI employees regarding the implementation of the IBPR process.
In addition to preventive efforts through the IBPR process, the Company also facilitates hazard reporting as a corrective measure to prevent accidents. Hazard reporting is facilitated through the Safety Railway Information (SRI) app, which can be accessed by all employees. For the reporting entity that does not have access to the Safety Railway Information app, a reporting medium is provided through the Safety Railway Information Whatsapp Center, which will then be forwarded to the SRI app. KAI implements a policy to maintain the confidentiality of the reporting entity’s identity and guarantees that no punishment or sanctions will be imposed on the reporting entity, based on the Board of Directors Decree of PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) Number KEP.U/ KK.301/XII/1/KA-2016.
631 Annual and Sustainability Report 2024 | PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) Laporan Keberlanjutan Sustainability Report Apabila terjadi insiden yang membahayakan keselamatan, Direktur Keselamatan dan Keamanan akan segera menetapkan tim khusus yang ditugaskan untuk melakukan proses investigasi terhadap insiden tersebut. Tim Investigasi tersebut kemudian akan segera menuju lokasi kejadian untuk melaksanakan rangkaian proses investigasi meliputi pengumpulan bukti/data lapangan, pengumpulan keterangan saksi, pengolahan dan analisis data, penyusunan laporan hasil investigasi mencakup hasil kesimpulan penyebab terjadinya insiden, hingga penyusunan rekomendasi perbaikan dan pencegahan. Dalam penerapan proses investigasi insiden kecelakaan kereta api, KAI menggunakan metode ORILIO (Organisational Influences, Operational Risk Control, Local Factors, Individual Actions and Occurrence Events). Adapun, terhadap insiden kecelakaan kerja, KAI menerapkan pendekatan SCAT (Systematic Cause Analysis Techniques). Setelah rangkaian proses investigasi selesai, Direktur Keselamatan dan Keamanan menyampaikan laporan hasil investigasi kepada seluruh pihak terkait. Kemudian Unit Safety melakukan proses monitoring terhadap pelaksanaan safety action berdasarkan rekomendasi tindakan perbaikan dan pencegahan yang dihasilkan dari laporan hasil investigasi.
Layanan Kesehatan [GRI 403-3, 403-6] KAI menyediakan fasilitas kesehatan miliki KAI, yaitu Klinik Mediska, yang dapat dimanfaatkan oleh pekerja, keluarga pekerja, hingga masyarakat. Penyediaan layanan kesehatan kerja tersebut diatur berdasarkan Peraturan Direksi PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) Nomor PER.A/KL.104/I/1/KA-2019 tanggal 8 Januari 2019 tentang Standardisasi Minimum Fasilitas Klinik Mediska. Untuk menjaga kinerja operasional berjalan sesuai target, KAI mewajibkan para pekerja untuk melakukan pemeriksaan kesehatan pekerja secara rutin melalui program medical check-up tahunan, dan pemeriksaan kesehatan, sebelum berdinas kepada awak sarana perkeretaapian di Pos Pemeriksaan Kesehatan (POSRIKKES). Pemeriksaan kesehatan sebelum menjalankan pekerjaan dinas sangat penting dilakukan guna memastikan para pekerja, termasuk masinis, bebas dari pengaruh alkohol. Ini adalah bagian dari prosedur pemeriksaan kesehatan yang dilakukan sebelum masinis dan asisten masinis mulai dinas. KAI memastikan kondisi masinis dalam keadaan sehat dan prima, sehingga perjalanan kereta api dapat berlangsung aman, nyaman, selamat, dan tepat waktu. Selain pemeriksaan bebas alkohol, masinis juga diperiksa untuk suhu tubuh dan tekanan darah. If a safety-threatening incident occurs, the Managing Director of Safety and Security will immediately establish a special team assigned to investigate the incident. The Investigation Team will then promptly go to the incident location to carry out a series of investigation processes, including collecting evidence/field data, gathering witness statements, processing and analyzing data, preparing an investigation report that includes conclusions on the causes of the incident, and preparing recommendations for improvements and prevention.
In the implementation of train accident incident investigations, KAI uses the ORILIO method (Organizational Influences, Operational Risk Control, Local Factors, Individual Actions, and Occurrence Events). For workplace accident incidents, KAI applies the SCAT (Systematic Cause Analysis Techniques) approach.
After the entire investigation process is completed, the Managing Director of Safety and Security will present the investigation report to all relevant parties. Subsequently, the Safety Unit will monitor the implementation of safety actions based on the corrective and preventive action recommendations resulting from the investigation report.
Health Services [GRI 403-3, 403-6] KAI offers health facilities owned by KAI itself, namely Mediska Clinics, which can be utilized by employees, their families, and the community. The provision of these occupational health services is regulated by the Director's Regulation of PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) Number PER.A/KL.104/I/1/KA-2019 dated January 8, 2019, concerning Minimum Standardization of Mediska Clinic Facilities.
To maintain operational performance according to the target, KAI requires employees to conduct regular health checks for workers through an annual medical check-up program and pre-service health examinations for railway personnel at Health Examination Posts (POSRIKKES). Health checks before carrying out official work are crucial to ensure that employees, including train drivers, are free from the influence of alcohol. This is part of the health check procedure carried out before train drivers and assistant train drivers start working. KAI ensures that train drivers are in good health and prime condition so that train travel can be safe, comfortable, secure, and on time. In addition to the alcohol-free check, train drivers are also checked for body temperature and blood pressure.
632 PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) | Laporan Tahunan dan Keberlanjutan 2024 Memperkuat Layanan dan Menjamin Keselamatan untuk Wujudkan Keberlanjutan Empowering Services and Ensuring Safety to Cultivate Sustainability Kecelakaan Kerja dan Langkah Pencegahan Insiden Kematian [GRI 403-9, 403-10] Dalam rangka meminimalisasi adanya risiko kerja berkenaan dengan aktivitas operasi Perseroan, KAI secara berkesinambungan melakukan investigasi dan pendataan terhadap insiden kecelakaan kerja secara berkala. KAI menerapkan proses Identifikasi Bahaya, Penilaian dan Pengendalian Risiko Keselamatan (IBPR) sebagai upaya memitigasi risiko kecelakaan kerja, penyakit akibat kerja, serta insiden kematian di tempat kerja. Untuk memperkuat upaya mitigasi, KAI juga mengimplementasikan Sistem Manajemen Keselamatan Perkeretaapian dengan memastikan keandalan peralatan kerja serta memberikan pelatihan K3 kepada pekerja secara berkala, sebagai upaya sistematis pencegahan insiden penyakit, kecelakaan hingga kematian di tempat kerja. KAI berkomitmen untuk senantiasa memastikan kinerja operasional telah memenuhi prosedur yang ditetapkan demi menjamin keamanan dan keselamatan seluruh pekerja baik pekerja KAI maupun pekerja mitra usaha kami. Upaya kuat ini membawa hasil dengan tidak terdapatnya kematian pekerja KAI pada periode 2024. Kami sungguh menyesali kejadian tersebut dan kami terus melakukan evaluasi dan pembenahan terhadap sistem dan prosedur kami. Berikut rekapitulasi kecelakaan kerja pada 3 (tiga) tahun terakhir: Rekapitulasi Kecelakaan Kerja Uraian / Description Satuan / Unit 2024 2023 2022 Kecelakaan Kerja / Work Accidents Orang / Person(s) 7 11 7 Kematian / Fatality Orang / Person(s) 0 2 0 Jumlah jam kerja aman* / Safe working hours* Jam / Hours 3.140.560 5.677.549 8.888.040 Lost Time Injury Frequency Rate (LTIFR) Pekerja Organik / Lost Time Injury Frequency Rate (LTIFR) for Organic Workers LTIFR 0,10 0,14 0,12 Lost Time Injury Frequency Rate (LTIFR) Outsource LTIFR 0,04 0,29 0,00 *) Disajikan kembali / Restated **) Perhitungan jam kerja aman dilakukan terhadap hari kerja yang bebas dari kejadian kecelakaan kerja setiap tahun. Apabila terjadi kecelakaan kerja pada tahun berjalan, maka perhitungan jam kerja aman di reset dari tanggal kejadian kecelakaan terakhir hingga tanggal akhir tahun berjalan. Hasil yang disampaikan dalam tabel diatas adalah perhitungan rata-rata jam kerja aman dalam tiap tahunnya. Jumlah jam kerja aman dipengaruhi oleh kondisi pandemi yang terjadi di tahun 2021-2022 dimana operasional KA menjadi lebih sedikit dibandingkan di tahun 2023, serta pada tahun 2023 juga mulai ada penambahan jumlah pekerja dibandingkan tahun sebelumnya. / The calculation of safe working hours is based on workdays free from work accidents each year. If a work accident occurs during the year, the calculation of safe working hours is reset from the date of the last accident until the end of the current year. The results presented in the table above are the average calculation of safe working hours each year. The number of safe working hours was influenced by the pandemic conditions in 2021-2022, where train operations were reduced compared to 2023. Additionally, in 2023, there was an increase in the number of employees compared to the previous year.
Partisipasi, Konsultasi, dan Komunikasi pekerja Tentang Keselamatan dan Kesehatan Kerja [GRI 403-4] Sebagai upaya kepatuhan terhadap peraturan perundangan dan implementasi Sistem Manajemen Keselamatan Perkeretaapian (SMKP) yang terintegrasi dengan Sistem Manajemen Keselamatan dan Kesehatan Kerja (SMK3), Perseroan telah membentuk Komite Keselamatan. Komite Keselamatan ini secara umum bertugas sebagai fasilitator Work Accidents and Incident Prevention Measures [GRI 403-9, 403-10] KAI conducts regular investigations and documentation of work accidents as a continuous effort to minimize work-related risks associated with the Company’s operational activities. As a preventive measure to mitigate the risks of work accidents, occupational diseases, and fatalities in the workplace, KAI implements the Hazard Identification, Risk Assessment, and Safety Risk Control (IBPR) process. Additionally, KAI applies the Railway Safety Management System by ensuring the reliability of work equipment and providing regular occupational health and safety (OHS) training to employees as a systematic effort to prevent incidents of disease, accidents, and fatalities in the workplace.
KAI is committed to always ensuring that operational procedures fulfill the set procedures to guarantee the safety and security of all employees, including KAI employees and our business partners’ employees. This strong effort has yielded results with no KAI employee deaths still occurring in 2024. We deeply regret this incident and will evaluate our systems and procedures for the future. The recapitulation for the last 3 (three) years is as follows: Recapitulation of Work Accidents Employee Participation, Consultation, and Communication on Occupational Health and Safety [GRI 403-4] As an effort to comply with laws and regulations and the implementation of the Railway Safety Management System (SMKP) which is integrated with the Occupational Safety and Health Management System (SMK3), the Company has formed a Safety Committee. This Safety Committee generally serves as a facilitator in the implementation of aspects of railway 633 Annual and Sustainability Report 2024 | PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) Laporan Keberlanjutan Sustainability Report dalam implementasi aspek keselamatan perkeretaapian, keselamatan dan kesehatan kerja serta lingkungan hidup di seluruh wilayah kerja KAI baik di Daerah Operasi (Daop), Divisi Regional (Divre) ataupun Balai Yasa. Setiap bulan Komite Keselamatan secara rutin melaksanakan pertemuan guna membahas isu terkait keselamatan pada wilayah-wilayah tersebut. Bila terdapat permasalahan yang tidak dapat diputuskan pada tingkat Komite Keselamatan Daop, Divre, dan Balai Yasa akan disampaikan kepada Direktur Keselamatan dan Keamananan untuk selanjutnya dibahas pada Rapat Komite Keselamatan Tingkat Pusat. Pada tahun 2024 Komite Keselamatan Tingkat Pusat telah rutin menyelenggarakan rapat setiap bulan sebanyak 12 kali, dihadiri oleh DU, D2, D3, D5 beserta jajaran EVP, VP dari direktorat lainnya Pelatihan Pekerja Mengenai Keselamatan dan Kesehatan Kerja [GRI 403-5] Untuk meningkatkan kualitas Keselamatan dan Kesehatan Kerja (K3), KAI menyelenggarakan program pengembangan kompetensi untuk pekerja berupa mengikuti pelatihan internal dan pelatihan sertifikasi khusus yang bekerja sama dengan Lembaga Pelatihan eksternal bagi pekerja. Untuk pelatihan internal, KAI memberikan pelatihan materi K3. Materi ini wajib dikuasai pada penyelenggaraan pelatihan di Training Center KAI. Pada pelatihan sertifikasi khusus, KAI bekerja sama dengan Lembaga Pelatihan/ Sertifikasi eksternal yang sudah mendapatkan penunjukan dari Kementerian Ketenagakerjaan, Badan Nasional Sertifikasi Profesi (BNSP), dan lainnya sesuai kebutuhan. Employee Training on Occupational Health and Safety [GRI 403-5] To improve the quality of Occupational Health and Safety (OHS), KAI conducts competency development programs for employees in the form of participation in internal training and specialized certification training in collaboration with external training institutions for employees. In internal training, KAI includes OHS material as mandatory content that must be mastered during training sessions at the KAI Training Center. For specialized certification training, KAI collaborates with external Training Institutions that have been appointed by the Ministry of Manpower, the National Professional Certification Agency (BNSP), and others as needed. dan Kesehatan Kerja yang Secara Langsung Terkait Hubungan Bisnis [GRI 403-7] Untuk mewujudkan pengelolaan risiko yang efektif dan efisien, KAI mengimplementasikan proses Identifikasi Bahaya, Penilaian dan Pengendalian Risiko Keselamatan (IBPR). Dengan menerapkan IBPR, KAI dapat melakukan upaya preventif dan mitigasi terhadap risiko keselamatan, yang mencakup risiko kecelakaan kereta api, kecelakaan kerja, penyakit akibat kerja, dan pencemaran lingkungan hidup. Prevention and Mitigation of Occupational Health and Safety Impacts Directly Linked by Business Relationships [GRI 403-7] To realize effective and efficient risk management, KAI implements the Hazard Identification, Risk Assessment, and Safety Risk Control (IBPR) process. By implementing IBPR, KAI can take preventive and mitigation measures against safety risks, which include railway accidents, occupational accidents, work-related illnesses, and environmental pollution.
636 PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) | Laporan Tahunan dan Keberlanjutan 2024 Memperkuat Layanan dan Menjamin Keselamatan untuk Wujudkan Keberlanjutan Empowering Services and Ensuring Safety to Cultivate Sustainability IBPR telah diterapkan pada seluruh Daerah Operasional (Daop), Divisi Regional (Divre) dan Balai Yasa Sarana. Hasil IBPR yang dilakukan pada level unit, kemudian dibahas secara rutin setiap bulan di dalam Rapat Komite Keselamatan Tingkat Daerah, untuk dilaporkan kepada Direktorat Keselamatan dan Keamanan. Proses IBPR diterapkan secara terintegrasi ke dalam sistem Manajemen Risiko Terpadu (Enterprise Risk Management) yang difasilitasi melalui aplikasi Sistem Manajemen Risiko Terpadu Kereta Api (SMARTKA). Untuk menjaga kinerja operasional berjalan baik, KAI terus-menerus melakukan pengembangan terhadap proses IBPR yang dilakukan melalui evaluasi dan perbaikan secara berkesinambungan, sehingga pengelolaan risiko keselamatan dapat berjalan optimal.
Pelatihan dan Pengembangan Kemampuan Pegawai [OJK F.22] [GRI 404] Sebagai wujud pemenuhan hak bagi pekerja untuk dapat mengembangkan kompetensi sekaligus untuk meningkatkan produktivitas kinerja pekerja, KAI menyelenggarakan program pelatihan dan pengembangan kemampuan pekerja. Secara periodik, KAI melaksanakan kegiatan pelatihan dan pendidikan pekerja, yang diharapkan mampu menghadirkan SDM yang unggul dan kompetitif sekaligus mendukung upaya peningkatan kualitas pelayanan bagi pelanggan, hubungan kerja dengan mitra usaha, serta hubungan baik dengan masyarakat. Program pengembangan kompetensi bagi pekerja yang dirancang dan dilaksanakan oleh KAI sejalan dengan pencapaian visi dan misi Perseroan tahun 2020-2024, dan mengakomodir talenta baru bagi Perseroan. Untuk mengoptimalkan pelaksanaan program pengembangan kompetensi KAI memiliki Divisi Training & Education yang bertransformasi menjadi KAI Corporate University. Divisi ini bertanggung jawab dalam mengelola perencanaan, pengendalian, dan evaluasi pelaksanaan program, hingga merencanakan materi pendidikan dan pelatihan. Selain itu, divisi ini bertugas memelihara fasilitas program, menyusun standarisasi kualitas dan sertifikasi/ pengujian SDM sesuai kebutuhan Perseroan, serta melakukan pengelolaan pengembangan pegawai.
Sebagai pemenuhan hak asasi manusia dan menciptakan kualitas SDM yang berkarakter, KAI memberikan kesempatan yang sama kepada seluruh pekerja (100%) untuk mengikuti pengembangan kompetensi tanpa adanya diskriminasi apapun termasuk latar belakang mereka. IBPR is applied across all Operational Areas (Daop), Regional Divisions (Divre), and Balai Yasa Sarana. The results of the IBPR conducted at the unit level are routinely discussed monthly in the Regional Safety Committee Meetings and reported to the Directorate of Safety and Security. The IBPR process is integrated into the Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) system, facilitated through the Integrated Railway Risk Management System (SMARTKA) app. KAI is committed to continuously implementing and developing the IBPR process through ongoing evaluation and improvement to ensure that safety risk prevention, mitigation, and management are carried out optimally.
Employee Training and Development [OJK F.22] [GRI 404] As a form of fulfillment of employees’ rights to be able to develop their competencies as well as to increase employee performance productivity, KAI organizes employee training and development programs. KAI periodically conducts employee training and education activities, which are expected to be able to produce superior and competitive human resources while supporting the improvement of service quality for customers, fostering working relationships with business partners, and maintaining good relations with the community.
The competency development program for employees designed and implemented by KAI is in line with the achievement of the Company's vision and mission for 2020-2024, and accommodates new talents for the Company. To optimize the implementation of the competency development program, KAI has a Training & Education Division that has transformed into KAI Corporate University. This division is responsible for managing the planning, control, and evaluation of program implementation, including planning educational and training materials. In addition, this division is responsible for maintaining program facilities, preparing quality standards and HR certification/testing according to the Company's needs, and managing employee development.
As a fulfillment of human rights and to create quality human resources with character, KAI provides equal opportunities for all employees (100%) to develop their competencies without any discrimination, including based on their background.
637 Annual and Sustainability Report 2024 | PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) Laporan Keberlanjutan Sustainability Report Program pelatihan dan pengembangan kompetensi pekerja dilakukan berdasarkan ketentuan internal berupa Keputusan Direksi PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) tentang Petunjuk Pelaksanaan Sistem Pengembangan Karier. Berdasarkan ketentuan tersebut, pengembangan karier di dalam organisasi KAI diterapkan melalui program pendidikan dan pelatihan (Diklat), yang terdiri dari Diklat Pembentukan, Diklat Profesional, dan Diklat Manajerial. Upaya ini merupakan wujud upaya KAI dalam memberikan kesempatan yang transparan dan setara bagi seluruh pekerja (100%) untuk dapat mengisi berbagai posisi jabatan, melalui sistem promosi, jenjang karier, serta jalur pengembangan karier yang dievaluasi secara objektif berdasarkan kompetensi yang dimiliki. Kebijakan dan Pelaksanaan Pengembangan Kompetensi [GRI 3-3, 404-2] Perseroan telah melakukan penyesuaian terhadap model kompetensi yang diterapkan untuk pekerja KAI, sebagai upaya menyesuaikan perkembangan peran SDM dan perubahan tantangan yang dihadapi. Hal ini dilakukan untuk mendukung tercapainya visi dan misi Perseroan, sejalan dengan pencapaian Rencana Jangka Panjang Perusahaan (RJPP) tahun 2020-2024. Di samping itu, penyesuaian model kompetensi dilakukan untuk mengakomodasi kapabilitas baru di dalam struktur organisasi Perseroan. Model Kompetensi KAI tersebut diberlakukan berdasarkan Peraturan Direksi PER.U/ KH.503/IX/1/KA-2021 tentang Kamus dan Profil Kompetensi. Model Kompetensi KAI meliputi kompetensi yang bersifat non-teknis (soft-competency) dan teknis (hard-competency). Kompetensi non-teknis mengacu pada kompetensi yang berkaitan dengan kemampuan mengelola proses pekerjaan, mengelola hubungan antarmanusia, serta membangun interaksi dengan orang lain, terdiri dari Basic, Core, dan Leadership. Sementara kompetensi teknis merupakan keterampilan teknis yang melekat atau dibutuhkan untuk profesi/posisi tertentu, terdiri dari Technical, Bussiness, Digital, dan Management. Berikut penjelasan mengenai Model Kompetensi KAI: The employee training and competency development programs are conducted based on internal regulations, specifically the Board of Directors Resolution of PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) regarding the Implementation Guidelines for the Career Development System. According to these regulations, career development within KAI is implemented through education and training programs (Diklat), which include Formation Training, Professional Training, and Managerial Training. This is KAI’s effort to provide transparent and equal opportunities for all (100%) employees to fill various positions through a promotion system, career paths, and career development tracks that are objectively evaluated based on their competencies.
Competency Development Policy and Implementation [GRI 3-3, 404-2] The Company has adjusted the competency model applied to KAI employees, as the role of human resources evolves and new challenges arise, which is carried out to support the achievement of the Company’s vision and mission, in line with the Long-Term Corporate Plan (RJPP) for 2020-2024. Moreover, the adjustment to the competency model is made to accommodate new capabilities within the Company's organizational structure. The KAI Competency Model is implemented based on the Director's Regulation PER.U/ KH.503/IX/1/KA-2021 concerning the Competency Dictionary and Profiles.
The KAI Competency Model includes both non-technical (soft-competency) and technical (hard-competency) competencies. Non-technical competencies refer to skills related to managing work processes, interpersonal relationships, and building interactions with others, and are categorized into Basic, Core, and Leadership. Technical competencies involve the specific skills required for particular professions/ positions and are divided into Technical, Business, Digital, and Management. Learning Development System and Program • Core is the main development program aimed at shaping the character of all KAI personnel to be collaborative, innovative, and proactive.
• Basic is a development program designed to equip workers with fundamental competencies required by all KAI personnel (Integrity, Service Excellence, Prioritizing Safety).
• Technical is a development program focused on enhancing expertise through the fulfillment of railway technical competencies and its ecosystem.
• Business is a development program designed to support the company's business in achieving its vision and mission through the fulfillment of technical competencies related to the business.
• Management is a development program aimed at maximizing job functions through the fulfillment of competencies that support job roles or positions.
• Digital is a development program designed to address challenges in the era of digitalization through the fulfillment of digital competencies.
• Leadership is a development program designed to prepare the Company’s leaders to compete with other state-owned enterprises (SOEs) by fulfilling leadership competencies for executives.

SOCIAL AND COMMUNITY ASPECTS Impact of Operations on Surrounding Communities [OJK F.23] [GRI 3-3, 413-1] KAI does not only focus on making a profit in carrying out its business activities, but it is also committed to providing positive values to the community, which is realized in providing support for improving regional economic growth. KAI strives to continue supporting the community’s economic circulation by building strategic collaborations with all stakeholders.
